title_en: Fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue system comprising a command platform and a positioning caller worn on a firefighter. The positioning caller comprises an inertial positioning module, an active positioning module and a first sending module; the inertial positioning module is used for acquiring current first position information by adopting an inertial positioning mode; the active positioning module is used for acquiring current second position information by adopting an active positioning mode; the first sending module is used for sending the first position information and the second position information to the command platform; and the command platform is used for calculating the actual position of the positioning caller according to the first position information and the second position information. By adopting the fire rescue system, accurate position data is obtained by synthesizing the positioning results of the inertial positioning module and the active positioning module and after constraint and correction of an algorithm, so that the positioning precision of indoor positioning under complex environments is improved.

title_en: Method and apparatus to allow a psap to derive useful information from accelerometer data transmitted by a caller's device
abstract_en: A Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) is configured to receive a description of detected movement associated with one or more inertial sensors of a communication device. The description of the detected movement may then be analyzed to determine a likelihood of injury associated with the movement, whether or not the user associated with the communication device is experiencing abnormal neuromuscular activity, and/or whether the user is outside a range of the communication device such that the user is unlikely to hear audio information originating from the communication device. The PSAP may additionally or alternatively utilize the description of the movement information to assist and/or provide an advisory recommendation in the decision of which, if any first responder resources should be dispatched; the recommendation may include which resources and at what priority the resources should be dispatched.

title_en: Personnel and asset searching system and method for tourist attraction and goods yard
abstract_en: The invention integrates the GPS module and an ultra-long distance intelligent electronic tag which works in a low duty ratio working mode into a low-power consumption intelligent GPS tag by utilizing ultra-low power consumption and ultra-long distance sleep awakening technology with a distance of more than 1500 meters. The GPS tag not only has all functions of intelligent electronic tags including indoor positioning and multi-channel cooperative work, but also has the function of outdoor accurate positioning which is unique to the GPS. The GPS label does not depend on networks such as a mobile public network or WiFi and the like to transmit the GPS position information acquired by the GPS label, and the service life of a battery of the GPS label can reach 3-5 years. It is not only low in cost, but also simple and convenient to use. The device can be widely used for searching and positioning personnel in various tourist attractions, amusement places and cities; personnel management of the travel team. The remote area has no personnel search and rescue covered by network, and can be widely used for asset search and positioning of containers and the like in large ports and cargo yards.

title_en: Firefighter indoor positioning device and firefighter indoor positioning method based on compound positioning system
abstract_en: A firefighter indoor positioning device and a firefighter indoor positioning method based on a compound positioning system are disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: getting outdoor satellite positioning information; getting outdoor base station positioning information; getting indoor WIFI positioning information; correcting and optimizing the sea level standard atmospheric pressure and temperature values of the current area of the positioning system to get corresponding altitude information; and analytically processing, storing and recording the satellite positioning information, the base station positioning information, the WIFI positioning information and the altitude information, and providing real-time indoor positioning information and trajectory tracking information for a data service center. According to the invention, the positioning information of the modules in the positioning system is acquired and synthetically analyzed, and the locations of firefighters can be precisely positioned in real time when the firefighters get into a room and put out a fire to save life and property; and meanwhile, data of each dimension of the satellite positioning information is effectively stored in milliseconds, so the external data service center can monitor the trajectory of indoor rescue work of firefighters in real time.

title_en: Ultra wideband ai-enhanced imu tracking system for first responder use with smart glasses
abstract_en: A tracking system that works through walls, below grade, and at long range is provided, which may be utilized as a first responder tracking system. The system combines UWB (Ultrawideband) with AI-enhanced IMU motion tracking with use on, e.g., android-based smart glasses, phones and tablets. The UWB tracking provides a stable reference point in GPS denied environments, offering 3D tracking under the most challenging conditions. When walls or distance make UWB untenable, disclosed tags stream back IMU data processed by machine learning algorithms which remove, e.g., the effect of drift, noise, and error common to motion-based tracking. The system may process the UWB and IMU input data and produce a platform and language agnostic serialized message stream with position data. This published stream allows any visualization platform to subscribe and consume 3D position data, be it a local graph for engineering debug, cloud-based first responder software, or a third-party solution.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system which comprises a UWB (Ultra-Wide Bandwidth) radar front end and a signal processing display unit. The system can realize real-time and non-contact monitoring on physiological parameters of a human body, such as respiration, body movement signals, respiratory rate, and the like under the condition of penetrating through a thicker nonmetal obstacle. The ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system is mainly used for the physiological parameter monitoring of patients which are not suitable for being connected with electrodes and a sensor in a ward, such as large-area burn patients, and the like, can be also used for carrying out non-contact real-time monitoring on buried wounded people (who can not be rescued in short time) in the disasters, such as earthquake, and the like and provides necessary reference for search and rescue staffs applying medical rescue to learn the vital sign condition of a rescued object at any time.

title_en: Method for performing two-dimensional wireless positioning on stationary node based on single mobile node
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for performing two-dimensional wireless positioning on a stationary node based on a single mobile node and relates to a wireless positioning method. The method comprises the steps of measuring information of acceleration, angular speed and the like through an inertial sensor to calculate the relative position of the mobile node; determining several point coordinates to serve as virtual positioning index points; and using measured distances between the stationary node and the index points during determination and a locating algorithm to calculate relative coordinates of the stationary node to the mobile node, and displaying the relative coordinates on a handheld device. According to the method for performing two-dimensional wireless positioning on the stationary node based on the single mobile node, search and rescue personnel can find persons in distress rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Digital fire-fighting individual communication system and data perception acquisition communication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital fire-fighting individual communication system and a data perception acquisition communication method, which comprise a core communication terminal and a plurality of networking nodes, wherein the core communication terminal is assembled on a scene fire-fighting individual, and has a plurality of network communication modes, is carried by the fire-fighting individual, can be in wireless interconnection and intercommunication with one or a plurality of networking nodes nearby, and can carry out audio and video communication with scene actual combat command platform commander of other scene fire-fighting individual or scene command parts. According to the invention, the information acquisition and communication equipment are highly integrated, so that the effective fusion of the individual fire fighting system equipment is realized, the individual combat load is reduced, and the individual flexible combat advantage is better exerted; the UWB-Tag is applied to realize the position location of the UWB base station, a method for information communication exchange between two networks is established, the difficulty of position acquisition of individual firefighters in indoor and outdoor spaces, particularly in the internal combat process of complex buildings, is solved, and the individual safety protection capability of the individual firefighters in the emergency rescue process can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: A kind of building based on BIM and UWB faces side hole safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of buildings based on BIM and UWB to face side hole safety management system and method, and management system includes UWB personnel positioning modules, and central server visualizes display module, and safe early warning module and intelligence search and rescue module；UWB personnel positionings module realizes personnel's three-dimensional localization by UWB no-load communication techniques；Personnel positioning information is carried out data with BIM models and coupled by central server, and analyzes whether personnel are in danger zone；Visualize accurate location of the display module real-time display personnel in BIM models；Safe early warning module carries out danger warning prompt to personnel；Intelligence searches and rescues module and determines most short rescue route for unexpected personnel occur, and is shown on BIM models.The present invention can be accurately positioned personnel's three-dimensional position in real time, and be compared and analyzed with preset danger zone, and phonic warning is carried out to construction personnel, to effectively take precautions against dangerous generation, help to reduce casualties, realize building site intelligent safety management.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of automatically switching navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle capable of automatically switching navigation systems, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a laser SLAM system for realizing navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a visual SLAM system for assisting navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a controller, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a plurality of navigation modules; when the controller detects that the error between the pose obtained by the laser inertial odometer in the laser SLAM system and the reference true value is larger than a switching setting threshold, the laser SLAM system is switched to the vision SLAM system for unmanned plane navigation. The unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention can still make a movement decision in a complex environment when encountering severe weather such as heavy rain, dense smoke or dense fog, and the like, so that the accuracy and stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle are improved, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to use, and the safety is improved.
assignees: BEIJING QINGYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar sensor-based bio-inspired autonomous mobile robot using ble location tracking for disaster rescue
abstract_en: An autonomous bio-inspired mobile robotic device ( 200 ) capable of detecting, tracking and communicating location of survivor(s) ( 34 ) trapped under earthquake/building collapse debris ( 30, 32 ). The small-size, lightweight, ruggedized autonomous legged mobile robot ( 200 ) incorporates high-frequency millimeter-wave radar sensor ( 10 ) and Ultra Wideband (IR-UWB) radar sensor ( 12 ) for detecting presence and perform ranging of trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ). The autonomous mobile robot ( 200 ) also comprises GNSS ( 8 ) and BLE ( 4 ) connectivity for location tracking of trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ) in conjunction with a Wi-Fi enabled visual sensing solution ( 20 ) and a flashlight ( 16 ) to aid during rescue operation. The battery-powered ( 24 ) autonomous bio-inspired mobile robot ( 200 ) also comprises an MCU ( 26 ), actuators ( 14   b ), motor control circuitry ( 18 ) and IMU ( 6 ) to control robot ( 200 ) locomotion and perform sensor data fusion. BLE ( 4 ) connectivity solution of the present invention ( 200 ) communicates the location of detected trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ) to a plurality of rescue devices ( 44 A,  44 B,  44 C) using Angle-of-Arrival ( 700 )/Angle-of-Departure ( 800 ) method for successful survivor ( 34 ) location resolution.

title_en: Method and system for locating and monitoring first responders
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention can provide for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station.

title_en: Precision aerial firefighting and deluge system for helicopters and unmanned aerial systems
abstract_en: The precision aerial firefighting and deluge system for helicopters and unmanned aerial systems is a device to attack fires inaccessible to firefighters due to altitude or other obstructions by streaming water or other fire retardant into or onto a specific location on the ground, on the water, or at altitude. The system employs a medium or heavy lift helicopter or unmanned aerial systems one or more tanks or bladders for water and/or fire retardant chemicals, a compressed air foam system, a pump, rigid plumbing lines for outflow of water/fire retardant; a rigid, telescopic boom that extends beyond rotor tip path plane, flexible lines/hoses inside boom; a crew switched electronic boom controller, a boom management system, a flange adapter, an electric, variable direction, crew-controlled fire monitor, a drop-hose, and a dart with inertial feathers.

title_en: Rescue equipment for dog
abstract_en: The invention relates to rescue equipment for dogs, which comprises a police dog cap, wherein the police dog cap is connected to rescue personnel handheld equipment through wireless transmission; the police dog cap comprises a control module, a camera, a sound pickup, a loudspeaker, a chargeable and dischargeable battery, a GPS positioning tag and a UWB positioning tag; the handheld device comprises a sound pickup, a loudspeaker, a chargeable and dischargeable battery, two UWB positioning base stations, a remote controller and a display module; the control module, UWB location label and GPS location are connected with control module, and the camera is connected with control module, and the adapter is connected with the controller, and the speaker is connected with the controller, can charge and discharge the battery and be connected with control module. The invention can realize the autonomous positioning requirements of the police dog and the rescued person with real-time high precision, the real-time transmission of the site environment, the voice conversation between the rescuers and the rescued person and the voice instruction of the police dog.

title_en: Method for Tracking Emergency Caller for Securing Emergency Rescue Golden Time in City Area
title_ko: 도심 지역에서 긴급 구조 골든타임 확보를 위한 요구조자 탐색 방법
abstract_en: A method for locating a first responder to ensure emergency rescue golden time in an urban area is disclosed. The method includes the following steps: measuring a signal strength from a rescuer terminal; estimating a GPS position error distribution of the rescuer; determining whether a path between the rescuer and the rescuer is LOS or NLOS and estimating a location and uncertainty of the rescuer after obtaining channel parameters according to each of the above; and minimizing a navigation path of the rescuer in a direction that minimizes a cramer-rao lower bound (CRLB), which is an inverse matrix of the FIM.
abstract_ko: 도심 지역에서 긴급 구조 골든타임 확보를 위한 요구조자 탐색 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 요구조자 단말기로부터의 신호 세기를 측정하는 단계; 구조대의 GPS 위치 오차 분포를 추정하는 단계; 구조대와 요구조자 사이의 경로가 LOS 인지 또는 NLOS인지 여부를 판단하고 각 상항에 따른 채널 파라미터를 획득한 후 요구조자의 위치 및 불확실성을 추정하는 단계; 및 FIM의 역행렬인 CRLB(Cramer-Rao Lower Bound)를 최소화하는 방향으로 구조대의 탐색 경로를 최소화하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UIF UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV

title_en: Positioning system and method for emergency networking in disaster area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning system and a method for emergency networking in a disaster area, belonging to the technical field of communication positioning. The system comprises a GNSS data module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the GNSS data module is used for acquiring coordinate data of a peripheral reference point of a disaster area and providing reference coordinate data for UWB emergency networking in the disaster area; the UWB emergency networking module is used for establishing UWB emergency networking in a disaster area according to the reference coordinate data; the UWB mobile tag positioning module is used for acquiring positioning data of UWB emergency networking in a disaster area; the data calculation module is used for calculating the position information of the rescuers according to the positioning data of the UWB emergency networking and the reference coordinate data; and the monitoring end display module is used for receiving the position information of the rescue workers and displaying the positions of the rescue workers in real time. The invention solves the problem that rescue workers cannot be accurately positioned due to the fact that the quality of communication signals cannot be guaranteed in a disaster site of building collapse in the prior art.

title_en: Individual soldier field searching equipment based on IMU guides
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual field searching equipment based on IMU (inertial measurement unit) guidance in the technical field of communication equipment, which comprises a microcontroller, a positioning function module, a communication function module, a power supply system, an interaction function module, a searching function module and a distress function module. The invention is provided with a GPS and Beidou BDS dual positioning mode, carries 4G, LORA and Beidou short message multi-communication modes, uses an MPU9250 nine-axis sensor and uses an algorithm such as Kalman filtering to calibrate gesture and geomagnetic errors for an IMU to be matched with an LCD to serve as an electronic compass to execute search and rescue guidance, uses low-power hardware, designs various working modes in terms of equipment software and algorithm to realize dynamic power consumption management, and tests that the duration is not less than 24 hours under the condition of full task output and not less than 48 hours under the normal condition.

title_en: Disaster prevention support system and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention support system and a program that allow for determining the attributes of occupants when displaying the number of the occupants in each area of a building.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention support system 1 includes an automatic fire alarm system 2, an indoor positioning system 3, an on-site activity support system 4, and a private firefighting support system 5. The disaster prevention support system 1 acquires location and attribute information of occupants. At the time of a fire, detector alarm information is sent from a support server 7 to portable terminals 8 carried by private firefighters, and a map image showing numbers of occupants in each area of a building, which are aggregated in units of the attribute based on the acquired location and attribute information, is displayed on a display device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Automatic determination of defibrillation pad location on patient's chest
abstract_en: A medical device uses UWB units to infer a position of an adjunct positioned in proximity to an exterior portion of a patient's body. The position information can be used to provide CPR feedback to a rescuer. In other applications, the position information can be used to provide prompts to a user to change the position of the adjunct.

title_en: Wireless remote control life detector for rescue searching
abstract_en: A life detector for wireless remote control rescue search belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and aims to solve the problems that the imaging effect of a radar detector and the detection precision of trapped people are affected due to the fact that the number of antennas causes high grating/side lobe levels when the existing radar life detector transmits ultra-wideband signals; according to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle main body is provided with the radio-frequency radar and the far-infrared camera for aerial detection, the unmanned aerial vehicle main body receives instructions from an operator under the action of the remote control antenna, so that control of a flight track and operation of radar detection equipment are realized, the radio-frequency radar emits ultra-wideband signals, electromagnetic wave irradiation detection is performed by using the spiral antenna array, meanwhile, the far-infrared camera captures thermal imaging data of a target point, the data are processed and analyzed by each functional module in the intelligent control computer, and the image optimization module optimizes images by adopting a weighted coherence factor processing method, so that grating/sidelobe levels are effectively inhibited, and resolution and detection accuracy of the images are improved.

title_en: Through-the-wall magnetoquasistatic positioning
abstract_en: Magnetoquasistatic through-the-wall non-line-of-sight coupling between a mobile transmitting device located within a building, or indoor, and a fixed receiving device located outside the building, outdoor, enables positioning of the transmitting device through the wall of the building and in non-line-of-sight environments. Systems based on magnetoquasistatic coupling can separately sense the distance and orientation of the transmitting device accurately even in heavy non-line-sight environments such as steel-reinforced buildings. The approach permits sensing and determination of location and attitude of mobile devices in buildings and can be used to locate rescue workers, first responders, or law enforcement officers inside a building.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting drill bracelet based on UWB
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting drill bracelet based on UWB, including shell, it is connected to first watchband and the second watchband at shell both ends, set on the face-piece of housing upper surface, display screen, battery and the machine core panel being set in the housing, set on the bottom case of housing lower surface；Machine core panel includes: master controller, UWB locating module, communication module, attitude transducer, heart rate sensor, smoke detector, and main controller controls；Master controller receives the position data determined by UWB locating module, the attitude data obtained by attitude transducer, the heart rate data obtained by heart rate sensor, the smoke data obtained by smoke detector, control display is on a display screen, and above-mentioned data are transmitted to by server by communication module, server is electrically connected monitoring client, is monitored in real time by monitoring client.The utility model can monitor the case where bracelet wearer in real time, and convenient processing in time is abnormal, ensure its safety, and accurate positioning, data transmission are fast.

title_en: Device for position tracking and monitoring of endangered rescue personnel in indoor diseaster environment using wireless communication and method thereof
title_ko: 무선통신을 이용한 실내 재난환경에서의 위험에 처한 구조대원의 위치파악 및 모니터링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a device for acquiring and monitoring a position of a rescue worker in danger in an indoor disaster environment using wireless communication comprises: a monitoring terminal including a bioactivity monitoring sensor unit to collect bioactivities via Bluetooth low energy (BLE) communication between a temperature sensor and a heart rate sensor, an indoor environment position tracking unit to use an acceleration sensor to track a position in an indoor environment, and a remote server communication unit to perform communication with a remote server via wireless communication to be carried on the body of a rescue worker; a server including a bioactivity monitoring unit to collect, store, and monitor the bioactivities and recognize a dangerous state, and an indoor position tracking unit to store position tracking data; and a search terminal including a sensing unit to determine whether the rescue worker is present or absent, a position tracking unit to track a position of a rescue worker and track a direction of a rescue worker in danger, and a direction display lamp to notify a direction to find a rescue worker in danger.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신을 이용한 실내 재난환경에서의 위험에 처한 구조대원의 위치파악 및 모니터링 장치에 관한 것으로, 온도센서와 심박센서간 BLE(Bluetooth Low Energy)통신을 통해 생체활동을 수집하는 생체활동 모니터링 센서부, 가속도 센서를 이용하여 실내 환경에서의 위치추적을 담당하는 실내환경 위치추적부, 및 무선통신을 통해 원격 서버와 통신을 수행하는 원격 서버통신부로 구성되어 구조대원 몸에 휴대하는 모니터링 단말; 상기 생체활동을 수집 및 저장, 모니터링, 위험상태 인지를 담당하는 생체활동 모니터링부, 및 위치추적 데이터를 저장하는 실내 위치 추적부로 구성된 서버; 및 상기 구조대원이 있는지 없는지를 판별하는 감지부, 구조대원의 위치를 추적하고 위험에 처한 구조대원의 방향을 추적해 내는 위치 추적부, 및 위험에 처한 구조대원을 찾기 위한 방향을 알리는 방향 표시등으로 구성된 탐색 단말;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume.
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a trans-mitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: Intelligent fire rescue boot and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent firefighting rescue boot and a positioning method thereof, wherein walking speed values, direction data and gesture data of a plurality of preset time points are transmitted by a miniature Inertial Navigation System (INS) deployed in the firefighting boot; performing time sequence association analysis on the walking speed values, the direction data and the gesture data of the plurality of preset time points to obtain positioning parameter association characteristics; and determining positioning data based on the positioning parameter association features. Therefore, the high-precision positioning of the firefighter can be realized under the condition that no external reference signal exists, so that the firefighter is suitable for complex and changeable fire scene environments, and the rescue efficiency and safety are improved.
assignees: DONGPENG SHOES IND CO LTD;Pingxiang Fire Rescue Detachment

title_en: Disaster site three-dimensional mapping system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster site mapping, and discloses a disaster site three-dimensional mapping system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The system comprises a control unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a multispectral sensor for carrying out omnibearing scanning on a disaster site, collecting earth surface deformation data and multiband reflectivity data, carrying out time sequence alignment and noise filtering on the collected data, constructing an initial three-dimensional point cloud through dynamic voxelization processing, merging inertial measurement unit data to correct space positions, identifying earth surface fracture zone edge and elevation mutation characteristics from the point cloud, dividing geological stability subareas by combining the reflectivity data, carrying out multilevel detail division on the stability subareas by adopting a self-adaptive octree segmentation algorithm, automatically adjusting grid resolution according to fracture zone density to generate a three-dimensional topological structure of the disaster site, calculating earth surface displacement vectors and sedimentation gradients through comparing historic and current three-dimensional data, marking potential secondary disaster risk areas, and realizing accurate evaluation and risk early warning of the disaster site.

title_en: Firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection system. The system includes a main control circuit board based on an STM32 single chip microcomputer, a GPRS data transmission module based on Sim-900, a GPS positioning module, a remote monitoring client and an inertial navigation module I and an inertial navigation module II; the main control circuit board is respectively connected with the GPRS data transmission module, the GPS positioning module and the inertial navigation module I and the inertial navigation module II through serial ports; and the GPRS data transmission module is connected and communicates with the bound remote monitoring client through adopting a GPRS network. The firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection system of the utility model can realize firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection, can accurately identify and judge movement states of firefighters, and at the same time, can realize firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning; according to application occasions of the firefighters, the system can extend sensors such as a toxic gas sensor, a smoke sensor and a temperature sensor; and the system is of great significance in the protection of life safety of the firefighters who work in complex fire environments.

title_en: Multifunctional fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and discloses a multifunctional fire fighting robot, which mainly comprises four parts, namely a self-walking chassis 1, an upper loader 2, an autonomous control system 3 and a data acquisition and transmission system 4; the robot is provided with various sensors such as a laser radar, a tracking camera and various toxic gas detectors, can be remotely controlled in a non-line-of-sight manner, has the functions of autonomous path planning driving, tracking driving and the like, and is a third-generation intelligent fire-extinguishing rescue robot in the true sense. The robot can replace fire rescue personnel to enter dangerous disaster accident sites such as inflammable, explosive, toxic, anoxic or dense smoke and the like for detection, fire extinguishing and rescue, and the problem of personal safety threat of the fire fighters in the sites is solved; meanwhile, the robot has extremely strong off-road surface driving capacity, can overcome surface obstacles such as curbs, abrupt slopes, trenches and the like through various field road surfaces such as grasslands, sand lands, shoals, broken stones and the like, and is used for detection, fire extinguishment and rescue under field conditions.
assignees: MINGGUANG HAOMIAO SECURITY AND PROTECTION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of autonomous heuristic approach in interior based on caterpillar robot
abstract_en: The autonomous heuristic approach in interior that the invention discloses a kind of based on caterpillar robot, includes the following steps: step 1, using caterpillar robot as mobile robot platform, is expanded；Step 2 optimizes laser beam dot matrix with the map obtained, estimates laser point in the expression of map and the probability of occupancy grid；Scan matching is solved the problems, such as with Gaussian-Newton method, obtains the rigid body translation (x, y, theta) that laser point set is mapped to existing map；Step 3 is built Tu Bao and is combined using hector_navigation navigation packet and hector_slam, to realize the indoor specific frame independently explored；Inertial measurement system IMU is added in state estimation in navigation, and is filtered using EKF；The present invention can be easier, be more convenient that control robot is gone to carry out indoor autonomous exploration, the grating map of indoor environment be obtained, to more effectively rescue personnel be helped to search and rescue the wounded.

title_en: ROS-based modular unmanned ship/unmanned vehicle system with intelligent auxiliary counterweight
abstract_en: The modular unmanned ship/unmanned vehicle system based on intelligent auxiliary counterweight of ROS comprises a ship body/vehicle body, wherein a foundation module and an expansion module are installed in the ship body/vehicle body, the foundation module and the expansion module both comprise universal modules, each universal module comprises an embedded ROS system, a battery, a wireless electric energy conversion circuit and a wireless charging coil interface, the foundation module is provided with a plurality of wireless charging coil interfaces, the wireless charging coil interface of the expansion module is in butt joint with the wireless charging coil interface on the foundation module to realize charging and communication with the foundation module, the expansion module is one or a plurality of combinations of camera modules, 4G network modules, radar modules, inertial modules, vertical propulsion modules, horizontal propulsion modules, docking modules, water quality detection modules, water surface garbage cleaning modules, sonar imaging modules, search and rescue modules, magnetic sensor modules, high-speed calculation modules, interference modules and Mecanum wheel modules, and the ship body is provided with an intelligent counterweight module for counterweight or weight reduction and balance.

title_en: Dual-source IR-UWB radar for searching and rescuing non-natural human body target after disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of post-disaster search and rescue, and particularly relates to a dual-source IR-UWB radar for searching and rescuing a human body target in an unnatural state after a disaster, which comprises a radar host, an antenna array and an upper computer; the radar host comprises a stepping control module, a sequential logic control module, a data acquisition module, a DSP data processing module, a power supply module, an indicator light and an operation button; the antenna array comprises a Tx1 antenna, a Tx2 antenna, an Rx1 antenna and an Rx2 antenna; the upper computer is a notebook computer and a tablet personal computer, the structure is reasonable, the defect that a single-source IR-UWB radar cannot have a lower central frequency and a larger bandwidth at the same time is overcome, the target is detected by using two antennas with low central frequencies of 270MHz and 400MHz, the equivalent bandwidth of the radar is expanded, and the system has good ruins penetration capacity and strong weak signal detection capacity.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of heart rate, stroke volume and ejection fraction
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a trans-mitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.p

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning, and particularly discloses a unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation, which is characterized in that an activation signal is forwarded through unmanned aerial vehicle group cooperation relay, a coverage radius range is improved by combining a spread spectrum technology, a terrain shielding blind area is eliminated, a joint positioning algorithm of azimuth angles and change rates thereof is provided, satellite signals are not required to be relied on, meter-level positioning is realized in a non-line-of-sight environment, the beacon device adopts an intermittent wake-up mechanism, the standby current is reduced to below 10 mu A, the endurance time is prolonged to 30 days, the long-period search and rescue requirement is met, and the problems of the traditional search and rescue system in terms of coverage area, safety, precision and cost are systematically solved.

title_en: Method and system for constructing and optimizing environment map based on ultra wideband UWB
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing and optimizing an environment map based on ultra wideband UWB, which are applicable to extreme environments. First, the system initializes a two-dimensional grid map and collects signal data through the UWB device. When determining the LOS path, the corresponding mesh is defined as "free" state, otherwise marked as "occupied". For NLOS features, the obstacle positions are mapped onto a map. And then, refining the map through an average filter, a morphological filter and a region growing algorithm, and improving the accuracy of obstacle representation. Finally, the optimized map information is utilized, and the weight of a positioning algorithm is adjusted through a Weighted Least Squares (WLS) method, so that the positioning accuracy is improved. The invention has the advantages that the invention can effectively construct the environment obstacle information, is suitable for navigation after refinement treatment, and can normally construct the map in dark light and smoke environment. The system relies solely on UWB sensors to achieve accurate positioning in obstructed environments.

title_en: Disaster monitoring system of steep slope land by using DRON and operating method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 경사지 재난 감시 시스템 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slope disaster monitoring system using a drone and an operating method thereof. The slope disaster monitoring system comprises: a ground pile unit; a central control center server; a manager control terminal; and a disaster monitoring drone. According to the present invention, it is possible to accurately predict the possibility of a landslide or collapse of a slope.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산사태 등이 발생할 수 있는 급격한 경사지에 위치정보를 확인할 수 있는 소자를 다수 살포하고 가시광선과 열화상이 포함된 현장의 3차원 위치데이터와 이미지를 촬영하여 데이터베이스로 기록 관리하고 주기적으로 해당 현장을 감시하므로 경사지에서 발생할 수 있는 재난을 사전에 예방하거나 피해 규모를 예상하고 확인하는 드론을 이용한 경사지 재난 감시 시스템 및 그 운용방법에 관한 것으로 지상의 경사지에 해당하는 특정 지역에 고정 설치되며 해당 위치 설명 정보를 입력받아 기록 저장하고 지피에스 좌표정보와 엘비에스 좌표정보를 각각 수신하여 갱신 기록 저장하며 해당 제어신호 수신에 의하여 기록 저장된 정보를 지반데이터 패킷 프레임으로 변환하여 와이파이 통신방식과 블루투스 통신방식과 CDMA 이동통신 방식으로 각각 송신하고 하나 이상 다수로 이루어지는 지상말뚝부; 지상말뚝부와 스마트통신망을 경유하여 와이파이 통신방식과 블루투스 통신방식과 CDMA 이동통신 방식과 유선랜 통신방식 중 선택된 어느 하나 또는 선택된 어느 하나 이상으로 접속하고 지반데이터 패킷 프레임으로 변환된 정보를 수신하여 할당된 영역에 저장 관리하며 분석 처리된 상황정보를 출력하는 중앙관제센터서버; 중앙관제센터서버에 접속하여 상기 상황정보를 수신하고 해당 비행조정제어신호를 출력하는 관리자조정단말; 관리자조정단말의 해당 비행조정제어신호에 의하여 비행하고 지피에스 좌표정보와 엘비에스 좌표정보와 관성항법 좌표정보를 각각 검출하며 선택적 산술평균연산된 좌표정보를 이용하여 비행자세를 제어하고 지정된 위치의 상공에서 지정된 지상을 자외선과 적외선과 가시광선으로 각각 스테레오 촬영하고 촬영시의 해당 자세 정보에 연계시켜 할당된 영역에 기록 저장하며 지반데이터 패킷 프레임으로 변환하여 자체 구비된 다수 통신수단 중 2 가지 이상의 통신수단으로 상기 관리자조정단말과 중앙관제센터서버에 송신하는 재난감시드론을 포함하는 특징에 의하여 수풀이 울창한 산간지역의 지반의 상태를 신속하고 정밀하게 측정 관찰하여 산사태 또는 경사지의 붕괴 가능성을 정확하게 예측하고, 발생된 재난 현장을 정확하게 분석하여 필요한 후속조치가 신속하게 진행되도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and method for tracking location of rescue worker in disaster building
title_ko: 재난건물 내에서 구조대원의 위치추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is a system for tracking a position of a rescue member in a disaster building, which comprises: a position detector outputting blinking light having a light blinking frequency which is distinguishable toward at least one light transmitting window present in the disaster building, and detecting a light arrival point position corresponding to an arrival point in the disaster building of the blinking light; a member terminal carried by a rescue member and photographing a ray image formed at the position of the ray arrival point in the disaster building by the blinking ray, and transmitting the photographed ray image; and a position tracking server using the arrival point position of the ray for the blinking ray received from the position detector and a light blinking frequency calculated from the received ray image, and determining an indoor position of the rescue member carrying the member terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난건물 내에서 구조대원의 위치추적시스템은 재난 건물에 존재하는 적어도 하나 이상의 광선 투과 윈도우를 향해 구분 가능한 광 점멸 주파수를 갖는 점멸 광선을 출력하고, 상기 점멸 광선의 상기 재난 건물 내의 도달 지점에 대응하는 광선 도달점 위치를 검출하는 위치 검출기; 구조대원에 의해 휴대되며, 상기 점멸 광선에 의해 상기 재난 건물 내의 상기 광선 도달점 위치에 형성된 광선 이미지를 촬영하고, 촬영된 광선 이미지를 전송하는 대원 단말기; 및 상기 위치 검출기로부터 수신된 상기 점멸 광선에 대한 상기 광선 도달점 위치 및 상기 대원 단말기로부터 수신된 상기 광선 이미지로부터 산출된 광 점멸 주파수를 이용하여, 상기 대원 단말기를 휴대하는 상기 구조대원의 실내 위치를 결정하는 위치 추적 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency navigation and positioning system and method for fire disaster in building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency navigation positioning system and a method in a building, wherein the system comprises a handheld positioning device, fire emergency lamps, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor, each handheld positioning device is provided with a UWB positioning tag and a second UWB transceiver, each fire emergency lamp is provided with a power supply, a display screen and a processor, the first UWB transceiver and the intelligent sensor are arranged in each fire emergency lamp and are connected with the processor and the power supply, the first UWB transceiver is used for sending corresponding signals and positioning data of the processor when receiving UWB signals of the UWB positioning tag, and the processor is used for calculating and sending the positioning data and environment data of the handheld positioning device, judging the unblocked condition of a channel and controlling the display screen to indicate an escape route according to a judging result and the environment data. The invention can provide the fire fighter with the unblocked condition of the internal passage of the building and the distribution condition of trapped people, and improve the disaster relief efficiency.

title_en: A kind of emergency light and indoor positioning navigation system with positioning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to emergency light technical fields, specifically disclose a kind of emergency light with positioning function, wherein, lamp includes: lighting circuit, Bluetooth base. station, power module, microcontroller, speech control module and lamp cap control module, speech control module and lighting circuit are connect with power module, Bluetooth base. station is connect with power module and microcontroller respectively, power module with external power supply power supply for connecting, speech control module is connect with lamp cap control module, speech control module is also connect with microcontroller, lighting circuit is connect with lamp cap control module, Bluetooth base. station with communication of mobile terminal for connecting, microcontroller is used to control the work of Bluetooth base. station.The invention also discloses a kind of indoor positioning navigation system.The helpful trapped person's positioning of emergence lighting lamp with positioning function provided by the utility model, to improve the escape efficiency of trapped person.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE ZHIRUI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hearing protection with directional audio
abstract_en: Hearing protection including passive noise cancellation or reduction material can include UWB radios. The hearing protection may include a microphone for capturing the audio when the user is speaking. An UWB radio can be used to transmit the audio to other users with similar hearing protection. The UWB radio can also be used to determine a relative location of other users and 3D spatial audio encoding can be applied to the associated audio signals in order to make it appear that the audio signals are coming from the relative location of the other respective users. The hearing protection may be used in a wide range of environments, including for example for first responders. In such cases, the hearing protection may include active noise cancelling functionality for reducing a loudness of siren noises.

title_en: Emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters, which particularly relates to the technical field of wireless communication scheduling in firefighters, and comprises a communication scheduling module, a signal receiving module and terminal equipment, wherein the communication scheduling module is connected with the signal receiving module, and the signal receiving module is connected with the terminal equipment; the communication scheduling module is carried on the fire fighter body, and the terminal equipment is arranged on the ground. The communication scheduling module comprises a sensor and a radio indicator transmitting part which are arranged on the body of the firefighter, a wireless communication assembly connected with the radio indicator transmitting part and a power supply module. The wireless communication assembly is connected with the photo transmission module; the photo transmission module comprises a camera shooting assembly and a cooling and mist reducing assembly which are arranged on the body of the firefighter. The emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters provided by the invention realizes the aim of indoor positioning of firefighters in a wireless communication scheduling transmission mode.

title_en: Real-time, two dimensional (2-d) tracking of first responders with identification inside premises
abstract_en: A combination of active reader tags and ultra wideband (UWB) radar systems provide real-time monitoring of first responders, with identification of each team member using active tags, and detection of victims or other subjects using motion or breathing detection, in a field of operations such as a building affected by fire or hazardous material or search and rescue mission area. Initially, a cluster of miniaturized radars (sensors) act in a static mode of operation, gathering static radar information used to depict a constructed layout of the premises. The cluster of radars then operate in a dynamic mode that detects motion or breathing of multiple subjects inside the field of operations. With dual mode operation the system can read the active tags identification, and by triangulation, display the position of each first responder with its identification and positions of subjects on a composite image of the constructed layout.

title_en: Emergency management fire-fighting and disaster-relief search and rescue radar based on MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave
abstract_en: The utility model designs an MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave-based emergency management fire-fighting and disaster-relief search and rescue radar which comprises a product shell, a linear power supply module, an integrated transceiver module, a power amplifier module, a signal processing board, a display control unit, a calibration unit, a VGA unit, a rectifying circuit, a low-noise amplification unit and an FPGA interface module, wherein the linear power supply module is arranged in the product shell; the environment-friendly energy-saving wall body penetrating power, power area, external interference and other factors are taken into consideration, the MIMO array antenna with multiple inputs and multiple outputs is adopted, the requirements of ultra-wideband, impedance matching, light weight and low profile are met, receiving and transmitting leakage is controlled, and the dynamic range of a receiving channel is ensured; the array topological structure is optimized, and grating lobes on angles are avoided as much as possible while the requirement of detecting high resolution is met; the multi-airspace degree of freedom is adopted to ensure the fuzzy calculation of the target, reduce the change of propagation speed and direction deviation and inhibit a plurality of false targets caused by multipath effect.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: It is a kind of to be used for personnel and assets hunting system and the method in tourist attraction and goods yard
abstract_en: The present invention utilizes super low-power consumption and the overlength distance sleep awakening technology more than 1500 meters of distances, GPS module is integrated with one using the overlength distance intelligent electronic label of low duty ratio mode of operation, the intelligent GPS label as a low-power consumption.Here not only there is GPS labels intelligent electronic label to include indoor positioning, and the institute including multichannel cooperates is functional, but also with the distinctive outdoor pinpoint functions of GPS.GPS labels transmit the GPS position information oneself collected independent of networks such as mobile public network or WiFi, and the service life of its battery is up to 3-5.Its not only low cost, and easy to use.The personnel that can be widely used in various tourist attractions, recreation ground and city search positioning；The personal management of tourist party.Remote districts the personnel without the network coverage search and rescue, and is but also widely used for assets search positioning of container etc. in major port and goods yard etc..
assignees: CHENGDU WEST VALLEY DIGITAL TECH INC

title_en: Mine rescue search system and mine rescue search method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine rescue search system and method, which belong to the field of mine safety technology and emergency rescue communication, and comprise a plurality of search instruments and a plurality of beacons, wherein the search instruments are positioned under a mine and are in communication connection through an ultra wideband UWB module, each search instrument is in communication connection with the plurality of beacons and is used for receiving signals of the plurality of beacons and transmitting the received beacon signals to other search instruments, and the plurality of search instruments position the beacons according to the received signals of the same beacon. The invention adopts the TNP protocol to calculate and compensate the propagation delay of the aerial signal, distributes the time interval for communicating with the same beacon for the searcher and at least two searchers nearest to the searcher, can lead the beacon signal of trapped personnel to be shared to the searchers, realizes data sharing, and can form rescue team under the mine to rescue, thereby avoiding the problem that rescue cannot be carried out when mine disaster occurs.

title_en: Dual-communication intelligent fire-fighting equipment with high-precision indoor positioning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses double-communication intelligent fire-fighting equipment with a high-precision indoor positioning function, which belongs to the field of intelligent distress systems. The system has the functions of accurate positioning and high-efficiency communication, combines ATGM H positioning modules and UWB positioning technologies, provides accurate indoor and outdoor positioning capability, and ensures that firefighters can be positioned in real time and accurately no matter in indoor, underground or outdoor environments. In particular to indoor positioning, primary position calculation is realized through PDOA and DS-TWR algorithms, and then a self-adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm with memory attenuation is adopted as a post-processing link to realize indoor centimeter-level high-precision positioning.

title_en: System for communicating location of survivors in mine emergencies
abstract_en: The disclosed system uses seismic signaling to locate survivors in a mine collapse. A separate transmitter with a specific pre-selected frequency or frequencies is placed in pre-positioned safety zones of a mine. The system generates frequency-locked, unmodulated seismic energy, which allows rescuers to identify the safety zone where a transmitter is activated. The transmitter comprises an oscillator that generates the signal. The oscillator drives the transducer. The transducer causes the inertial mass to move. The movement of the inertial mass generates the seismic waves, which are conducted through the pressure plate to the earth. The seismic signal is detected then amplified, filtered, converted and then processed. The use of a continuous signal enables the processing unit to identify the frequency of the signal with a very low error rate, using frequency content identification. The disclosure also describes a method for transmitting seismic waves through the earth using the above described system.
assignees: SQUIRE JAMES C;SULLIVAN GERALD A;FLATHERS III GEORGE W

title_en: Method for realizing indoor positioning by utilizing fire-fighting evacuation strobe light and smoke detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing indoor positioning by utilizing a fire-fighting evacuation strobe light and a smoke detector. The method comprises the steps of obtaining positioning identification information by taking the fire-fighting evacuation strobe light or the smoke detector as a positioning base point through intelligent positioning equipment communicating with the positioning base point, and locally processing the positioning information or sending the positioning information through a network to conduct remote processing. According to the method, a great amount of fire-fighting evacuation strobe lights and smoke detectors installed or necessarily installed are used, a communication module (such as a zigbee module) with a GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) positioning function is additionally arranged in the equipment, thus not only being used for the communication control of the fire-fighting evacuation strobe lights and the smoke detectors, but also realizing the low-cost distribution of the indoor positioning base points. The method is of a positioning method which is low in cost, wide in coverage and capable of fast distributing the positioning base points.
assignees: XINJIANG ENOWIT INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent reflecting surface-assisted ultra-wideband indoor positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent reflection surface-assisted ultra-wideband indoor positioning method, which relates to the technical field of communication facilities, wherein an intelligent reflection surface receives ultra-wideband pulse signals, selects different beam forming schemes, dynamically generates and applies optimal phase configuration parameters to reflection units, user equipment receives ultra-wideband signals from a direct path and a path reflected by the intelligent reflection surface, calculates distance information, performs comprehensive position calculation by combining an arrival time difference or an arrival angle algorithm, estimates three-dimensional coordinates of the user equipment, updates the phase configuration parameters, constructs a closed-loop feedback optimization loop, and iteratively executes until final three-dimensional position coordinates of the user equipment are calculated. The invention also provides an ultra-wideband indoor positioning device, which comprises an ultra-wideband base station, user equipment and an intelligent reflecting surface, wherein the intelligent reflecting surface is provided with a passive reflecting unit for independently regulating and controlling the phase. The invention is suitable for complex indoor and outdoor environments and meets the high-precision positioning requirements of urban traffic, personnel guidance, disaster sites, logistics and the like.

title_en: Novel hand-held indoor positioner, positioning system thereof, and positioning method of positioning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel hand-held indoor positioner, a positioning system thereof, and a positioning method of the positioning system. The positioner comprises a system operation control module, and a sensor group module, a two-dimensional code scanning module, a display module and a data storage module which are connected with the system operation control module; the positioning system comprises the hand-held indoor positioner and two-dimensional codes pasted at the entrance of a room and key points; and the positioning method allows current position information to be obtained by calculating according to sensor data sent from sensor groups, data room two-dimensional code data sent from the two-dimensional code scanning module and room landform data in the data storage module and to be displayed through the display module. The positioner, the positioning system and the positioning method have a reasonable design, realizes the indoor positioning function through the sensor data and the two-dimensional code information by effectively combining a plurality of sensor groups, the two-dimensional code scanning module and the two-dimensional codes in the room, has the characteristics of high positioning precision, high anti-interference capability, use convenience, low cost and the like, and can be widely used in the exhibition field, the firefighting field and the like.
assignees: TIANJIN GUOXIN HAOTIAN 3D SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Indoor positioning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an indoor positioning method and system, wherein the indoor positioning method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional coordinate map according to the installation positions of a plurality of detection devices in a building; controlling each detection device to detect the trapped person and acquiring detection data; and determining the position of the trapped person according to the detection data and the position coordinates of each detection device in the three-dimensional coordinate map. Through the application, the problem that the position of the trapped person cannot be quickly positioned in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent fire-fighting helmet for sensing explosion accident and predicting risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing an intelligent fire-fighting helmet for sensing explosion accidents and predicting risks, which comprises a fire-fighting helmet, a remote combustible gas detector, a thermal imaging camera module, a head-mounted near-to-eye display module, a positioning instrument, a data communication transmission module, an embedded core board, an earphone, a base station and a fire-fighting command center. According to the invention, a firefighter positioning technology is combined with a building information model and live-action thermal image information, and information projection and display are carried out through the head-mounted near-to-eye display module, so that the real-time position of the firefighter in a building can be displayed for the firefighter, and the environment explosion risk and the risk thereof can be predicted in real time. When a firefighter enters an unknown environment place, the potential fire explosion accident risk can be rapidly and effectively predicted, and the rapid perception and information communication of the firefighter on the fire accident scene can be realized through an advanced video and thermal imaging technology and an indoor positioning and communication transmission technology, so that the fire fighting rescue science level and capability of the firefighter are improved.

title_en: Indoor positioning method and positioning device based on WIFI and laser radar and robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an indoor positioning method, a positioning device, an unmanned robot, a server, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on WIFI and laser radar, wherein the indoor positioning method based on the WIFI and the laser radar comprises the following steps: constructing a WIFI fingerprint database; constructing a laser 2D map; simultaneously performing indoor WIFI positioning and laser AMCL positioning; and selecting a WIFI positioning result to replace the AMCL for repositioning according to the effectiveness of the AMCL positioning result until the positioning result is output. According to the embodiment of the invention, by adding the WIFI indoor positioning method, when the robot runs in an indoor environment, the result of the WIFI positioning is adopted to replace the result of the laser positioning trapped in the local optimum, so that the result of the laser positioning is changed, the repositioning is completed on the basis, the accurate position of the laser positioning is found, the robot is helped to find the position of the robot under the mismatch condition, and the application requirement of an actual scene is better met.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ELITE AUTOPILOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography
abstract_en: The application discloses a post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography, comprising the following steps: ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, robot cluster and cluster control and tomography system. The ultra-wideband wireless sensor network is divided into a stationary ultra-wideband node and a mobile ultra-wideband node, wherein the stationary node is used for assisting in positioning of the mobile node, and all the nodes are used for radio tomography; the robot clusters are used for bearing the mobile ultra-wideband nodes, each robot is provided with two nodes, and is provided with an independent power supply, a two-dimensional laser radar and a communication module, so that the robot can walk under complex road conditions, and the application range is wide; the cluster control and tomography system is in wireless interconnection with the robot clusters and is used for controlling the moving track of the robot, performing tomography on the environment according to the direct path signal receiving intensity signals acquired in the ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, and realizing victim detection in invisible areas (dense smoke, collapse environments and the like).

title_en: Three-dimensional visual indoor positioning system for fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional visual indoor positioning system for fire rescue, which relates to the technical field of positioning and comprises a positioning label, a positioning module and a positioning module, wherein the positioning label is used for sending communication information to the outside, and the communication information comprises sending time; the positioning module comprises at least three positioning units, and the positioning units are used for receiving the communication information sent by the positioning tag and sending the receiving time and the sending time to the server; and the server is used for receiving the receiving time and the sending time sent by the positioning unit and determining the position information of the positioning label on the three-dimensional model according to the receiving time, the sending time, the communication speed, the positioning unit position and the preset three-dimensional model. The invention solves the problem of low positioning accuracy of the existing indoor positioning system and realizes the accurate positioning of firefighters indoors.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIUBANG FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Handheld stand-alone search and rescue method and system based on inertial navigation and UWB
abstract_en: The application discloses a handheld single machine search and rescue method and system based on inertial navigation and UWB. The method comprises the following steps: determining initial gesture information of the handheld stand-alone device, wherein the gesture comprises initial position information and initial speed information; calculating initial distance information between the handheld single machine equipment and the personnel to be searched and rescued; the handheld single machine equipment is moved for multiple times, and updated posture information of the handheld single machine equipment and updated distance information between the handheld single machine equipment and the personnel to be searched and rescuing after each movement are calculated; and determining the position information of the personnel to be searched and rescuing according to the initial posture information, the initial distance information, the updated posture information and the updated distance information. According to the application, the inertial navigation system is introduced, so that the more accurate positioning of the personnel to be searched and rescued can be finished only through the single-machine search and rescue equipment, the active participation of the personnel to be searched and rescued is not needed, and the pressure and misjudgment of the personnel to be searched and rescued are reduced. In an environment where more complex ranging is continuously abnormal and jumping, the interference of the abnormal ranging on a positioning result can be eliminated based on the historical ranging by using a factor graph algorithm. Better positioning effect can be obtained in complex environment.

title_en: Life entity double station cooperative detection method based on single channel ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life entity double station cooperative detection method based on single channel ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR, pass through echo-signal in the radar receiving area of two different locations, form two two-dimentional echo-signal matrixes, motion filtering is carried out respectively to two matrixes, two matrixes are subjected to cross-correlation calculation along slow time dimension after the operation such as low-pass filtering, cross correlation matrix number is formed, calculates specific location and the imaging of target at a distance from two radars using target in cross-correlation matrix.This method can either realize effective detection to multiple and different strong and weak life entity targets, the range information relative to two radars of each life entity target can be disposably extracted again, the location information of life entity target can be resolved without pairing processing, it can be effectively reduced false-alarm and false dismissal probability under multi-target condition, the accuracy and robustness for improving human body target detection can satisfy the needs of the plural faint vital signs detection of name trapped person under the occasions such as disaster assistance.

title_en: Self-networking positioning system based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ad hoc network positioning system based on UWB, which comprises a long-distance Bluetooth gateway or a UWB base station, 1 or a plurality of fixed-point tags, 1 or a plurality of nearby tags and a server. The invention adopts a mechanism combining UWB and Bluetooth, and coordinates the master-slave relation M and the fixed point relation A of the label while reducing the power consumption, and confirms the self-positioning condition F; meanwhile, the ranging result is uploaded through Bluetooth, so that the ranging result can be conveniently received by a Bluetooth gateway or other intelligent equipment such as a tablet, a mobile phone and the like with Bluetooth, and the position information is further analyzed and displayed on a map; and self positioning and navigation can be realized. The firefighter carrying the tag can acquire the position information of the member carrying the tag at any time through the industrial tablet, and can support teammates through navigation or arrange personnel nearby for support. Because the data is directly transmitted from the tag to the tablet personal computer or the smart phone, the data does not need to be forwarded through a cloud platform or a server and the like, and the time delay of the position data is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Communication method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and related equipment. The method includes a first responder receiving a first frame from an initiator for initiating a ranging procedure, the first responder generating a first private address based on the first frame and information related to an identity of the first responder, the first responder transmitting a second frame carrying the first private address to the initiator. The method can be applied to an ultra wideband multi-millisecond ranging system. In accordance with the present application, the initiator may verify whether the frame is indeed from an authorized responder in an ultra wideband multi-millisecond ranging session.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Radar sensor-based bio-inspired autonomous mobile robot using ble location tracking for disaster rescue
abstract_en: An autonomous bio-inspired mobile robotic device (100) capable of detecting, tracking and communicating location of survivors trapped under earthquake/building collapse debris. The small-size, lightweight, ruggedized autonomous legged mobile robot incorporates high-frequency millimeter-wave radar sensor and Ultra Wideband (IR-UWB) radar sensor for detecting presence and perform ranging of trapped survivors. The autonomous mobile robot also comprises GNSS and BLE connectivity for location tracking of trapped survivors in conjunction with a Wi-Fi enabled visual sensing solution and a flashlight to aid during rescue operation. The battery-powered autonomous bio-inspired mobile robot (100) also comprises an MCU, actuators, motor control circuitry and IMU to control robot locomotion and perform sensor data fusion. BLE connectivity solution of the present invention communicates the location of detected trapped survivors to a plurality of rescue devices which use BLE Angle-of-Arrival method for successful survivor location resolution.

title_en: Method and device for cluster configuration and round allocation for uwb communication
abstract_en: An operation method of an electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: identifying two-way ranging (TWR) values for multiple anchors; configuring a first cluster including a first initiator anchor and first responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; configuring a second cluster including a second initiator anchor and second responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; and allocating a ranging round to each of the first cluster and the second cluster.

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography, comprising the following steps: ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, robot cluster and cluster control and tomography system. The ultra-wideband wireless sensor network is divided into a stationary ultra-wideband node and a mobile ultra-wideband node, the stationary node is used for assisting in positioning of the mobile node, all nodes are used for radio tomography, a robot cluster is used for bearing the mobile ultra-wideband node, each robot is provided with two nodes and is provided with an independent power supply, a two-dimensional laser radar and a communication module, the robot can walk under complex road conditions, the application range is wide, the cluster control and tomography system is in wireless interconnection with the robot cluster and is used for controlling the moving track of the robot, and the environment is subjected to tomography according to direct path signal receiving intensity signals collected in the ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, so that victim detection on invisible areas (dense smoke, collapsed environments and the like) is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle peak cruising path planning method, storage medium and device based on goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle mountain peak cruising path planning method based on a goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm, which solves the defects of low search precision, slow convergence speed, easy local optimization, poor optimizing stability and the like of the goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm, and provides a goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm (CWSSA) based on chaotic mapping and self-adaptive inertial weight.
