In order to enable the population to be uniformly distributed in a search space, enhance the diversity of the population, initialize the population by adopting a Tent chaotic map, select a logic chaotic map to update the position of a leader, avoid the leader from being trapped in local optimum and leading to insufficient global search, update the position of a follower by a self-adaptive weight strategy, improve the global search and local development capacity of an algorithm, introduce Gauss variation at a food source position, enable the algorithm to quickly jump out of the local optimum and improve the global search precision.
assignees: CSSC CHONGQING HYDRAULIC MECH ELECTRONICAL CO LTD

title_en: Handheld instrument suitable for accurate positioning of coal mine personnel and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handheld instrument suitable for accurately positioning coal mine personnel, which comprises a shell, a power supply, a voltage conversion circuit, a UWB radio frequency chip, a power amplifier, a UWB signal receiving and transmitting antenna, a microcontroller, a Bluetooth communication module, a Bluetooth signal receiving and transmitting antenna and a touch display screen. The invention provides three working modes to meet the search and rescue requirements under different situations, and the accurate positioning of the tag/base station is realized by effectively combining the three working modes, thereby being beneficial to search and rescue personnel under a mine; meanwhile, parameter configuration, operation management and firmware updating are carried out on the tags/base stations by combining the Bluetooth communication module, so that the positioning accuracy of other tags can be improved and the tag power consumption can be reduced by reasonably setting the working mode of each tag in the search and rescue process besides the convenience of daily management.

title_en: Real-time managing evacuation of a building
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 00, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building, triggered by alarm notification(S202). Based on determined (S214) precise real-time positions of personal ultra-wide band, UWB,devices, as determined by UWB real-time localization system, RTLS, a controller determines (S210) evacuation plans being personal UWB device specific in real-time. Based on individual evacuation plans and input from building facilities, real- time guidance information is defined (S208) and sent to each personal UWB device, providing guidance to person carrying said personal UWB device, in what direction to move (S212), to reach a safe area. Based on localization signals the UWB RTLSA then calculates updated positions of the personal UWB devices and sends to the evacuation management system. It is an advantage that trapped or injured people can be found, even in low visibility areas.

title_en: Indoor positioning and tracking system
abstract_en: Systems, methods, and apparatus are disclosed for tracking at least one of an object, a vehicle, and a person in a field by determining a distance between a first node and a remote node. In some embodiments, a method is provided for tracking an emergency responder in an emergency scene by determining distances between nodes located on the emergency responder and allowing the relative position of the emergency responder to be mapped.

title_en: Distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system and method, which relate to the field of intelligent weapon control and comprise the following steps: the upper end of the ship body is provided with a ship cabin; the photoelectric tracking reconnaissance device comprises a photoelectric detection head and a photoelectric control cabinet, wherein the photoelectric detection head is fixedly arranged at the top of the ship cabin, and the photoelectric control cabinet is arranged in the ship cabin; the inertial navigation device is arranged below the photoelectric detection head; the remote control weapon station comprises a weapon platform and a wall hanging box, wherein the weapon platform is fixedly arranged on the front side of the upper end of the warship body, and the wall hanging box is arranged in the warship cabin. The invention has the advantages that: the photoelectric, navigation and remote control weapon equipment on the unmanned ship are optimally integrated to form a distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system, so that the warning patrol, intelligence reconnaissance, offshore accurate striking, search and rescue and other tasks of a designated area, as well as the mine exploration/mine discharge, anti-frog personnel and other special combat tasks can be effectively completed.

title_en: Indoor positioning system for fire alarm system
abstract_en: A building management system tracks occupants of a building in which the building management system is installed and presents information about the occupants, including location information, to first responders during emergency and/or training events. Distributed devices of the building management system receive identification information broadcast by user devices of the occupants and sends the identification information to a control panel of the building management system. Location information for the occupants is generated based on the identification information received from the user devices and stored along with time and date information. This location information is then retrieved and presented to first responders, for example, by displaying a map of the building with icons representing the distributed devices and occupants, based on the location information.

title_en: A kind of emergency light and indoor positioning navigation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to indoor navigation technical fields, specifically disclose a kind of emergency light, wherein, emergency light includes: emergency light lamps and lanterns, power module, battery, Wi-Fi module, speech control module, lamp cap control module and buzzer, speech control module, Wi-Fi module and battery are connect with power module, emergency light lamps and lanterns are connect with battery and power module respectively, buzzer is connected with battery, speech control module is connect with lamp cap control module, and emergency light lamps and lanterns are connect with lamp cap control module；Speech control module can control the rotation of lamp cap control module, and power module can to charge the battery, and battery can provide power supply supply when power module powers off for buzzer and emergency light lamps and lanterns, and Wi-Fi module with mobile terminal for connecting.The invention also discloses a kind of indoor positioning navigation system.The function of the helpful trapped person's indoor positioning of emergency luminaire provided by the utility model, to solve the escape efficiency of trapped person.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE ZHIRUI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of automatically switching navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle capable of automatically switching a navigation system, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a laser SLAM system for realizing navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a visual SLAM system for assisting navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a controller, wherein when the controller detects that the error between the pose obtained by a laser inertial odometer in the laser SLAM system and a reference true value is greater than a switching setting threshold value, the laser SLAM system is switched to the visual SLAM system for navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention can still make a movement decision in a complex environment when encountering severe weather such as heavy rain, dense smoke or dense fog, and the like, so that the accuracy and stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle are improved, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to use, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Indoor positioning system for fire alarm system
abstract_en: A building management system tracks occupants of a building in which the building management system is installed and presents information about the occupants, including location information, to first responders during emergency and/or training events. Distributed devices of the building management system receive identification information broadcast by user devices of the occupants and sends the identification information to a control panel of the building management system. Location information for the occupants is generated based on the identification information received from the user devices and stored along with time and date information. This location information is then retrieved and presented to first responders, for example, by displaying a map of the building with icons representing the distributed devices and occupants, based on the location information.

title_en: Terricole track monitor terminal and working method based on NB-IOT
abstract_en: The invention discloses terricole track monitor terminals and working method based on NB-IOT, belong to the motion profile locating and tracking technical field of the terricole based on Internet of Things.Monitor terminal includes control processing module, GPS/ Beidou module, INS inertial navigation module, barometric leveling module, smoke sensor device, Temperature Humidity Sensor, NB-IOT communication module and antenna and backstage host computer, GPS/ Beidou module, INS inertial navigation module, barometric leveling module, smoke sensor device module, temperature humidity sensor module, NB-IOT communication module and antenna are connect with control processing module, and are monitored by monitor terminal to animal.The present invention is communicated using NB-IOT wireless technology, realize the transmission of low-power consumption, the location information of long range and environmental information, the technical advantage for thering are other locating and tracking technologies to hardly match, it is micro- to realize that intelligentized wild animal tracer technique has extremely profound significance.

title_en: Instant location and map building survey search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of instant location and survey search and rescue robot with map building, to be applied to after calamity the fields such as tube map establishment, landform exploration, comprise obstacle detouring chassis, vehicle body platform, 3-D scanning module, main control unit, body shell and driver module form.Obstacle detouring chassis adopts the bionics suspension frame structure of six wheel drive, makes car body have passive adaptivity to different terrain.3-D scanning module includes 3-D scanning mechanism, scanning laser radar, infrared temperature sensor, inertial laser sensor and fixed support composition.This robot can in traveling process autonomous exploration surrounding environment, and create three-dimensional land map in real time, detect whether likely life entity simultaneously and exist; Real-time three-dimensional map, possibility life entity can be searched and rescued position feedback to operating personal; Operating personal is helped to understand field condition quickly and accurately, to launch salvage work as early as possible, the personal casualty that minimizing is surveyed and rescue worker is unnecessary simultaneously and labor loss.

title_en: Method for positioning and monitoring in limited space based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a limited space positioning monitoring method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring first position information of personnel in a limited space in real time through a UWB limited space positioning technology, acquiring point cloud data in the limited space in real time through a laser radar positioning device, constructing an indoor map in the limited space through the point cloud data, supplying power to a system through a solar cell panel and a storage battery, acquiring environment information data in the limited space in real time through a singlechip module, a smoke sensing acquisition circuit module, a temperature sensing acquisition circuit module and a gas sensing acquisition circuit module, uploading real-time information of each sensing acquisition module circuit to a PC, a mobile phone and a cloud, and transmitting the data information to the mobile phone in real time through a short message module. The invention can monitor the environmental information data and the personnel position in the limited space on the premise of saving energy, thereby improving the disaster rescue efficiency.

title_en: Disaster site self-adaptive emergency investigation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster site self-adaptive emergency investigation device which comprises an antenna assembly, a main control board, a battery, an egg-shaped shell and a camera arranged on the shell, wherein the main control board is connected with the antenna assembly; the bottom of the shell is provided with a counterweight part for centering, so that the shell forms a tumbler structure; the antenna assembly, the main control board and the battery are respectively arranged in the shell; the main control board is provided with a UWB positioning module, and the battery, the antenna assembly and the camera are respectively electrically connected with the main control board. The disaster site self-adaptive emergency investigation device has a simple and novel structure; the shell is arranged into a tumbler structure, so that the shell can be kept upright after being thrown into a disaster site, and the camera has a good shooting visual angle; the antenna assembly can transmit pictures shot by the camera to a command center outside a disaster site, and help rescue workers to remotely survey the site condition; the UWB positioning module can help determine the position of a UWB positioning card on the rescue personnel, and the rescue personnel are prevented from getting lost.
assignees: SHENZHEN TIANYOU SATELLITE APPLICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hearing protection with directional audio
abstract_en: Hearing protection (102) including passive noise cancellation or reduction material can include ultrawideband radios (110). The hearing protection may include a microphone (112a, 112b) for capturing the audio (106) when the user (104) is speaking. An ultrawideband radio (110) can be used to transmit the audio (106) to other users (104) with similar hearing protection (102). The ultrawideband radio (110) can also be used to determine a relative location of other users (104) and 3D spatial audio encoding can be applied to the associated audio signals in order to make it appear that the audio signals are coming from the relative location of the other respective users (104). The hearing protection (102) may be used in a wide range of environments, including for example for first responders. In such cases, the hearing protection (102) may include active noise cancelling functionality for reducing a loudness of siren noises.

title_en: LTE and PDR-based fire-fighting indoor positioning and track navigating method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an LTE and PDR-based fire-fighting indoor positioning and track navigating method and system. The system comprises an intelligent terminal, an LTE small base station and a positioning server, wherein the intelligent terminal is terminal equipment supporting LTE, a camera, a nine-axis sensor and an air-pressure sensor; fire-fighting positioning service APP is installed on the intelligent terminal equipment, is an operator of a positioning algorithm, and is used for collecting information of the LTE RSS, camera, nine-axis sensor and air-pressure sensor, calculating the position of a firefighter according to the information, and returning the positioning result to the server; the LTE small base station is a small cell of a mobile communication system for covering indoor signals, and is used for providing data service link and assistant positioning to a smart mobile phone in the positioning system. The method and system have the beneficial effects that a communication and positioning environment can be quickly constructed by utilizing the LTE small base station and the intelligent terminal, the field arrangement system is convenient, and the implementation of the system can be greatly increased.

title_en: Victim rescue support system and information processing method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a victim rescue support system which can be utilized without a limit of area or place, and also rapidly and efficiently locate victims' positions.SOLUTION: A plurality of portable base stations are installed at a disaster stricken area. Each of the portable base station generates position parameter information composed of a tag ID and a parameter for position estimation by communicating with an RFID tag carried by a victim via UWB-IR, and transmits the position parameter information to a positioning server. The positioning server estimates and stores a position of each RFID tag 100 on the basis of the position parameter information transmitted from the portable base station.

title_en: Emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters, which particularly relates to the technical field of wireless communication scheduling in firefighters, and comprises a communication scheduling module, a signal receiving module and terminal equipment, wherein the communication scheduling module is connected with the signal receiving module, and the signal receiving module is connected with the terminal equipment; the communication scheduling module is carried on the fire fighter body, and the terminal equipment is arranged on the ground. The communication scheduling module comprises a sensor and a radio indicator transmitting part which are arranged on the body of the firefighter, a wireless communication assembly connected with the radio indicator transmitting part and a power supply module. The wireless communication assembly is connected with the photo transmission module; the photo transmission module comprises a camera shooting assembly and a cooling and mist reducing assembly which are arranged on the body of the firefighter. The emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters provided by the invention realizes the aim of indoor positioning of firefighters in a wireless communication scheduling transmission mode.
assignees: JINAN WUZHILIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;XIAMEN ATTIOT INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene vision construction system and working method
abstract_en: A fire scene vision construction system and a working method belong to the technical field of fire robots. The system comprises an environment-aware robot and a matched AR fire-fighting helmet, wherein the robot comprises a crawler device, a chassis cabin and a main cabin; the chassis cabin is fixedly provided with a protective shell, an electric motor, a power supply and a motion control board, and the main cabin is provided with the protective shell, a 4D millimeter wave radar sensor, a UWB sensor and a miniature main board. The AR fire helmet comprises a power supply, a UWB sensor, a miniature main board and an AR display. According to the invention, a cross-mode millimeter wave radar signal semantic segmentation algorithm, a high-precision rapid graph building and man-machine cooperative motion control algorithm of UWB are operated on a miniature main board in a main body cabin, and segmentation results are processed by the miniature main board in the helmet and then displayed by an AR display. The system can effectively avoid the short plates of the camera and the laser radar which fail in the dense smoke environment; the calculation power consumption of point cloud calculation is avoided, the drawing precision is improved, and the problem of motion control of the robot is solved.

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmitting image of scene of fire, and hand-held thermal imager for firefighting
abstract_en: Provided are a method and apparatus for transmitting an image of the scene of a fire, and a hand-held thermal imager for firefighting. The method comprises: acquiring position information about a fire-fighter by means of an inertial navigation system, and generating a visible spectrum image and a thermal imaging far-infrared spectrum image of the scene of a fire; according to the thermal imaging far-infrared spectrum image and the visible spectrum image, performing superposition to generate a scene image of the scene of the fire corresponding to the position information; and transmitting the position information and the scene image to a background command centre by means of a mobile network. By implementing the embodiments of the present application, position information about a fire-fighter and a scene image corresponding to the position information can be transmitted to a background command centre in a timely manner, so that the background command centre develops a reasonable rescue plan for the situation at the scene of a fire.

title_en: Method and system for locating and monitoring first responders
abstract_en: The invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention provides for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station.
assignees: FUNK BENJAMIN E;BANDYOPADHYAY AMRIT;KOHN ERIC A;GOLDSMAN NEIL;TEOLIS CAROLE A;BLANKENSHIP GILMER L

title_en: Accurate positioning method and system for firefighter in full-task scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for accurately positioning firefighters in a full-task scene, which comprises the following steps: intelligent fire hydrant system module: referencing a positioning beacon, monitoring the health state, detecting the fire and predicting the situation, and guiding the alarm and the task; the movable intelligent reference positioning system module comprises: the method comprises the steps of referencing a positioning beacon, autonomously positioning to acquire information through an IMU (inertial measurement unit), and resolving reference positioning; wearable individual positioning system: the positioning tag is referenced, the accurate position is calculated by receiving signals, information is obtained by self-positioning, task guidance is carried out, and physiological information is monitored; fire control task control commander terminal system module: positioning monitoring personnel, monitoring and predicting fire situation, optimizing and commanding tasks, monitoring equipment state, displaying and controlling; a central processing server module: monitoring information, optimizing tasks and guidance, resolving and positioning, and managing a database. The invention provides a method for accurately positioning fire fighters and guiding tasks in a full task stage.

title_en: Integrated control system for emergency disaster response and method for providing service thereof
title_ko: 긴급 재난 대응을 위한 통합 관제 시스템 및 그의 서비스 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control system for emergency disaster response and a service method thereof. The integrated control system of the present invention provides real-time information on the movement status of dispatched vehicles to a caller from the time of the emergency disaster report, thereby providing a reassuring service to the caller, analyzes multiple composite signals of the caller and firefighters to measure and identify their indoor locations at the disaster scene, secures the floor-by-floor layout of the building at the scene to accurately determine the locations of the caller and the dispatched firefighters, and provides a response service that responds to emergency disasters by sharing real-time information on hospital beds and situational information according to the transport situation among the fire situation room, police station, emergency medical institution, public health center, and disaster medical support team in relation to the transport of emergency patients, thereby securing an appropriate time for transport and controlling, monitoring, and supporting all information from dispatch to conclusion in the comprehensive situation room with the dispatched firefighters. The present invention enables rapid response and rescue from relevant agencies within the full council, thereby securing the golden time for emergency disaster incidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 긴급 재난 대응을 위한 통합 관제 시스템 및 그의 서비스 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 통합 관제 시스템은 긴급 재난 발생에 따른 신고 시점에서부터 신고자에게 출동 차량의 이동 상황을 실시간 전달하여 신고자에게 안심 서비스를 제공하고, 신고자와 소방대원의 다중 복합 신호를 분석하여 재난 현장에서의 실내 위치를 측정 및 파악하고, 현장의 건물에 대한 층별 평면 위치를 확보하여 신고자와 출동 소방대원의 정확한 위치를 파악하며, 응급 환자 이송에 따른 소방 상황실, 경찰서, 응급의료 기관, 보건소 및 재난 의료 지원팀들 간에 병상 정보와 이송 상황에 따른 상황 정보를 실시간 공유하여 이송 적정 시간을 확보하여 출동 소방대원들과 종합 상황실에서 출동에서 종결까지 모든 정보를 관제, 모니터링 및 지원하여 긴급 재난 대응에 대처하는 대응 서비스를 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 전원 협의체의 관련 기관들로부터 신속한 대응 및 구조가 가능하도록 하여 긴급 재난 사고에 대한 골든타임을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for locating and monitoring first responders
abstract_en: The invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention provides for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station.
assignees: FUNK BENJAMIN E;BANDYOPADHYAY AMRIT;KOHN ERIC A;GOLDSMAN NEIL;TEOLIS CAROLE A;BLANKESHIP GILMER L;TRX SYSTEMS INC

title_en: Internet of things sign-in card and fire fighting propaganda loading method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an internet of things sign-in card and a fire fighting propaganda loading method. The characteristic lies in that the sign-in card adopts a passive two-dimensional code, NFC (near field communication) and UHF (ultra high frequency) based RFID (radio frequency identification) as internet of things sign-in carriers. The characteristic also lies in that an application method of the sign-in card comprises the step of setting an intelligent mobile phone, an App (application program), a corresponding network, a server and an intelligent device used for reading a fire fighting propaganda RFID carrier. The advantage of loading the RFID sign-in carrier of the sign-in card is that fire fighting guidance is realized through indoor positioning in special fire scenes of power failure, network disconnection, indoor and outdoor communication shielding, smoke billowing and complete dark. The advantage of loading the two-dimensional code and the NFC sign-in carrier of the sign-in card is that fire fighting propaganda is implied to commercial sign-in through sign-in services of the sign-in card at ordinary times. Therefore, purposes of the invention are achieved efficiently with a low cost.

title_en: Fire detection system for predicting fire situation and checking occupancy through supervised learning
title_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire detection system capable of predicting fire situations and confirming occupancy status through supervised learning. The fire detection method according to an embodiment comprises the steps of: obtaining data for fire detection by the fire detection system; applying the obtained data to a recurrent neural network (RNN) model; determining the occurrence of a fire based on the RNN model; and determining occupancy detection based on an ultra-wideband (UWB) sensor. By utilizing machine learning with data from various sensors such as temperature, humidity, and smoke detectors, the system can assess and predict fire risk in advance and improve accuracy through re-learning of the prediction model. Additionally, the UWB radar sensor enables detection of human presence and location at the fire site, thereby minimizing human casualties during fire incidents.
abstract_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 화재감지 방법은, 화재감지 시스템이, 화재 감지를 위한 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, 획득된 데이터를 RNN(Recurrent Neural Network) 모델에 적용하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, RNN 모델을 기반으로 화재 발생 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 화재감지 시스템이, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 센서를 기반으로 재실감지 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 각 센서(온/습도, 연기감지)로부터 데이터를 이용한 기계학습을 통해 화재감지의 위험도를 사전에 판단하고 예측할 수 있으며, 예측 모델의 재학습을 통해 정확도를 개선할 수 있다. 또한, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 레이더 센서를 통하여 화재 발생 장소에 인체가 존재하는지를 판단하고, 위치를 확인할 수 있어, 화재 발생 시 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Novel large -scale naval vessels under -deck personnel positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel large -scale naval vessels under -deck personnel positioning system, sign, refer to label, ultra wide band location receiver, ultra wide band location processing ware and surveillance center's server including ultra wide band (UWB) personel locator beacon. Provide another kind of novel large -scale naval vessels under -deck personnel positioning system simultaneously, signed the mounting groove, referred to label mounting groove, ultra wide band location receiver mounting groove, ultra wide band location processing ware mounting groove and surveillance center's server mounting groove including integrated ultra wide band personel locator beacon. The utility model discloses based on the ultra wide band location finding technique, solved the problem of the inside personnel location in large -scale naval vessels cabin, for large -scale naval vessel is taking place under the condition such as accident, under -deck personnel's location, search and rescue, medical science rescue etc. Provide technical foundation and support.

title_en: Fire emergency device based on UWB positioning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire emergency devices and discloses a fire emergency device based on UWB positioning, which comprises a wear plate positioning device and positioning auxiliary devices, wherein the wear plate positioning device and the positioning auxiliary devices are internally provided with the UWB positioning device, the wear plate positioning device and a signal center wirelessly transmit signals, the wear plate positioning device is worn on a rescuer, the number of the positioning auxiliary devices is multiple, and the multiple positioning auxiliary devices are arranged in the building in a pre-distributed manner. This fire control emergency device based on UWB location is through seting up at the back of removing positioning device and wearing the slot, can effectually fix the position such as waistband, the safety rope at personnel with removing positioning device through wearing the slot, when carrying out the scene of a fire rescue, can avoid the high strength motion and lead to the problem that equipment drops, and use battery locking piece to fix spacing to the lithium cell, make the lithium cell make things convenient for the dismouting to change and the installation is firm, reached the effect that equipment convenient to carry is difficult for droing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHENENG TAIZHOU NO 2 POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HANGZHOU PUFENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor personnel positioning method and system based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of indoor positioning, in particular to an indoor personnel positioning method and system based on multi-mode sensing, the ultra-wideband channel impulse response, millimeter wave radar data and thermal imaging data of each layer are acquired, double-base geometric mapping is carried out by combining building information, an indoor ray path is reconstructed, and an occupied grid diagram is generated. Further collecting the water mist distribution intensity generated by the spraying equipment, carrying out phase correction and beam domain purification on millimeter wave data, and carrying out flow direction filtering and flicker suppression on thermal imaging data to obtain preprocessing data. On the basis, motion prior information and boundary constraint information are extracted, fusion is realized in the occupied grid diagram through mass conservation updating and normalization synthesis, and finally the position information and the motion orientation of the object to be positioned are output. The application can maintain the positioning stability and accuracy under the interference of fire smoke, water mist and multipath effect, and is suitable for high-risk scenes such as fire rescue and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG TAIGUANG ELECTRONIC GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Heading angle-assisted Kalman information direction finding correction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a heading angle-assisted Kalman information direction finding correction method, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a heading angle of a search and rescue aircraft through an airborne inertial unit of the search and rescue aircraft, measuring a gangway angle of a search and rescue target relative to the search and rescue aircraft through an airborne search and rescue radio station, combining the heading angle information of the search and rescue aircraft with a radio direction finding, calculating an azimuth angle of the search and rescue target, taking the azimuth angle of the search and rescue target as a state value, establishing a Kalman filtering recursive formula, constructing Kalman information, carrying out first correction on a direction finding result, and carrying out second correction on the heading angle, so that the radio direction finding wild value is effectively corrected, and the accuracy and reliability of aviation search and rescue radio direction finding are greatly improved.

title_en: A kind of Internet of Things intelligent fire self-rescue apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Internet of Things intelligent fire self-rescue apparatus, including Protective clothes combined with cap and mask (1), self-help apparatus (2) and intelligent positioner (3), it is characterized in that the filter device (2) is arranged in parallel using multiple filtration film, equipped with two filter layers and activated carbon adsorption device, form closed filter, filter and Protective clothes combined with cap and mask are all made of new material, it is lightweight and convenient, meet Human Engineering Principle, survivor is set to avoid wearing discomfort because of respirator during escape, the problem of Smoke Filter is delayed escape time not in time, the intelligent positioner uses NFC indoor positioning technologies, it is automatically positioned indicator of trapped personnel position, and it be furnished with light source emitter and loudspeaking alarm, allow fire fighter more rapidly and accurately find indicator of trapped personnel specific location.

title_en: Fire Command System utilizing Real-Time status and Indoor Position Tracking Information
title_ko: 소방대원의 실시간 상태 확인 및 실내 위치 트래킹 정보를 활용한 소방 지휘 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting command system utilizing a real-time status and indoor position tracking information of a firefighter. More specifically, disclosed is a firefighting command system which sets a location coordinate using a beacon to obtain the indoor location information of a firefighter using an acceleration, geomagnetic field, and barometric pressure sensors and obtains a more accurate location using a pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) method. In addition, the firefighting command system displays the location information on the screen of a mobile terminal to identify a movement path through a tracking system and measure, in real time, the status of the firefighter and information on the field by attaching a shock detection sensor and a temperature and humidity sensor to a firefighting suit and attaching a heart rate sensor attached to a fire fighting glove, thereby transmitting the status and information to the mobile terminal by using a long range (LoRa) communication module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방대원의 실시간 상태 확인 및 실내 위치 트래킹 정보를 활용한 소방 지휘 시스템에 관한 것으로서 더욱 상세하게는 비콘을 활용하여 위치 좌표를 설정한 뒤 가속도, 지자계, 기압 센서를 이용하여 소방대원의 실내 위치 정보를 확보하고 PDR(Pedestrian Dead Reckoning) 방식을 이용하여 보다 정확한 위치를 파악 할 수 있으며, 이러한 위치 정보를 모바일 단말기의 화면에 출력하여 트래킹 시스템을 도입해 이동 경로 파악과 충격 감지 센서, 온습도 센서를 화재 진압복에 부착하고 심박 센서를 소방 장갑에 부착하여 현장 정보와 소방대원의 상태를 실시간으로 측정해 LoRa(Long Range) 통신 모듈을 활용하여 모바일 단말기로 전송하는 소방 지휘 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Rescuer indoor cooperated positioning device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescuer indoor cooperated positioning device and a method. A system comprises at least three inertial navigation positioning devices, a plurality of single chip microcomputers, a plurality of ZigBee wireless sensor network nodes, a plurality of GPRS modules, and a remote server. The inertial navigation positioning devices are separately disposed on at least three rescuers. All the rescuers are provided with one of the single chip microcomputers, one of the ZigBee wireless sensor network nodes and one of the GPRS modules. The inertial navigation positioning devices are carried by some of the rescuers, thus achieving indoor positioning. A real-time positioning network is formed through a ZigBee wireless sensor network, and position data is provided for other rescuers not carrying the inertial navigation positioning devices in a rescuing site. When a rescuer can verify the position of himself or herself, the position information can be corrected and the precision of a dynamic positioning network can be corrected. A headquarter can know the positions and distribution of the rescuers on the site in real time, and the rescuers can known the position information of themselves and their teammates, thus increasing the disaster rescuing efficiency so as to guarantee human safety.

title_en: CPR assist device
title_ko: 심폐소생술 보조장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) assistance device. The device may comprise: a plurality of antennas for receiving signals, which are transmitted from an IR-UWB radar and changed according to chest compression of an object; a control unit for determining a chest compression depth, a number of chest compressions per minute, and a degree of chest relaxation of a CPR operation performed by a rescuer through analysis of the signals received from the plurality of antennas; and an output unit for outputting the chest compression depth, the number of chest compressions per minute, and the degree of chest relaxation of the CPR operation of the rescuer determined by the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 심폐소생술 보조장치에 관한 것이다. 본 장치는 IR-UWB 레이더로부터 송신된 신호가 객체의 흉부 압박에 따라 변화되는 신호를 수신하는 복수개의 안테나, 복수개의 안테나로부터 수신된 신호를 분석을 통해 구조자가 시행하는 심폐소생술 동작의 흉부 압박 깊이, 분당 흉부 압박 횟수, 흉부 이완의 정도를 판단하는 제어부 및 제어부로부터 판단된 구조자의 심폐소생술 동작의 흉부 압박 깊이, 분당 흉부 압박 횟수, 흉부 이완의 정도를 출력하는 출력부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multiple access techniques in ultra-wideband (uwb) positioning
abstract_en: Disclosed are techniques for wireless communication. In an aspect, an initiator anchor node transmits, to a first responder anchor node, first configuration information for a first ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the first responder anchor node, wherein the first configuration information indicates a first initiation time for the first ranging session, and transmits, to a second responder anchor node, second configuration information for a second ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the second responder anchor node, wherein the second configuration information indicates a second initiation time for the second ranging session, wherein the first and second ranging sessions are configured to enable a mobile device to obtain a first time-difference of arrival (TDOA) measurement and a second TDOA measurement for the first responder anchor node and the second responder anchor node, respectively, and wherein the second initiation time is offset from the first initiation time.

title_en: Indoor positioning smoke sensor emitting smoke through Bluetooth
abstract_en: The invention belongs to an indoor positioning smoke sensor emitting smoke by Bluetooth, which is characterized in that a geographic information superimposer and a Bluetooth emitter are additionally arranged on the existing smoke sensor. The device automatically overlaps two-dimensional and three-dimensional geographic position information (room number, building position, road section name and region name) of a smoke sensor, when an alarm condition occurs, a mobile phone owner in the site touches a mobile phone emergency rescue button, the mobile phone receives the geographic position information of the owner sent by a Bluetooth transmitter embedded in the device in real time and uploads the specific geographic information to a duty police mobile terminal, a district dispatching place and a superior command center in real time, and a duty department can reach a first site for issuing a case in real time according to the uploaded alarm condition position and a doorplate number after receiving the alarm, so that the purpose of integrating the alarm condition command and alarm handling action is achieved; the invention can also upload the alarm condition and the video monitored by the embedded camera of the device to the district dispatching place and the superior command center in real time through the operation of the on-site mobile phone according to the requirement.

title_en: Automatic determination of defibrillation pad location on patient's chest
abstract_en: A medical device uses UWB units to infer a position of an adjunct positioned in proximity to an exterior portion of a patient's body. The position information can be used to provide CPR feedback to a rescuer. In other applications, the position information can be used to provide prompts to a user to change the position of the adjunct.

title_en: Automatic determination of defibrillation pad location on patient's chest
abstract_en: A medical device uses UWB units to infer a position of an adjunct positioned in proximity to an exterior portion of a patient's body. The position information can be used to provide CPR feedback to a rescuer. In other applications, the position information can be used to provide prompts to a user to change the position of the adjunct.

title_en: Multiple access techniques in ultra-wideband (uwb) positioning
abstract_en: Disclosed are techniques for wireless communication. In an aspect, an initiator anchor node transmits, to a first responder anchor node, first configuration information for a first ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the first responder anchor node, wherein the first configuration information indicates a first initiation time for the first ranging session, and transmits, to a second responder anchor node, second configuration information for a second ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the second responder anchor node, wherein the second configuration information indicates a second initiation time for the second ranging session, wherein the first and second ranging sessions are configured to enable a mobile device to obtain a first time-difference of arrival (TDOA) measurement and a second TDOA measurement for the first responder anchor node and the second responder anchor node, respectively, and wherein the second initiation time is offset from the first initiation time.

title_en: Firefighter gait and posture detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting gait and posture of a fireman, which comprises the following steps: every time the firefighter takes one step, the corresponding basic state parameters are obtained through the measurement of the sensor; deriving the basic state parameters to obtain extended state parameters; judging the movement gait or posture of the firefighter according to the basic state parameters and the extended state parameters of the firefighter and by combining a state judgment criterion; and transmitting the determined movement gait or posture data of the firefighter back to the command terminal. The invention embeds an inertia processing layer, which analyzes the inertia data (speed, position, attitude angle) to judge the action state of the personnel, analyzes the action of the fire fighter and classifies the action into: normal walking, running, stillness, creeping forward, free falling, going upstairs, going downstairs and the like; the method monitors the nature of the firefighter's movements and attitude and posture in real time only through foot-mounted inertial sensors and provides flexible early warning in situations where the firefighter may be unconscious and unable to communicate.
assignees: BEIJING SPACEFLIGHT CONTROL INSTRUMENT RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Robot capable of automatically searching personnel underground coal mine and rescue method
abstract_en: The application relates to a robot capable of automatically searching personnel in a coal mine and a rescue method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps that the robot collects environment information of an underground accident site, and the environment information comprises high-frequency IMU data, laser radar point clouds and camera images; and determining the current position of the robot according to the high-frequency IMU data, the laser radar point cloud, the motor encoder pulse data and the camera image. The application realizes high-precision positioning by utilizing the laser radar, the inertial measurement unit and the camera, performs detection such as personnel search and gas analysis on unknown areas, can assist trapped personnel to quickly evacuate through the personnel carrying cabin after the trapped personnel are searched, and can send the position of the trapped personnel to off-site searching and rescuing personnel in a state that the trapped personnel are disabled to assist the rescuing personnel to enter an accident site for rescuing wounded personnel. The application not only can greatly improve the safety and efficiency of rescue, but also can provide powerful technical support for emergency disposal of coal mine safety accidents, and becomes an important tool for guaranteeing the life safety of miners.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Target detection method and device based on inertial measurement unit and ultra-wideband radar coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a target detection method and device based on inertial measurement unit and ultra-wideband radar coupling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a reference speed calculated by an inertial measurement unit; receiving a radar echo signal returned by an indoor environment; based on the reference speed, carrying out weak target enhancement processing on the radar echo signal by adopting a preset adaptive algorithm to obtain a target radar echo signal; and detecting the target in the indoor environment according to the target radar echo signal to obtain a target detection result. According to the method, the reference speed calculated by the inertial measurement unit is utilized to assist in carrying out weak target enhancement processing on the radar echo signal, so that the performance of detecting the weak target under the influence of multipath interference and clutter of the radar in a mobile measurement mode can be effectively improved, high-precision target detection is realized, and firefighters and other rescue workers are assisted to rapidly and accurately detect trapped people under emergency conditions such as fire.

title_en: Human body target positioning method based on tensor decomposition singular spectrum analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body target positioning method based on a singular spectrum analysis method of tensor decomposition, which relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue human body positioning and comprises the following steps of S1, ultra Wideband (UWB) biological radar echo signal acquisition and preprocessing, S2, embedding a preprocessed one-dimensional time sequence into tensor, S3, tensor decomposition, S4, grouping reconstruction, S5 and Hankel matrixing. The method is more suitable for processing non-stationary signals, and in subspace selection and reconstruction, the tensor decomposition process is supervised by using an Ensemble Empirical Mode (EEMD), and the tensor decomposition replaces the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) process in the traditional Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA), so that the signals can be well processed, in addition, the EEMD plays a role in supervising the reconstruction process in the tensor decomposition, and the SNCR reduction caused by error estimation of respiratory signal frequency is avoided.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF NORTHERN THEATER COMMAND OF PLA

title_en: AI based dangerous situation detection system for mobile crane and work of ground work place yard using analyzing accident cause big data of mobile crane and work of ground work place yard
title_ko: 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 사고원인 분석 빅데이터를 이용한 ai기반 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 위험 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence (AI)-based dangerous situation detection system for a working ground and worker below a mobile crane using accident cause analysis big data of a working ground and worker below a mobile crane and, more specifically, to a system for detecting the risk of a working ground and worker below a mobile crane, which is operated by an AI system and an ultrawide band (UWB) VT sensor and PT sensor system to prevent accidents. According to the present invention, the system comprises: an AI system analyzing mobile crane types and features, mobile crane working environments, disaster cases by the type of disaster including fall, drop, overturning, straying, collapse, electric shock, and collision related to mobile crane works, causes of accidents including defects in lifting objects, booms, car bodies, boarding equipment, and hooks, classification of victims including crane operators, nearby workers, and managers, and causes of accidents including non-compliance with safety rules, defective line hanging works, defective crane equipment, overturning of cranes, defective boarding facilities, defective buckets, and inexperienced work to build big data for each mobile crane type/feature, each mobile crane working environment, each disaster case by disaster type, each accident cause, each victim classification, and each accident cause, and generating and mapping accident response scenarios corresponding to the big data for each classification; and a UWB VT sensor and PT sensor system attached to the mobile crane and a worker or an object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 사고원인 분석 빅데이터를 이용한 AI기반 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 위험 탐지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 이동식 크레인 종류 및 특징과, 이동식 크레인 작업환경과, 이동식 크레인 작업과 관련한 추락, 낙하, 전도, 협착, 도괴·붕괴, 감전 및 충돌을 포함하는 재해형태별 재해사례와, 인양물, 붐대, 차체, 탑승설비 및 후크 결함을 포함하는 사고유발원인과, 크레인 운전자, 인근 작업자, 관리자를 포함하는 피해자분류와, 안전수칙 미준수, 줄걸이 작업불량, 크레인 장비불량, 크레인 전도, 탑승설비 불량, 버켓불량 및 작업미숙을 포함하는 사고원인을 분석하여 상기 이동식 크레인 종류 및 특징, 이동식 크레인 작업환경, 재해형태별 재해사례, 사고유발원인, 피해자분류, 사고원인별로 분류별 빅데이터화하고, 상기 분류별 빅데이터에 상응하는 안전사고 대응시나리오를 작성 맵핑하여 구축한 인공지능시스템과; 이동식 크레인 및 작업자 또는 사물에 부착된 UWB VT 및 PT센서시스템;을 포함하여 구성되어 상기 인공지능시스템 및 UWB VT센서 및 PT센서 시스템에 의하여 작동되는 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자의 위험을 탐지하기 위한 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a transmitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: Method and apparatus for position estimation of first responders
title_ko: 긴급 구조원의 위치 결정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for measuring an indoor location of an emergency responder in an emergency communication system which can be rapidly deployed during disaster recovery. According to one embodiment, a method for determining a location of an emergency responder includes the steps of: estimating a distance between an anchor node and an emergency responder based on signals received from a plurality of anchor nodes; based on the distance, determining an optimal set of anchor nodes from the plurality of anchor nodes; and determining the location of the emergency responder based on the optimal set of anchor nodes. The anchor node includes at least one of still-alive access points (SAPs) and helper access points (HAPs).
abstract_ko: 재난 복구 시 신속 배치 가능한 응급 통신 시스템에서 긴급 구조원의 실내 위치 측정 방법이 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 긴급 구조원의 위치 결정 방법은 복수의 앵커 노드에서 수신되는 신호에 기초하여, 앵커 노드와 긴급 구조원 사이의 거리를 추정하는 단계, 거리에 기초하여, 복수의 앵커 노드 중에서 최적의 앵커 노드 집합을 결정하는 단계, 최적의 앵커 노드 집합에 기초하여, 긴급 구조원의 위치를 결정하는 단계를 포함하고, 앵커 노드는 스틸 얼라이브 액세스 포인트(still-alive access points ; SAPs) 및 헬퍼 액세스 포인트(helper access points ; HAPs) 중 적어도 하나를 포함한다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication positioning, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB. The method comprises the following steps: step 100, receiving a distress signal sent by a UWB transmitter carried by a distress person by using a UWB receiver carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle; 102, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly for three times from an initial position according to a preset flight rule; 104, collecting position coordinates of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle after each flight is finished; step 106, determining the position coordinates of the distress call and the distance from the initial position to the distress call based on the initial position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the position coordinates of the current position after each flight is finished; step 108, circularly executing the steps 102-106 until the distance from the initial position to the SOS person is smaller than the preset distance; and taking the position coordinate of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the first flight in each round of circulation process as the position coordinate of the initial position. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the field search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Inertial navigation indoor positioning system and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inertial navigation indoor positioning system and a use method thereof. The system comprises a positioning module and a receiving module, the positioning module mainly comprises a calculating and processing module, an emission module and a gyroscope, one side of the calculating and processing module in the positioning module is provided with an error calibration module, the gyroscope is communicated with the calculating and processing module and the error calibration module, the calculating and processing module is communicated with the emission module, and the emission module is wirelessly communicated with the receiving module. The system can realizes accurate positioning in firefighting or rescue and relief work places without arranging basic points in advance. Human body pace data is acquired by the gyroscope, is calculated and analyzed by the calculating and processing module, is received by the receiving module, and is introduced to a computer, the position information of personnel is monitored in real time, and the pace data undergoes error detection and error correction through the error calibration module to make position information transmitted to command personnel be accurate.

title_en: Coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The vertical cylindrical fuselage is adopted, the coaxial double propellers provide power, and the control of the aircraft is realized by changing the direction of the pulling force and the rotating speed difference of the double rotors. The invention can also adopt GNSS positioning equipment and vision positioning equipment to respectively combine with IMU to form an inertial satellite integrated navigation and vision-inertial navigation synchronous positioning and map building VI-SLAM navigation positioning system, and can realize autonomous flight in both open environment covered by GNSS and closed and GNSS-rejected environment. The aircraft has the attributes of universalization, informatization, autonomy, intellectualization and the like, has a simple structure, low cost, high efficiency ratio, firmness and durability and convenient carrying, can provide global situation information of 'no-go, no-touch and no-see' parts of streets, indoors, jungles and the like, and completes the tasks of detection or search and rescue of closed and sheltered spaces of cities, jungles, indoors and the like.
assignees: SHENYANG AIRCRAFT DESIGN INSTITUTE YANGZHOU COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Risk analysis early warning device, early warning method, safety risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses risk analysis early warning equipment, an early warning method, a safety risk assessment method and a system, wherein the risk analysis early warning equipment comprises a clothing body, a positioning component, a monitoring component, an alarm component, an analysis prediction component and a communication component, the positioning component comprises a main positioning module and a standby positioning module, the main positioning module comprises a UWB main positioning module and an RTK positioning module, and the standby positioning module comprises a UWB standby positioning module; the monitoring component comprises a physiological condition monitoring module and an environmental condition monitoring module; the analysis and prediction component comprises a main control module and a standby control module which are provided with risk analysis and prediction units for constructing a CNN-LSTM model; the communication assembly comprises a main communication module and a standby communication module; and meanwhile, when accidents such as roof collapse and the like occur, the position information, the physiological condition information and the internal environment information of the mining area of the operating personnel can be provided for the outside, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Emergency rescue comprehensive command device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue comprehensive command device, which belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue, and comprises a closed space, double emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment with double UWB (ultra wide band) tag modules and a UWB base station system; the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment comprises a motor, a wireless module, an obstacle avoidance device, an encoder, a double UWB (ultra Wide band) tag module, an IMU (inertial measurement Unit) inertial measurement unit, a temperature detection module, a gas concentration detection module and a smoke concentration detection module, wherein the motor, the wireless module, the obstacle avoidance device, the encoder, the double UWB tag module, the IMU inertial measurement unit, the temperature detection module, the gas concentration detection module and the smoke concentration detection module are respectively connected with a PID (proportion integration differentiation) controller; the method has the advantages that the UWB positioning is adopted to automatically set the path tour according to the user; when meeting an obstacle during driving, the vehicle can automatically stop; through the configuration of cell-phone APP: a. the movement speed and the movement track of the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment can be configured through the APP; b. the driving, stopping and remote control of the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment can be controlled through the APP; c. the running state of the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment can be monitored.
assignees: HUNAN VOCATIONAL INSTITUTE OF SAFETY TECH CHANGSHA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: System for communicating location of survivors in mine emergencies
abstract_en: The disclosed system uses seismic signaling to locate survivors in a mine collapse. A separate transmitter with a specific pre-selected frequency or frequencies is placed in pre-positioned safety zones of a mine. The system generates frequency-locked, unmodulated seismic energy, which allows rescuers to identify the safety zone where a transmitter is activated. The transmitter comprises an oscillator that generates the signal. The oscillator drives the transducer. The transducer causes the inertial mass to move. The movement of the inertial mass generates the seismic waves, which are conducted through the pressure plate to the earth. The seismic signal is detected then amplified, filtered, converted and then processed. The use of a continuous signal enables the processing unit to identify the frequency of the signal with a very low error rate, using frequency content identification. The disclosure also describes a method for transmitting seismic waves through the earth using the above described system.

title_en: Rescue worker Indoor Location Tracking System
title_ko: 구조대원 실내 위치 추적 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 구조대원 실내 위치 추적 시스템은, 복수의 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그의 무선신호를 수신하는 적어도 하나 이상의 앵커노드와, 구조대원의 몸에 부착되며 소정의 주기마다 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그를 자동투하시키는 태그 투하장치와, 상기 앵커노드로부터 수신된 상기 복수의 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그의 무선신호를 바탕으로 미리 설정된 위치측위방식을 이용하여 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그의 위치를 파악하는 위치 파악부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NATIONAL INST OF TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Management system based on UWB mine staff
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system based on UWB mine workers, comprising: a base station system; the tag system is used for receiving and transmitting data with the base station system and is arranged on a safety helmet of a worker; the upper computer transmits and receives data to and from the base station system; and the background monitoring alarm system is used for receiving the data signal sent by the upper computer. The system can know the specific position of each worker in real time through the upper computer of the system, and whether the worker enters a dangerous area, and timely remind workers entering an illegal area; the life safety of the worker can be better guaranteed, and if the worker encounters an emergency or danger, the worker can ask for help through a help calling button on the label system to be rescued in time; when an accident occurs in the mine, the trapped personnel can be accurately positioned, and accurate and effective rescue is implemented.

title_en: Fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning method and system based on national secret trusted communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning method, a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning system and a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning system based on national secret trusted communication, which relate to the technical field of indoor rescue personnel positioning and comprise the following steps that step 100, a hybrid positioning network is formed through a UWB positioning base station, a UWB positioning card and a visual positioning node; step 200, acquiring initial positions and motion tracks of trapped personnel, encrypting by adopting a national encryption algorithm, uploading to a command center digital twin platform, step 300, acquiring multi-source sensor data by a rescue personnel terminal, receiving UWB base station signals, generating real-time position information of the rescue personnel and sign information of the rescue personnel by combining a pre-stored indoor micro map, step 400, encrypting the real-time position information of the rescue personnel and the sign information of the rescue personnel by adopting the national encryption algorithm, selecting a communication frequency band by adopting a dynamic frequency spectrum allocation mechanism, transmitting to the command center digital twin platform, and step 500, fusing the real-time position of the rescue personnel and the information of the trapped personnel by the command center digital twin platform, generating a rescue obstacle avoidance path and transmitting to the rescue personnel terminal.
assignees: YUXI E GOVERNMENT INTRANET INFORMATION TECH CENTER

title_en: Indoor localization system in disaster relief and localization method thereof
title_ko: 재난 구조시의 실내 위치 표시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to aindoor localization system and method during disaster relief, which can carry out exact localization by recognizing an indoor position if existing communication facilities are interrupted, and an indoor environment is changed (damaged) in a disaster situation. The indoor localization system comprises: a disaster victim terminal as a fixed node; a plurality of rescuer terminals as a plurality of mobile nodes, which can communicate with the disaster victim terminal; a localization server which divides a lower region with respect to the indoor environment, determines a position of the disaster victim terminal with the highest accuracy among positions reported from all the rescuer terminals as the final position of the disaster victim terminal; a database which divides the inside of a building into a latticed target region by the localization server, divides the target region into a lower region in accordance with the number and type of walls between the region and each latticed point, and stores information with respect to the indoor environment realized by separately forming the gathering of reference points (RP) with respect to each latticed point. According to the present invention, therefore, costs of an off-line step may be reduced in comparison to a conventional fingerprint-based method.
abstract_ko: 재난 상황에서 기존의 통신 시설이 중단되고 실내 환경이 변경(손상)되는 경우 실내 위치를 파악하여 정확한 위치 표시(localization)를 실행할 수 있는 재난 구조시의 실내 위치 표시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 고정 노드로서 재난피해자 단말기, 다수의 이동 노드로서 상기 재난피해자 단말기와 통신 가능한 다수의 구조자 단말기, 상기 실내 환경에 대한 하부 영역을 분할하고, 상기 재난피해자 단말기의 최종 위치로서 모든 구조자 단말기들로부터 보고된 위치들 중에서 가장 높은 정확도를 갖는 재난피해자 단말기의 위치를 재난피해자 단말기의 최종 위치로 결정하는 위치 표시 서버, 상기 위치 표시 서버에 의해 건물 내를 격자로 표적 영역으로 분할하고, 영역과 각 격자점 사이의 벽의 개수와 종류에 따라 표적 영역을 하부 영역으로 분할하고, 각 격자점에 대해 별도로 참조 점(RP : Reference Points) 집합을 형성하여 이루어진 상기 실내 환경에 대한 정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 종래의 지문 기반 방법에 비해 오프라인 단계의 비용을 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system which comprises a UWB (Ultra-Wide Bandwidth) radar front end and a signal processing display unit. The system can realize real-time and non-contact monitoring on physiological parameters of a human body, such as respiration, body movement signals, respiratory rate, and the like under the condition of penetrating through a thicker nonmetal obstacle. The ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system is mainly used for the physiological parameter monitoring of patients which are not suitable for being connected with electrodes and a sensor in a ward, such as large-area burn patients, and the like, can be also used for carrying out non-contact real-time monitoring on buried wounded people (who can not be rescued in short time) in the disasters, such as earthquake, and the like and provides necessary reference for search and rescue staffs applying medical rescue to learn the vital sign condition of a rescued object at any time.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication positioning, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB. The method comprises the following steps: step 100, receiving a distress signal sent by a UWB transmitter carried by a distress person by using a UWB receiver carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle; 102, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly for three times from an initial position according to a preset flight rule; 104, collecting position coordinates of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle after each flight is finished; step 106, determining the position coordinates of the distress call and the distance from the initial position to the distress call based on the initial position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the position coordinates of the current position after each flight is finished; step 108, circularly executing the steps 102-106 until the distance from the initial position to the SOS person is smaller than the preset distance; and taking the position coordinate of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the first flight in each round of circulation process as the position coordinate of the initial position. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the field search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: SHENZHEN DACHENWEI TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mobile life detection method, system and device based on migration learning mechanism and UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile life detection method, a system and a device based on a migration learning mechanism and a UWB radar, which relate to the technical field of radar signal processing and emergency rescue, and have the technical key points that the mobile life detection method and the system construct a simulation-migration-real-time reasoning technical system, generate a large amount of diversified training data with labels through high-fidelity physical simulation, and pre-train a deep neural network model by utilizing the data; after the mobile platform enters a real disaster site, the invention adopts a transfer learning technology, and the pre-training model can be quickly fine-tuned by only collecting data of a very small amount of non-living areas on site or simply calibrating the data, so that the model is suitable for the current special environment. In this way, the invention can realize high-precision mobile life detection and provide powerful support for emergency rescue work.

title_en: Fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an escape garment arranged near a fire hydrant box of a fire safety key unit and a fire control room arranged on a fire rescue vehicle; the escape suit is provided with a low-power consumption wireless signal transmission module which communicates with the outside in a severe environment, and is implanted with a building escape route map, an indoor positioning system and a Q-learning reinforcement learning escape route planning algorithm; the fire control room is provided with an information receiving module and an escape path guiding algorithm based on real-time fire conditions and LSTM; once a fire condition occurs, when on-site personnel pick up the escape clothes and generate rapid movement, the line signal transmission module of the escape clothes automatically starts and guides personnel to evacuate and carries out real-time communication with the fire control room and the fire rescue vehicle, so that the combination of on-site self rescue and fire rescue personnel search and rescue is realized, the survival rate is effectively improved, and the degree of damage of the on-site personnel is reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning, and particularly discloses a unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation, which is characterized in that an activation signal is forwarded through unmanned aerial vehicle group cooperation relay, a coverage radius range is improved by combining a spread spectrum technology, a terrain shielding blind area is eliminated, a joint positioning algorithm of azimuth angles and change rates thereof is provided, satellite signals are not required to be relied on, meter-level positioning is realized in a non-line-of-sight environment, the beacon device adopts an intermittent wake-up mechanism, the standby current is reduced to below 10 mu A, the endurance time is prolonged to 30 days, the long-period search and rescue requirement is met, and the problems of the traditional search and rescue system in terms of coverage area, safety, precision and cost are systematically solved.

title_en: Method and System for Determining the Delay of Digital Signals
abstract_en: A method of and system for determining the time required for a digital bit or bit stream to traverse a round-trip path from a source transceiver to at least one destination transceiver and back is disclosed. The relative timing of the transmitted bit or bit stream is compared to the return bit or bit stream using a high speed comparison configuration so as to provide in substantially real-time various measurements related to or derived from the time required to traverse the round trip path, including distance measurement in indoor positioning, real-time locating, adaptive cruise control, intelligent transportation systems, robotics, collision avoidance, personnel accountability, emergency location, search and rescue, loss and theft prevention, logistics, marine safety, network analysis, communication channel characterization, and other high-speed measurement tasks. In addition, a method of and system for determining the distance between a source transceiver and a destination transceiver, and a method of and system for determining the angular position of a transceiver with respect to at least two other transceivers, are disclosed.

title_en: Based on human body target and the surrounding environment structure compatible detection method of UWB bioradar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of human body target based on UWB bioradar and surrounding environment structure compatible detection method, comprise the following steps: A pre-treatment step; B human body target detection steps; C-structure detection steps; Consider the hole formed under pressing the survivor be embedded in ruins to be mostly buried in ruins after the disasters such as earthquake occur, therefore there is certain space between survivor and ruins, and the medium in this space is air.Utilize this qualifications and human body target positional information, the detecting and identifying to hole upper and lower interface can be realized, to for obtaining in follow-up study more accurately, comprehensively ruins structural information explore, and the application and development of searching and rescuing bioradar technology for UWB provides new thinking.

title_en: Doorplate with umb and Beidou positioning functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a doorplate utilizing umb and Beidou positioning functions, which comprises a mounting plate, a doorplate main body, a fixing plate, a fixing component, a doorplate mark, a buzzer, a solar panel, a power supply module, a Beidou positioning module, a umb module, a UWB module, a control module, a two-dimensional code generation module, a switching module and a wireless transmission module, wherein the doorplate main body is fixed on one side of the mounting plate, the fixing plate is mounted on the other side of the mounting plate through the fixing component, and the doorplate mark is mounted on one side of the doorplate main body; the doorplate provided by the invention avoids the singleness of the traditional doorplate, is convenient for a user to use, the Beidou positioning module and the umb module are more accurately positioned, and are matched with the buzzer, so that the alarming positioning and disaster rescue are facilitated, the doorplate position is conveniently and accurately found, the search and rescue time is reduced, and the fixed assembly is arranged, so that the doorplate main body can be conveniently fixedly installed, detached and maintained, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Uwb communication-based fire control system using indoor embedded lighting
title_ko: 실내 매립형 조명을 이용한 uwb 통신 기반 소방 관제 시스템
