abstract_en: Disclosed is a UWB communication-based fire monitoring system using indoor embedded lighting, comprising: a firefighter UWB tag that is attached to a firefighter and performs UWB communication; a rescue requester UWB tag that is attached to a rescue requester and performs UWB communication; a fire status notification UWB tag that is attached to a designated area of a fire site and performs UWB communication; an indoor embedded UWB anchor that is embedded in an indoor space, emits light, and performs UWB communication with the firefighter UWB tag, the rescue requester UWB tag, and the fire status notification UWB tag; and a UWB integrated monitoring server that measures the UWB tag communication time of the indoor embedded UWB anchor with the rescue requester UWB tag, the firefighter UWB tag, and the fire status notification UWB tag in real-time and measures and monitors the respective positions of the firefighter UWB tag, the rescue requester UWB tag, and the fire status notification UWB tag in real-time based on the real-time measured UWB tag communication time.
abstract_ko: 실내 매립형 조명을 이용한 UWB 통신 기반 소방 관제 시스템이 개시된다.  소방관에 부착되어 UWB 통신을 수행하는 소방관 UWB 태그; 요구조자에 부착되어 UWB 통신을 수행하는 요구조자 UWB 태그; 화재 현장의 소정 공간에 부착되어 UWB 통신을 수행하는 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그; 실내 공간에 매립되어 조명을 방사하며, 상기 소방관 UWB 태그, 상기 요구조자 UWB 태그 및 상기 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커; 상기 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커의 상기 요구조자 UWB 태그, 상기 소방관 UWB 태그 및 상기 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그와의 UWB 태그 통신 시간을 실시간 측정하고, 실시간 측정된 UWB 태그 통신 시간에 의해 상기 소방관 UWB 태그, 상기 요구조자 UWB 태그 및 상기 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그의 각각의 위치를 실시간 측정하고 모니터링하는 UWB 통합 관제 서버를 구성한다.

title_en: Disaster control system
title_ko: 실내위치제공장치를 통한 재난방지 시스템
abstract_en: A beacon is installed on a train or a public stage and is managed to execute an operation or report the location. A security guard in the corresponding location is connected through the corresponding beacon. The beacon can always connect the responsible agent and the security guard in a short range in order to check a device when an accident occurs, transmit a warning or a message, and enable the security guard to execute a needed operation as a first responder. The present invention can also group the security guard and a special public officer in a short range and transmit a responding manual to the corresponding agent to enable the security guard to execute the needed operation as the first responder. The present invention can group the agents on the same floor or train or in adjacent locations to enable more organized response.
abstract_ko:
비컨은 열차, 공공장소 등에 설치되어 있으며 위치및 작동이 관리되고 있으며 해당 비컨을 통하여 해당 위치의 안전요원등이 연결되어 있는 상태로 되어 있거나 근거리에 있는 책임요원이나 안전요원을 언제나 연결할 수 있도록 하여 사고가 발새아였을대 장치를 확인하여 경고및 메세지를 전달하도록 하고 안전요원을 통하여는 필요한 초동조치를 할 수 있도록 한다.  
또한, 근거리에 있는 안전요원, 특수공무원등을 그룹핑 할 수 있으며 필요한 경우 대응메뉴얼을 해당 요원에게 전송하여 안전요원등이 당황하지 않고 초동조치를 행할 수 이쏟록 한다.  
특히 같은 층, 근처의 위치와 장소, 같은 열차 등에 있는 요원들이 그룹핑될 수 있어 보다 조직적인 대응이 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire detection system for predicting fire situation and checking occupancy through supervised learning
title_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템
abstract_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 화재감지 방법은, 화재감지 시스템이, 화재 감지를 위한 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, 획득된 데이터를 RNN(Recurrent Neural Network) 모델에 적용하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, RNN 모델을 기반으로 화재 발생 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 화재감지 시스템이, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 센서를 기반으로 재실감지 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 각 센서(온/습도, 연기감지)로부터 데이터를 이용한 기계학습을 통해 화재감지의 위험도를 사전에 판단하고 예측할 수 있으며, 예측 모델의 재학습을 통해 정확도를 개선할 수 있다. 또한, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 레이더 센서를 통하여 화재 발생 장소에 인체가 존재하는지를 판단하고, 위치를 확인할 수 있어, 화재 발생 시 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane, including earth station and unmanned plane two parts, the earth station includes control computer, model generates interface, control interface, the base station UWBLOC and data transmission module, the unmanned plane includes drone body, flight control system, signal transmission device, indoor positioning module, data processing module, gas detection module, camera, fire behavior acquisition module and life detection module, fire behavior size and spatial distribution and variation tendency are judged by setting fire behavior acquisition module, life detection module is set simultaneously and detects the life entity to live, gas-detecting device is set again to judge the concentration of pernicious gas, and these detection results are generated interface display in model to come out for fireman's reference, the present invention can carry out scene of fire effectively and comprehensive Information is collected, and is referred to for fireman, is helped fireman to formulate rescue strategies, is reduced the difficulty and risk of rescue.
assignees: GUANGDONG RONGQE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire fighting fire scene internal attack positioning method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire fighting fire scene internal attack positioning method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring sensor information from a data acquisition device; step two, importing a scene three-dimensional model; acquiring real-time data of an attack position in a fire scene; step four, carrying out real-time synchronous twinning in the fire scene attack process of the firemen; fifthly, carrying out online interaction by firemen; the fourth step specifically comprises the following steps; s1, establishing and researching a twin model; s2, indoor positioning research based on a PDR algorithm; s3, designing a digital twin physical layer; s4, visual monitoring research based on MQTT; the invention can solve the problem that the firefighter gets lost in the process of attack.

title_en: Method and system for constructing and optimizing environment map based on ultra wideband UWB
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing and optimizing an environment map based on ultra wideband UWB, which are applicable to extreme environments. First, the system initializes a two-dimensional grid map and collects signal data through the UWB device. When determining the LOS path, the corresponding mesh is defined as "free" state, otherwise marked as "occupied". For NLOS features, the obstacle positions are mapped onto a map. And then, refining the map through an average filter, a morphological filter and a region growing algorithm, and improving the accuracy of obstacle representation. Finally, the optimized map information is utilized, and the weight of a positioning algorithm is adjusted through a Weighted Least Squares (WLS) method, so that the positioning accuracy is improved. The invention has the advantages that the invention can effectively construct the environment obstacle information, is suitable for navigation after refinement treatment, and can normally construct the map in dark light and smoke environment. The system relies solely on UWB sensors to achieve accurate positioning in obstructed environments.

title_en: Indoor positioning and condition monitoring system for fire-fighting and rescue personnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indoor positioning and condition monitoring system for fire-fighting and rescue personnel, and belongs to the technical field of dead zone positioning. The system consists of an indoor positioning module, a condition monitoring module, an emergent rescue device, and a remote monitoring module, wherein the indoor positioning module, the condition monitoring module and the emergent rescue device are fixed in a terminal which is worn on a rear waist of an operator, so as to achieve the positioning and condition monitoring of the operator. Moreover, the position and condition of the operator are displayed through an upper computer. The surroundings of the operator are simulated by the upper computer, and a route is also drawn. The system provided by the utility model is high in positioning precision, is high in safety, is good in instantaneity, and greatly helps the indoor firefighting and rescue.

title_en: Self-configurable firefighter location and environment detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-configurable firefighter positioning and environment detecting method and system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, the equipment is in a sleep mode; step 2, the equipment is switched into a working state from a sleep mode; step 3, respectively calculating position data by the micro inertial navigation system and the satellite navigation system; step 4, the central processing unit acquires environmental data by using the sensing detection module; step 5, acquiring equipment information and firefighter identity identification information; step 6, the positioning equipment and the identity identification information of the firemen, the fusion positioning position data and the fire fighting site environment detection data are broadcasted and sent out through the wireless communication module; and 7, continuously and intelligently detecting and configuring the peripheral sensing detection module/equipment by the equipment in the working mode. The invention can realize non-inductive use, and firemen do not need to manually operate each device on a task site, thereby reducing the workload, and also do not need to carry out additional training on the firemen, thereby reducing the use cost and difficulty.
assignees: JIANGSU DEYIJIA SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Communication method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and related equipment. The method includes a first responder receiving a first frame from an initiator for initiating a ranging procedure, the first responder generating a first private address based on the first frame and information related to an identity of the first responder, the first responder transmitting a second frame carrying the first private address to the initiator. The method can be applied to an ultra wideband multi-millisecond ranging system. In accordance with the present application, the initiator may verify whether the frame is indeed from an authorized responder in an ultra wideband multi-millisecond ranging session.

title_en: Underwater acoustic signal detection method based on Redberg atomic radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic signal detection method based on a Redberg atomic radar, which utilizes a multi-frequency band microwave source to emit microwave signals to a water surface, each frequency band microwave signal senses fluctuation of the water surface and generates a reflection echo, utilizes a Redberg atomic antenna array to receive the reflection echo of each frequency band microwave signal once, inverts the water surface fluctuation signal according to a micro Doppler effect and fits an acoustic component through high-pass filtering. According to the invention, the performance of the traditional radar is upgraded by the capability advantage of the Redburg atoms in the aspects of high-sensitivity electromagnetic signal sensing, ultra-wideband multi-band parallel signal detection and the like, so that the traditional radar meets the micro-Doppler water surface fluctuation measurement requirement; meanwhile, in view of the fact that the working frequency of the underwater acoustic signal is larger than the fluctuation frequency of the water surface waves, high-frequency effective information can be extracted from low-frequency strong background noise by using a high-pass filter, and a brand-new and feasible underwater acoustic signal detection means with upgraded performance is provided for underwater exploration, hydrologic measurement, diving search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Autonomous navigation unmanned aerial vehicle integrating visual inertial navigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an autonomous navigation unmanned aerial vehicle integrating visual inertial navigation, wherein a frame is of a three-layer structure, and the bottom of the bottom layer of the frame is provided with a supporting part and a camera assembly; a plurality of wings are arranged outwards at the edges between the middle layer and the bottom layer of the rack, and a flight assembly and a function expansion assembly are arranged in cooperation with the wings; a control panel is arranged on the upper part of the bottom layer of the machine frame among the plurality of wings in a matching way; a power supply is arranged on the middle layer of the frame in a matching way; the top layer of the rack is provided with an upper computer in a matching way; the upper computer and the control panel are connected with a power supply, and the upper computer is matched with the control panel; the camera shooting assembly, the flying assembly and the function expansion assembly are arranged in a matched mode with the control panel. The utility model can independently position and navigate in complex unknown environment which can not be reached easily, provide reasonable and stable map building of surrounding environment, automatically patrol in high-difficulty search and rescue tasks of different occasions, carry out map reconnaissance and construction in unknown geographical areas, and realize autonomous navigation logistics transportation; overall structure is stable, and work efficiency is high, and operating condition is stable, the maintenance of being convenient for.

title_en: Multi-terminal collaborative forest crown lower landform mapping system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for establishing a map of a landform under a multi-terminal cooperative forest tree crown. The method comprises initializing correction time; the method comprises the following steps that a three-dimensional laser radar obtains three-dimensional point cloud data of a space environment around an unmanned vehicle, an inertial navigation system obtains inertial navigation positioning data of the unmanned vehicle, and a satellite navigation module obtains satellite navigation positioning data of the unmanned vehicle; fusing inertial navigation positioning data and satellite navigation positioning data of the unmanned vehicle to obtain real-time positioning information of the unmanned vehicle; and orderly accumulating according to the three-dimensional point cloud data and the real-time positioning information to generate a three-dimensional landform map. The unmanned vehicle inertial navigation positioning data and the satellite navigation positioning data are fused, the positioning precision of the unmanned vehicle is improved, the precision of the three-dimensional landform map is improved, and direct basis and guarantee are provided for the optimal fire extinguishing search and rescue path and scheme when a fire disaster occurs.
assignees: ZHEJIANG XIBEIHU SPECIAL VEHICLE CO LTD

title_en: High-rise building fire rescue information system based on bluetooth indoor positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-rise building fire rescue information system based on Bluetooth indoor positioning, which comprises: the Bluetooth beacon is used for sending Bluetooth signals to the intelligent terminals in the communication range in the building; the intelligent terminal is used for collecting real-time position information of rescue workers, receiving Bluetooth signals sent by the Bluetooth beacons and sending the received Bluetooth signals to the background server; the background server is used for analyzing the Bluetooth signal through a signal attenuation model to obtain a signal intensity indication value of the intelligent terminal, analyzing the signal intensity indication value through a filtering algorithm to obtain a stable signal intensity indication value, calculating to obtain the distance between the Bluetooth beacon and the intelligent terminal, further calculating to obtain the position of the intelligent terminal, and transmitting the obtained position information to the command terminal; and the command terminal is used for receiving the position information of the intelligent terminal sent by the background server. The invention can accurately acquire the position of the firefighter, improve rescue efficiency and reduce the probability of casualties.
assignees: NANJING LES INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rat search and rescue robot based on multi-mode fusion positioning and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rat search and rescue robot based on multi-mode fusion positioning and a search and rescue method, and the robot comprises a rat biological body, an electronic backpack module and a system platform, wherein the electronic backpack module comprises a microprocessor, a pulse generator, a channel selector, a wireless communication signal receiving module, a UWB human body presence sensor, a positioning module and a power supply circuit, the system platform comprises an upper computer and a wireless communication signal transmitting module, and wireless communication connection is established in a wireless communication mode so as to establish an information interaction channel between a computer system and a biological brain central nervous system among the rat biological body, the electronic backpack module and the system platform. The rat robot realized by the brain-computer interface technology directly takes the body of a rat as a body, reserves the good function of the animal through natural evolution, does not need to use a special control algorithm to detect and judge the environment in a complex environment, and can autonomously realize the motion control and obstacle avoidance functions by utilizing the existing capacity of the rat.

title_en: Automatic determination of defibrillation pad location on patient's chest
abstract_en: A medical device uses UWB units to infer a position of an adjunct positioned in proximity to an exterior portion of a patient's body. The position information can be used to provide CPR feedback to a rescuer. In other applications, the position information can be used to provide prompts to a user to change the position of the adjunct.

title_en: Multi-information fusion and heat source assisted medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning, and particularly relates to a medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method based on multi-information fusion and heat source assistance. According to the method, a GPS, an inertial measurement unit, an optical flow sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, an infrared thermal imaging camera and other sensors are integrated, an extended Kalman filtering algorithm and an active disturbance rejection control algorithm are utilized to achieve accurate positioning of a target heat source and accurate landing of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and a real-time monitoring unit in a real-time monitoring and decision support system receives data returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle and transmits analysis results to a real-time decision unit. The positioning method provided by the invention enables the unmanned aerial vehicle to effectively execute medical search and rescue tasks in a wide search area under complex terrain and changeable weather conditions, and provides immediate medical assistance for trapped persons, thereby playing a vital role in the field of emergency medical rescue.
assignees: JIANGXI CHANGHE PHARMACEUTICAL SUPPLY CHAIN MAN CO LTD

title_en: Communication method and related device
abstract_en: The present application provides a communication method and related device. The method includes: a first responder receives from an initiator a first frame for initiating a ranging process; the first responder generates a first private address based on the first frame and information related to an identity of the first responder; and the first responder transmits a second frame carrying the first private address to the initiator. The method may be applied to ultra-wideband multi-millisecond ranging systems. According to this application, an initiator can verify whether a frame is really from an authorized responder in an ultra-wideband multi-millisecond ranging session.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group searching and rescuing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue method and a system for unmanned aerial vehicle groups, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of search unmanned aerial vehicles form an unmanned aerial vehicle group, and a detection source is carried to scan a region to be searched to determine a suspected region, wherein the detection source comprises a radio spectrum detection source, and/or a SAR imaging detection source, and/or an optical imaging detection source; determining a target area from the suspected area through data fusion; and scanning the target area by searching an ultra-wideband life detection radar carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and acquiring and returning vital sign state information in the target area. The method has the advantages of accurate search and rescue positioning, high precision, good flexibility, good stability, capability of greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency and the like.

title_en: Disaster warning video color ring sending method and device based on near field communication equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a disaster warning video color ring sending method and device based on short-range communication equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining networking information of a search and rescue network sent by a target user terminal, wherein the search and rescue network is a group constructed by the target user terminal based on ultra wideband UWB technology, screening optimal terminals from surrounding short-distance assisted search and rescue terminals, the networking information comprises disaster type information and position information reported by the target user terminal, corresponding disaster warning video color ring is generated according to the disaster type information in the networking information, and the disaster warning video color ring and the position information of the target user terminal are directionally pushed to the assisted search and rescue terminals in the search and rescue network based on terminal identification of the networking information, wherein the disaster warning video color ring is used for assisting the assisted search and rescue terminals to rescue. The method and the device can reduce the resource loss of the search and rescue target in the search and rescue process, can also improve the accuracy of search and rescue information transmission, and realize the accurate triggering of the search and rescue information.
assignees: MIGU MUSIC CO LTD;MIGU CULTURE TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode fusion positioning-based rat search and rescue robot and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rat search and rescue robot and a search and rescue method based on multi-mode fusion positioning, wherein the rat search and rescue robot comprises a rat biological body, an electronic knapsack module and a system platform, the electronic knapsack module comprises a microprocessor, a pulse generator, a channel selector, a wireless communication signal receiving module, a UWB human body existence sensor, a positioning module and a power supply circuit, the system platform comprises an upper computer and a wireless communication signal transmitting module, and wireless communication connection is established in a wireless communication mode so as to build an information interaction path between a computer system and a biological brain central nervous system among the rat biological body, the electronic knapsack module and the system platform. The rat robot realized by the brain-computer interface technology directly takes the body of the rat as a body, keeps the good function of the animal through natural evolution, does not need to detect and judge the environment by a special control algorithm in a complex environment, and can autonomously realize the motion control and obstacle avoidance functions by utilizing the existing capability of the rat.

title_en: Indoor positioning system for firemen
abstract_en: A firefighter indoor positioning system, having: a wireless tag reader for a firefighter to wear or carry; the wireless tags are arranged at a plurality of positioning points in an indoor space and are respectively provided with a memory for storing position information, and the position information corresponds to one positioning point; in operation, the wireless tag reading device is wirelessly coupled with at least one wireless tag in a sensing range to obtain the position information corresponding to at least one positioning point of the indoor space.

title_en: Method and system for predicting survival space aperture of pressed human body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of prediction of living space of a buried human body, and discloses a method and a system for predicting aperture of living space of the buried human body based on ultra-wideband biological radar, according to prior information that medium in a living space hole is mostly air, and the propagation speed of electromagnetic waves is close to the propagation speed of the electromagnetic waves in vacuum, after a human body target is judged to exist and positioned, taking the human body target positioning position as the circle center, taking the distance from the sparse pulse sequence obtained by sparse pulse deconvolution to the circle center as the radius, making a series of concentric circles, if the concentric circles are overlapped to a certain extent, judging the position of the pulse sequence as the upper edge position of the human body living space hole, and estimating the aperture size. The method can effectively estimate the aperture size of the living space of the human body target under ruins, and the information is favorable for judging the surrounding condition of survivors.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF NORTHERN THEATER COMMAND OF PLA

title_en: Indoor positioning and tracing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses track system, the method and apparatus of at least one of object, vehicle and personnel at the scene by determining the distance between first node and remote node.In some embodiments, it provides a kind of for by the distance between node for being located in emergency responder and allowing to draw the relative position of the emergency responder method to track the emergency responder at emergency scene.

title_en: Amphibious exoskeleton robot system for underwater rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides an amphibious exoskeleton robot system for underwater rescue in the technical field of flood disaster relief auxiliary robots, which comprises a sensing module, a base module and a rigid lower limb exoskeleton, wherein the sensing module comprises a myoelectric sensor and an inertial sensor, the base module comprises a processing module and a driving module, the rigid lower limb exoskeleton module comprises a waterproof backpack, the inertial sensor is arranged on the surface of the skin of a joint, the myoelectric sensor is arranged at the position of a shank and a thigh, the driving module and the processing module are arranged in the waterproof backpack, the driving module is connected with the processing module, the inertial sensor and the myoelectric sensor receive signals, the signals are fed back to the processing module and the driving module, and the driving module indicates the rigid lower limb exoskeleton to make corresponding actions to provide assistance. The invention is provided with the inertial sensor to realize the distinguishing of the motion states, obtains the bioelectricity signal of the rescuers by the myoelectric sensor to predict the next action, and controls the rigid lower limb exoskeleton to make the corresponding action to complete the optimal boosting work.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title_en: Wall penetrating radar system for life detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar system for life detection, which belongs to the technical field of radar detection, and comprises an antenna module, a P440 ultra-wideband transceiver module, a signal processing module, a communication module and a control terminal, wherein an antenna array formed by sail-shaped antenna units is constructed, and the P440 ultra-wideband transceiver module is combined to realize accurate detection of a human body target after a dry brick wall with the thickness of more than or equal to 22cm, and the system is modularized integrated under the condition of ensuring the detection distance and the angle range, so that portability is ensured, and the system stability is ensured through a power module and a temperature sensing supplementing unit, so that the system can be widely applied to the scenes of anti-terrorism detection, post-disaster search and rescue and the like. The invention solves the problem of insufficient reliability of life detection of the radar in a complex wall environment.

title_en: Firefighter location tracking system and method using Bluetooth-based indoor positioning and altitude sensor
title_ko: 블루투스 기반 실내 측위 및 고도 센서를 이용한 소방 대원 위치 추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블루투스 기반 실내 측위 및 고도 센서를 이용한 소방 대원 위치 추적 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템은 소방 대원이 휴대하는 스마트폰, 웨어러블 기기, 그리고 관제 서버로 구성된다. 스마트폰은 블루투스 모듈과 고도 센서를 이용하여 위치 정보를 측정하고, 웨어러블 기기는 스마트폰과 블루투스 통신을 통해 위치 정보를 수신하여 디스플레이에 표시한다. 관제 서버는 스마트폰과 웨어러블 기기에서 수신된 정보를 기반으로 소방 대원의 위치를 3차원 좌표로 계산하고, 이를 지도 상에 시각적으로 표시하여 소방 현장 지휘 및 효율적인 구조 활동을 지원한다. 
 
본 발명에 따르면, 블루투스 및 고도 센서를 이용하여 실내 환경에서 소방 대원의 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 저비용, 저전력으로 구현 가능하며, 유지보수가 용이한 위치 추적 시스템을 제공한다. 또한, 화재, 재난 등의 상황에서도 안정적으로 작동하는 강건한 위치 추적 시스템을 제공하며, 소방 대원의 위치 정보, 이동 경로, 층 정보, 상대적 위치 등 다양한 정보를 실시간으로 제공하여 소방 현장 지휘 및 효율적인 구조 활동을 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system, include: the system comprises an upper computer, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a portable device which are in wireless connection communication with the upper computer, and an OpenMV machine vision module; the portable device is positioned on the person to be rescued; the portable device is attached with a GPS module to preliminarily position the rescue workers, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the portable device are respectively provided with a UWB positioning module to perform positioning again. The utility model discloses at first treat the rescue personnel through the GPS module and carry out preliminary location, the host computer obtains preliminary positioning information, go out to move unmanned aerial vehicle and go to preliminary positioning position according to planning the route, the further accurate positioning of UWB positioning module is recycled, positioning accuracy reaches centimetre level, can realize accurate input, when unable realization real-time location and the pursuit through the UWB module, unmanned aerial vehicle can rely on OpenMV machine vision module to realize real-time location and pursuit, thereby the adaptability and the interference killing feature of system have been strengthened.

title_en: Fire rescue field positioning system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue field positioning system and method based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of positioning; the method comprises the steps of enabling a person to be positioned to wear equipment integrated with an ultrahigh frequency RFID card reader and an inertial navigation sensor, entering the area to be positioned, enabling the ultrahigh frequency RFID card reader to automatically scan surrounding passive RFID cards and read ID information to obtain RFID positioning information, enabling the inertial navigation sensor to calculate the motion track and direction of the person to be positioned to obtain the positioning information of the inertial navigation sensor, and commanding a dispatching background to determine the real-time position of the person to be positioned through a data analysis algorithm. According to the invention, the RFID positioning and the inertial navigation sensor are combined, the passive RFID card is used for providing a fixed position reference, the inertial navigation sensor compensates the positioning blind area, the personnel positioning is completed in a seamless connection way, and the firefighting rescue area is covered.
assignees: SUZHOU QIANYE IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultra wideband radar multipoint distributed target positioning method based on life detection aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra wideband radar multipoint distributed target positioning method based on a life detection aircraft, which relates to the technical field of life detection aircrafts and radars. Based on powerful maneuvering performance of a search and rescue aircraft, an ultra wideband life detection radar is arranged on the aircraft, and by using the multipoint distributed target positioning method, quick and accurate living thing positioning can be realized. In an experiment, the radar is placed on an aircraft pan-tilt, the aircraft is used for controlling the radar to move at a high altitude, and according to a multipoint distributed target judgment criterion, a three-sphere method is applied to solving target position information. The original distance detection result in a pitch-catch mode is used for solving a ternary quadratic inhomogeneous equation set, the optimal solution is selected according to results of the equation set, and thus the position information of the living thing in three-dimensional space can be obtained. Through applying an adjacent discrimination method to searching a detection point, the radar is closest to the target position and surrounds the target, and effectiveness and reliability of living thing target positioning are enhanced.

title_en: Waterproof infrared light smoke detector for throwing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof infrared light smoke detector for throwing, which comprises a smoke detector body, wherein an air passage is arranged in the smoke detector body, an infrared luminous tube and an infrared photosensitive tube are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the middle of the air passage, an electrode contact A and an electrode contact B are symmetrically arranged on two sides of one end part of the air passage, an electrode contact C and an electrode contact D are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the other end part of the air passage, the electrode contact A, the electrode contact B, the electrode contact C, the electrode contact D, the infrared luminous tube and the infrared photosensitive tube are all connected with a control circuit board box through wires, and the control circuit board box is fixedly arranged at the right center of the inside of the smoke detector body. The invention solves the problem that the traditional smoke sensor is difficult to rapidly and accurately monitor smoke in the area near the ground in severe environments such as emergency rescue and the like by arranging the infrared luminous tube, the infrared photosensitive tube and the acceleration inertial sensor.

title_en: Indoor positioning and path planning method under fire-fighting rescue condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning and path planning method under the condition of fire fighting and rescue, which comprises a server platform of an emergency on-site command center, a GPS positioning module, an inertial navigation module, an air respirator with augmented reality glasses and information processing and transmitting terminal equipment, wherein the GPS positioning module and the inertial navigation module are arranged on the firemen, and the specific position of the firemen in a building is obtained by obtaining the conversion relation from an inertial navigation coordinate system to a world coordinate system through the GPS positioning and the inertial navigation positioning. And planning an indoor optimal path from the firefighter to the target position according to the target position appointed by the command center. By the method, the fire-fighting rescue action speed of the firemen can be effectively improved, and the action safety of the firemen is guaranteed.

title_en: Fire control positioning system based on INS, 5G and unmanned aerial vehicle combination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting positioning system based on combination of an INS, a 5G and an unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting positioning and comprises a rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle and a positioning terminal, wherein the rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a 5G base station and a first camera module, the first camera module is arranged on a cradle head of the rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle, data acquired by the first camera module are wirelessly transmitted through the 5G base station, the positioning terminal comprises a microprocessor module arranged in a shell, a display screen, a first Bluetooth module and a 5G communication module, the display screen, the first Bluetooth module and the 5G communication module are electrically connected with the microprocessor module, an inertial navigation system module, a second camera and the second Bluetooth module are arranged on a fire-fighting helmet, the inertial navigation system module, the second camera module and the second Bluetooth module are electrically connected, and the first Bluetooth module and the second Bluetooth module are in communication connection. The utility model can assist firefighters in sensing the scene situation and the position, and improve the positioning accuracy and reliability in the fire environment.

title_en: System for spatial visualizing of disaster site and method thereof
title_ko: 재난현장 공간 시각화 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for visualizing a space at a disaster site and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a system for visualizing a space at a disaster site and a method thereof, which visualize and provide spatial information of various disaster sites by using location information of rescue workers confirmed through pedestrian dead reckoning (pdr) and data measured through fmcw lidar, thereby accurately grasping a spatial structure of a site where a disaster occurs and smoothly performing lifesaving work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난현장 공간 시각화 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보행자 추측 항법(PDR)을 통해 확인한 구조대원의 위치 정보와 FMCW 라이다를 통해 측정한 데이터를 이용하여 각종 재난현장의 공간 정보를 시각화하여 제공함으로써, 재난이 발생한 현장의 공간 구조를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 이를 통해서 인명 구조 작업을 원활하게 수행할 수 있도록 하는 재난현장 공간 시각화 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: TOA co-positioning method for vehicle-mounted fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TOA co-location method of a vehicle-mounted fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: UWB module installation and deployment: three motor fire-fighting vehicles on the ground are adopted as positioning platforms, and four UWB modules are deployed and installed on the roof of each vehicle; each motor fire truck roof platform is provided with a fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and each rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a UWB module; the UWB module coordinates of the fire rotor unmanned aerial vehicle are calculated; the method comprises the steps of collecting TOA sensor data of a UWB module of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle; and (5) solving the spatial position of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, under the conditions of unreliable GPS signals, weak signals or refusal among urban buildings, the accurate and reliable calculation of the spatial position of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is realized by the TOA co-location mode of a plurality of small-sized motor fire-fighting vehicles, thereby providing preconditions for autonomous or semi-autonomous flight of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and improving the safety of firefighters during operation.

title_en: A kind of UWB positioning systems for robot
abstract_en: A kind of UWB positioning systems for robot,Belong to indoor autonomous navigation technology field,Including locating module,Reconnoitre module,Data processing module,Control module,GPS technology and UWB technology are combined by locating module,GPS technology is for positioning robot chamber external position,UWB technology is for the positioning to indoor location,It reconnoitres module and is equipped with a variety of detection units,For detecting varying environment data,After data being exchanged with the pattern drawing unit in control module,It can be used for search-and-rescue work,Control model is divided into Active Control Mode and passive control model,The formulation of route can to data analysis and be independently carried out by system CPU data analysis unit,It also can be by the way that mobile route be sent instructions or fixed in a manner of program under artificial remote control,The present invention solves the problems, such as the unstable of indoor transmissions signal by UWB technology,UWB technology transmission rate is high,Spatial content is big,It is at low cost,It is low in energy consumption.

title_en: Rapid help seeking method based on indoor positioning advertisement screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick help seeking method based on an indoor positioning advertisement screen. When the person needs to seek help, the person looks for a nearby advertisement screen; judging whether the help seeker can use code scanning software or not; seeking help by scanning the two-dimensional code on the advertisement screen; seeking help through a help seeking button of the advertisement screen; initiating a help call; the machine linkage is used for displaying the requirements and the position of equipment closest to the help seeker; the rescuer selects whether to provide help; scanning the two-dimensional code on the watched advertisement screen, and displaying navigation of equipment nearest to the help seeker, snapshot of a nearby environment or contact information of the help seeker; the rescuer arrives at the position of the help seeker and judges whether the help can be given or not; displaying a feedback two-dimensional code on an advertisement screen after releasing the release of the related emergency message; and (3) the rescuers and passers-by scan and evaluate the two-dimensional codes in the step (10), if the two-dimensional codes are true to call for help, the two-dimensional codes are ended, and if the two-dimensional codes are false to call for help, the two-dimensional codes are added into a blacklist.
assignees: FUZHOU DONGFANG WISDOM NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for emergency call using wearable device in both in-building and outdoor environment
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스를 활용한 실내외 응급호출 구현 방안
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a communication terminal device which transmits location information measured by an optimum positioning method to a rescuer, respectively, in case a victim is located indoors and outdoors, in an emergency call by using a wearable device, and a recording medium storing a program to perform the method. Unlike the prior art in which errors may be generated according to the position of the victim by performing only the indoor positioning or outdoor positioning, optimum position information is automatically selected according to the position of the victim to transmit accurate position information of the victim, thereby increasing the likelihood of success of rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 디바이스를 활용하여 응급호출시 피구호자의 위치가  실내일 경우와 실외일 경우, 각각 최적의 측위방법으로 측위된 위치정보를 구호자에게 전송하는 통신단말장치와 이러한 방법을 수행할 수 있는 프로그램이 저장된 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 실내측위 혹은 실외측위만 수행하여 피구호차의 위치에 따라서 오차가 많이 발생할 수 있는 종래의 기술과 달리 피구호자의 위치에 따라  자동으로 최적의 위치정보를  선택하여 피구호자의 정확한 위치정보를 전송함으로써 구호의 성공 가능성을 높였다.

title_en: UWB network-based remote fire-fighting IoT system design
abstract_en: The design name is a remote fire-fighting IOT system design based on a UWB network, is an internet of things system with main functions of positioning, monitoring, fire-fighting and local navigation based on UWB communication technology, and is used for combining communication, positioning, network organization, data processing, computer visualization and the like, and aims to better solve the problem of difficult implementation of fire-fighting rescue in remote areas and higher floors of cities, monitor environments, remote operation objects and reduce casualties through the internet of things. Meanwhile, in a 3D modeling scene, positioning and navigation are performed by combining data, so that firefighters can conveniently perform fixed-point search and rescue navigation, and convenient intelligent service is provided for common users of other non-firefighting staff in commercial buildings.

title_en: Method for uwb transaction and electronic device therefor
title_ko: Uwb 트랜잭션을 위한 방법 및 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for an ultrawide band (UWB) transaction, which is capable of providing a security-guaranteed transaction using a UWB transaction, and an electronic device thereof. According to various embodiments of the present invention, the electronic device comprises: a communication circuit performing short-range wireless communications; a UWB communication circuit performing UWB communications; a security element providing an execution environment isolated from an operating system (OS) of the electronic device; and a processor. The UWB communication circuit performs ranging with an external electronic device, receives a first UWB signal including a media access control (MAC) header and a MAC payload from the external electronic device, and determines whether to transfer information included in a MAC payload information element to the security element based on at least the MAC payload information element included in the MAC payload. In addition, various embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시예에 따르면, 근거리 무선 통신을 수행하도록 설정된 통신 회로, UWB(ultra-wideband) 통신을 수행하도록 설정된 UWB 통신 회로, 상기 전자 장치의 OS(operating system)로부터 고립된(isolated) 실행 환경을 제공하도록 설정된 보안 요소, 및 프로세서를 포함하는 전자 장치가 개시된다. 상기 UWB 통신 회로는, 외부 전자 장치와의 레인징(ranging)을 수행하고, 상기 외부 전자 장치로부터 MAC 헤더 및 MAC 페이로드를 포함하는 제1 UWB 신호를 수신하고, 상기 MAC 페이로드에 포함된 MAC(medium access control) 페이로드 정보 요소에 적어도 기반하여 상기 MAC 페이로드 정보 요소에 포함된 정보의 상기 보안 요소로의 전달 여부를 결정하도록 설정될 수 있다. 이외에도 다양한 실시예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Fireman indoor positioning method based on WiFi fingerprint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WiFi fingerprint-based firefighter indoor positioning method, which comprises the following steps: when a fire disaster suddenly occurs, receiving signal intensity information transmitted by the wireless access node by a fireman rushing into the fire scene, and determining the serial number of a cluster to which the fireman belongs; according to the wireless access node reliability function, calculating and screening the reliability of each wireless access node, and filtering out wireless access nodes damaged by fire; calculating the distance proportion of all reference points in the same cluster by using a dynamic online matching algorithm in the cluster to which the firefighter belongs and combining the signal strength values received by the reference points, and selecting the reference points with the distance proportion larger than a distance proportion threshold value to carry out position estimation; and calculating the position coordinates of the firefighter according to the selected reference point. The invention provides an AP trust function to screen the AP aiming at the possible AP damage condition in the fire scene; and a dynamic online matching algorithm is applied, so that the positioning precision of the algorithm is improved.

title_en: ROS-based modular unmanned ship/unmanned vehicle system with intelligent auxiliary counterweight
abstract_en: The modular unmanned ship/unmanned vehicle system based on intelligent auxiliary counterweight of ROS comprises a ship body/vehicle body, wherein a foundation module and an expansion module are installed in the ship body/vehicle body, the foundation module and the expansion module both comprise universal modules, each universal module comprises an embedded ROS system, a battery, a wireless electric energy conversion circuit and a wireless charging coil interface, the foundation module is provided with a plurality of wireless charging coil interfaces, the wireless charging coil interface of the expansion module is in butt joint with the wireless charging coil interface on the foundation module to realize charging and communication with the foundation module, the expansion module is one or a plurality of combinations of camera modules, 4G network modules, radar modules, inertial modules, vertical propulsion modules, horizontal propulsion modules, docking modules, water quality detection modules, water surface garbage cleaning modules, sonar imaging modules, search and rescue modules, magnetic sensor modules, high-speed calculation modules, interference modules and Mecanum wheel modules, and the ship body is provided with an intelligent counterweight module for counterweight or weight reduction and balance.

title_en: Real-time managing evacuation of a building
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 00, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building, triggered by alarm notification (S202). Based on determined (S214) precise real-time positions of personal ultra-wide band, UWB, devices, as determined by UWB real-time localization system, RTLS, a controller determines (S210) evacuation plans being personal UWB device specific in real-time. Based on individual evacuation plans and input from building facilities, real-time guidance information is defined (S208) and sent to each personal UWB device, providing guidance to person carrying said personal UWB device, in what direction to move (S212), to reach a safe area. Based on localization signals the UWB RTLSA then calculates updated positions of the personal UWB devices and sends to the evacuation management system. It is an advantage that trapped or injured people can be found, even in low visibility areas.

title_en: Multiple access techniques in Ultra Wideband (UWB) positioning
abstract_en: Techniques for wireless communication are disclosed. In one aspect, an initiator anchor node sends first configuration information for a first ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the first responder anchor node to a first responder anchor node, wherein the first configuration information indicates a first time of initiation for the first ranging session, and sends second configuration information for a second ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the second responder anchor node to a second responding Fang Mao node, wherein the second configuration information indicates a second time of initiation for the second ranging session, wherein the first ranging session and the second ranging session are configured to enable a mobile device to obtain a first time difference of arrival (TDOA) measurement and a second TDOA measurement for the first responder anchor node and the second responding Fang Mao node, respectively, and wherein the second time of initiation is offset from the first time of initiation.

title_en: Indoor dynamic security evacuation system based on Internet of things and BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor dynamic security evacuation system based on the Internet of things and BIM, which comprises: the system comprises an indoor personnel positioning system, an indoor environment monitoring system, a building structure monitoring system, a set of dynamic evacuation path optimization algorithm and a three-dimensional dynamic visual system, wherein the indoor environment monitoring system is installed in a room of a building; the building structure monitoring system is arranged in a beam, a column, a floor slab and a wall body of a building; the dynamic evacuation path optimization algorithm can divide an indoor layout into a dangerous area and a safe area according to indoor environment information acquired by the indoor environment system and structural stress information acquired by the building structure monitoring system, and an evacuation path optimization scheme for trapped people is obtained by combining personnel position information acquired by the indoor positioning system and the indoor layout after dividing the areas; when disasters such as earthquake, fire and the like occur, trapped people can be helped to find the optimal evacuation path, the evacuation efficiency is improved, and casualties are reduced.

title_en: Distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system and a method, which relate to the field of intelligent weapon control and comprise the following steps: the warship comprises a warship body, wherein a warship cabin is arranged at the upper end of the warship body; the photoelectric tracking reconnaissance device comprises a photoelectric detection head and a photoelectric control cabinet, wherein the photoelectric detection head is fixedly arranged at the top of the cabin, and the photoelectric control cabinet is arranged inside the cabin; the inertial navigation equipment is arranged below the photoelectric detection head; the remote control weapon station comprises a weapon platform and a wall-mounted box, wherein the weapon platform is fixedly arranged on the front side of the upper end of a warship body, and the wall-mounted box is arranged in a warship cabin. The invention has the advantages that: photoelectric, navigation and remote control weapon equipment on the unmanned ship are optimized and integrated to form a distributed intelligent reconnaissance and attack integrated system, and tasks such as warning patrol, information reconnaissance, accurate attack on the sea, search and rescue and the like on a designated area, and mine exploration/mine elimination, anti-frogman and other special combat tasks can be effectively completed.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a trans-mitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: Intelligent gas leakage alarm system and method thereof
title_ko: 지능형 가스 누출 경보 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an intelligent gas leakage alarm system for providing an optimal evacuation path and a method thereof. The system comprises: a worker mobile device estimating worker location information based on a radio signal for indoor positioning received from a plurality of gas leakage detecting devices fixedly installed in a building; and a control center collecting measurement data measuring concentration of a harmful gas, the temperature/humidity, flow of air, and smoke from the gas leak detecting devices, generating harmful information indicating a gas leakage position, a gas distribution map according to the gas leakage position, and a gas diffusion state according to time based on the measurement data, estimating evacuation path information optimized for each worker in the building based on the harmful information and the worker position information received from the worker mobile device, and transmitting the estimated evacuation path information and the harmful information to the worker mobile device.
abstract_ko: 지능형 가스 누출 경보 시스템이 제공된다. 이 시스템은, 건물 내에 고정 설치된 다수의 가스 누출 감지 장치로부터 수신된 실내측위용 무선신호를 기반으로 작업자 위치 정보를 추정하는 작업자 휴대기기; 및 상기 다수의 가수 누출 감지 장치로부터 유해 가스의 농도, 온/습도, 공기의 흐름, 연기를 측정한 측정 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 측정 데이터를 기반으로 가스 누출 위치, 상기 가스 누출 위치에 따른 가스 분포도 및 시간에 따른 가스 확산 양상을 나타내는 유해 정보를 생성하고, 상기 유해 정보와 상기 작업자 휴대기기로부터 수신된 작업자 위치 정보를 기반으로 상기 건물 내에서 작업자 별로 최적화된 대피 경로 정보를 추정하고, 추정된 상기 대피 경로 정보와 상기 유해 정보를 상기 작업자 휴대기기로 전송하는 관제 센터;를 포함한다.

Based on determined (S214) precise real-time positions of personal ultra-wide band, UWB,devices, as determined by UWB real-time localization system, RTLS, a controller determines (S210) evacuation plans being personal UWB device specific in real-time. Based on individual evacuation plans and input from building facilities, real- time guidance information is defined (S208) and sent to each personal UWB device, providing guidance to person carrying said personal UWB device, in what direction to move (S212), to reach a safe area. Based on localization signals the UWB RTLSA then calculates updated positions of the personal UWB devices and sends to the evacuation management system. It is an advantage that trapped or injured people can be found, even in low visibility areas.

title_en: Multiple access techniques in ultra-wideband (uwb) positioning
abstract_en: Disclosed are techniques for wireless communication. In an aspect, an initiator anchor node transmits, to a first responder anchor node, first configuration information for a first ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the first responder anchor node, wherein the first configuration information indicates a first initiation time for the first ranging session, and transmits, to a second responder anchor node, second configuration information for a second ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the second responder anchor node, wherein the second configuration information indicates a second initiation time for the second ranging session, wherein the first and second ranging sessions are configured to enable a mobile device to obtain a first time-difference of arrival (TDOA) measurement and a second TDOA measurement for the first responder anchor node and the second responder anchor node, respectively, and wherein the second initiation time is offset from the first initiation time.

title_en: Microwave tracking system based on Beidou positioning and signal searching automatic rotation adjustment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maritime communication and target tracking, and discloses a maritime search and rescue multi-target collaborative tracking method and a maritime search and rescue multi-target collaborative tracking system based on sea condition self-adaption, wherein the maritime search and rescue multi-target collaborative tracking method comprises the steps of obtaining sea condition forecast data, ship gyroscope data and target initial position data to generate a comprehensive data set, and (3) establishing a motion-drift coupling prediction model, calculating a time-varying difficulty matrix, executing a sea condition self-adaptive load balancing algorithm to generate a collaborative tracking instruction set, updating prediction parameters in real time through a ship motion-target track coupling prediction network, and carrying out multipath signal transmission processing based on a non-line-of-sight microwave communication technology. The method solves the technical problems of low multi-target collaborative tracking precision and unreasonable resource allocation under extreme sea conditions.
assignees: JIANGSU RUICHI BOTONG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;YANGJIANG BRANCH OF CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS LTD

title_en: Augmented reality search and rescue glasses suitable for complicated environmental conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses augmented reality search and rescue glasses suitable for complex environmental conditions, which comprise UWB ultra-wideband radar, RGB cameras, infrared cameras, IMU, eyeball trackers, calculation modules, display modules and the like. Wherein: UWB ultra-wideband radar, RGB camera, infrared camera adopt different technical means to detect the life in the environment respectively, realize shielding, life detection under multiple complex environment such as low illumination. The eye tracker is used for monitoring eye movements of the wearer, and the IMU is used for monitoring head movements of the wearer. The calculation module fuses the real-time life detection result, the eyeball movement of the wearer and the head movement data, and then presents the life detection result on the display module, thereby providing guidance for the search and rescue work of the rescue workers. Under complex environmental conditions, the invention has higher life detection capability, can greatly reduce the workload of rescue workers, and is very beneficial to life detection under complex environmental conditions.

title_en: Under-forest personnel positioning equipment based on inertial navigation, UWB, GNSS and LORA
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an inertial navigation, UWB, GNSS and LORA based understory personnel positioning apparatus, method, electronic device and storage medium. The personnel positioning equipment comprises a main control module, a sensor module and an antenna module, wherein the main control module is used for receiving UWB information, GPS information, beidou information and LORA information based on the antenna module, receiving the sensor information based on the sensor module and processing the UWB information, the GPS information, the Beidou information, the LORA information and the sensor information to generate positioning information, the sensor module is used for generating the sensor information based on each sensor, and the antenna module is used for collecting the UWB information, the GPS information, the Beidou information and the LORA information based on each antenna. The system and the method adopt three modes for combined positioning, more accurately position personnel and more quickly rescue facilities, can send information under the condition of no public network, are convenient for detecting firefighter conditions in real time, detect harmful gases and send alarm signals.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on an ultra-wideband radar, which relate to the technical field of vital sign detection and are used for acquiring an echo signal of the ultra-wideband radar; filtering processing operations such as linear migration removal, time domain sliding average difference filtering, fast Fourier transform, frequency domain sliding average difference filtering, overall frequency domain sliding average filtering and the like are carried out on the ultra-wideband radar echo signals; carrying out harmonic multiple cycle detection on the filtered frequency domain signal to obtain a vital sign signal, wherein the vital sign signal comprises information such as position information, respiratory rate and heart rate of a person to be detected; the invention improves the judgment standard of respiration and heartbeat frequency, can accurately detect the position of a vital body from a radar and the respiration and heartbeat rate, can detect and display the vital sign information in real time, and has wide application prospect in the aspects of medical care, disaster search and rescue and the vital sign detection of special people.

title_en: Method and system for locating entry point of firefighter building
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for locating entry points of firefighters in buildings, comprising the following steps: step S1: respectively solving position data by a micro inertial navigation system and a satellite navigation system; step S2: fusing the position data to obtain fused position data; step S3: collecting 3D data of surrounding environment, matching and resolving the data with the 3D graphic database of the building, and correcting the position information of the micro inertial navigation system by using the position information of the database after the entry point of the building is successfully paired; step S4: the micro inertial navigation system calculates accurate position data by integration starting from this point based on the corrected position information. The invention provides a fusion positioning method based on a miniature 3D laser radar, which is used for determining the accurate position of a building entry point of a fireman and fusion positioning calculation of an individual positioning system, so that the problem that the prior art cannot provide an effective and accurate fusion positioning method is solved.

title_en: IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-vision multi-mode perception
abstract_en: The invention provides an IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-visual multi-mode perception, which comprises the functional modules of initial calibration and semantic map initialization, pre-integral prediction and key frame judgment, dense point cloud reconstruction and relative pose estimation, semantic embedding extraction, semantic guidance loop detection, semantic three-dimensional map incremental update and the like, wherein IMU motion priori, depth geometric constraint and language model semantic factors are jointly modeled through a graph optimization framework, and high-precision positioning and labeled map construction under a complex dynamic environment are realized. Compared with the prior art which only depends on geometric or inertial information, the invention reduces the loop error matching rate, improves the closed loop convergence efficiency and long-time repositioning robustness, and provides semantic interfaces for upper-layer tasks such as natural language navigation, target retrieval and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of service robots, security inspection, intelligent driving, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Indoor personnel positioning method and system based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of indoor positioning, in particular to an indoor personnel positioning method and system based on multi-mode sensing, the ultra-wideband channel impulse response, millimeter wave radar data and thermal imaging data of each layer are acquired, double-base geometric mapping is carried out by combining building information, an indoor ray path is reconstructed, and an occupied grid diagram is generated. Further collecting the water mist distribution intensity generated by the spraying equipment, carrying out phase correction and beam domain purification on millimeter wave data, and carrying out flow direction filtering and flicker suppression on thermal imaging data to obtain preprocessing data. On the basis, motion prior information and boundary constraint information are extracted, fusion is realized in the occupied grid diagram through mass conservation updating and normalization synthesis, and finally the position information and the motion orientation of the object to be positioned are output. The application can maintain the positioning stability and accuracy under the interference of fire smoke, water mist and multipath effect, and is suitable for high-risk scenes such as fire rescue and the like.

title_en: Indoor positioning device based on wireless WIFI inertial positioning
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wireless positioning, in particular to an indoor positioning device based on wireless WIFI inertial positioning, which comprises a mounting seat, a control box and a processor, wherein both sides of the mounting seat are provided with fixing binding bands, the top of the mounting seat is provided with the control box, the left side of the top of the control box is provided with a smoke sensor, the middle of the top of the control box is provided with a display screen, the right side of the top of the control box is provided with a buzzer, the inner cavity of the control box is provided with a processor, a storage battery, an inertial sensor and a communication module, the processor is electrically connected with the storage battery, the smoke sensor and the inertial sensor in an input mode, the structure is reasonable, the indoor positioning is realized through the cooperation of the inertial sensor, the processor, the communication module and a monitoring terminal, the smoke sensor, the display screen and the buzzer are arranged on the, the fire disaster monitoring and early warning is realized, and the remote warning is realized through the cooperation of the communication module and the monitoring terminal.

title_en: Emergency positioning method and device based on vehicle, vehicle and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency positioning method and device based on a vehicle, the vehicle and equipment, and the method and the device can be used in the technical field of vehicle positioning. The method comprises the following steps: if the vehicle is monitored to be in an emergency state, a first UWB signal is sent to UWB search and rescue equipment through a UWB functional module; receiving a second UWB signal sent by UWB search and rescue equipment through a UWB functional module; analyzing the received second UWB signal to obtain the positioning information of the vehicle; transmitting a third UWB signal to UWB search and rescue equipment through the UWB functional module; wherein the third UWB signal includes positioning information of the vehicle; the UWB search and rescue equipment is used for processing the positioning information and generating and displaying the relative position information of the vehicle. The method can quickly and accurately position the trapped vehicle, reduce the positioning time and the excavation workload, and is more beneficial to search and rescue operation.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Fire scene fireman cooperative relay positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cooperative relay positioning method and system for firefighters in a fire scene. According to the number of UWB base stations which can communicate with the tag to be positioned, the UWB base stations are firstly divided into a plurality of priorities and then targeted positioning is carried out. Aiming at the first priority label, the UWB and the INS are combined, under the condition that the UWB base station is sufficient but mostly in an NLOS environment, the NLOS error in the UWB ranging value is weakened, and the positioning accuracy of the first priority label is improved. And then, the positioned label is used as a mobile anchor point and is combined with a corresponding UWB base station to form a reference node, and for other priority labels, a cooperative positioning algorithm based on UWB is adopted to perform relay positioning on the label to be positioned in a grouping positioning mode according to the conditions of the UWB base stations and the mobile anchor points distributed around the label, so that the positioning rate of the other priority labels is improved. The invention can reduce the requirement of positioning on high UWB base station distribution density or long communication radius, and uses the whole co-location network resource to the maximum extent, thereby obtaining more positioning reference information.
assignees: UNIV XIAN POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS;XIAN BLUE SEA SKY ELECTRONIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for cluster configuration and round allocation for uwb communication
title_ko: Uwb 통신을 위한 클러스터 구성 및 라운드 할당 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An operation method of an electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: identifying two-way ranging (TWR) values for multiple anchors; configuring a first cluster including a first initiator anchor and first responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; configuring a second cluster including a second initiator anchor and second responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; and allocating a ranging round to each of the first cluster and the second cluster.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 다양한 실시예에 따른 전자 장치의 동작 방법은, 복수의 앵커들에 대한 TWR (two-way ranging) 값들을 확인하는 단계와, 상기 TWR 값들에 기반하여, 제1 initiator 앵커와 제1 responder 앵커들을 포함하는 제1 클러스터를 구성하는 단계와, 상기 TWR 값들에 기반하여, 제2 initiator 앵커와 제2 responder 앵커들을 포함하는 제2 클러스터를 구성하는 단계와, 상기 제1 클러스터 및 상기 제2 클러스터 각각에 레인징 라운드를 할당하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a transmitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: Real-time, two dimensional (2-D) tracking of first responders with identification inside premises
abstract_en: A combination of active reader tags and ultra wideband (UWB) radar systems provide real-time monitoring of first responders, with identification of each team member using active tags, and detection of victims or other subjects using motion or breathing detection, in a field of operations such as a building affected by fire or hazardous material or search and rescue mission area. Initially, a cluster of miniaturized radars (sensors) act in a static mode of operation, gathering static radar information used to depict a constructed layout of the premises. The cluster of radars then operate in a dynamic mode that detects motion or breathing of multiple subjects inside the field of operations. With dual mode operation the system can read the active tags identification, and by triangulation, display the position of each first responder with its identification and positions of subjects on a composite image of the constructed layout.

title_en: Method and apparatus for cluster configuration and round allocation for UWB communications
abstract_en: Methods of operation of an electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may include confirming two-way ranging (TWR) values for a plurality of anchors, configuring a first cluster including a first initiator anchor and a first responder anchor based on the TWR values, configuring a second cluster including a second initiator anchor and a second responder anchor based on the TWR values, and assigning a ranging round to each of the first cluster and the second cluster.

title_en: Enhancement of the 3d indoor positioning by augmenting a multitude of 3d imaging, lidar distance corrections, imu sensors and 3-d ultrasound
abstract_en: The invention focuses on enhancing indoor positioning and navigation through advanced synchronous fusion methodologies that integrate various technologies, including Inertial Navigation Systems (INS), Inertial Measurement Units (IMU), LiDAR, stereo vision, and Sonar. This comprehensive system aims to achieve high-precision data collection with centimeter-level accuracy, crucial for creating detailed three-dimensional indoor maps. A significant aspect of this innovation is its ability to address privacy concerns by incorporating measures that abstract sensitive segments of the environment when necessary, ensuring personal privacy is maintained during data collection. Additionally, the system tackles challenges such as voids in stereo imaging and temperature variations in ultrasound and LiDAR measurements through sophisticated algorithms and corrections, including back propagation techniques that utilize stereo depth data. By employing particle swarm optimization and Neuro-Fuzzy algorithms, the framework enhances the accuracy and reliability of navigation in complex environments, making it particularly beneficial for emergency responders and personal navigation in unfamiliar settings.

title_en: Indoor Positioning System for Fire Alarm System
