abstract_en: A building management system tracks occupants of a building in which the building management system is installed and presents information about the occupants, including location information, to first responders during emergency and/or training events. Distributed devices of the building management system receive identification information broadcast by user devices of the occupants and sends the identification information to a control panel of the building management system. Location information for the occupants is generated based on the identification information received from the user devices and stored along with time and date information. This location information is then retrieved and presented to first responders, for example, by displaying a map of the building with icons representing the distributed devices and occupants, based on the location information.

title_en: Search and rescue uav system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Method and system for locating and monitoring first responders
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention can provide for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station.
assignees: TRX SYSTEMS INC;BANDYOPADHYAY AMRIT;KOHN ERIC A;GOLDSMAN NEIL;TEOLIS CAROLE A;BLANKENSHIP GILMER L;FUNK BENJAMIN E

title_en: Down-the-hole hammer drill bit for life rescue sensing and positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a down-the-hole hammer drill bit for life rescue sensing and positioning, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a drill bit body, a UWB base station, a nine-axis attitude sensor, a protective shell and a mounting bracket; the UWB base station and the nine-axis attitude sensor are circumferentially arranged and fixed inside the mounting bracket, the mounting bracket is fixed on the outer surface of the drill bit body, the protective housing is located outside the mounting bracket, the top end of the drill bit body is provided with a thread groove, the middle end of the drill bit body is provided with a thread groove and the inside of the protective housing is provided with a central spray pipe, and the central spray pipe and the middle of the drill bit body are provided with an air inlet duct. The problem that the existing down-the-hole hammer drill bit cannot locate and autonomously track trapped personnel in real time in the actual use process, rescue workers cannot clear and know the positions of the trapped personnel, so that rescue work difficulty is increased, and the trapped personnel cannot be timely rescued is solved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 16 BUREAU GROUP BEIJING METRO ENG CONSTR CO LTD;UNIV SHIJIAZHUANG TIEDAO

title_en: Method and System for Locating and Monitoring First Responders
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention can provide for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station. The system and method can include storing the location, motion and orientation data as well as status data, in the event that the communication system is unable to communicate with and transmit information to the monitoring station, the system will wait until communication is restored and transmit the status information to the monitoring station to update the location, motion orientation and status information for the person or asset.
assignees: FUNK BENJAMIN E;BANDYOPADHYAY AMRIT;KOHN ERIC A;GOLDSMAN NEIL;TEOLIS CAROLE A;BLANKENSHIP GILMER L

title_en: Target positioning device used for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates a target positioning device used for airborne equipment. The target positioning device includes a signal processing unit, a laser range finder of which output signals are connected into the signal processing unit, an infrared thermal imager, a visible-light camera, a combination inertial navigation module and a goniometer, wherein the signal processing unit is used for calculating position information of a target according to uploaded various signals. According to the target positioning device used for the airborne equipment of the utility model, aerial carrier GPS information, aerial carrier attitude information, angle deviation of observation equipment relative to a carrier aircraft, and ranging information of the observation equipment for the target are integrated so as to realize accurate positioning of the longitude, latitude and height of the target; the advantages of multiple sensors are combined, and a multidimensional space transformation principle is utilized, such that rapid, effective, non-contact, high-adaptability and accurate positioning of the target can be realized; and the target positioning device can be used in fields such as forest fire prevention, and rapid search and rescue, and has broad technical and market prospect.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENTS & CONTROLS CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for quickly setting up map to assist indoor positioning under emergency rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly setting up a map to assist indoor positioning under an emergency rescue scene. The method comprises the following steps: setting up a three-dimensional map of a target building; obtaining initial position coordinate information of a rescuer entering the target building; reading sensing data and processing the sensing data; deducing the walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment through a pre-stored calculation algorithm; with one of double feet of the rescuer as a reference foot, judging whether the reference foot is in a static state at the current moment, if so, correcting a calculation error and an accumulative position calculation error, and outputting corrected walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment, otherwise, outputting deduced walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment; marking the walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment in the three-dimensional map of the target building. The method provided by the invention is used for dynamically tracking the rescuer in real time and providing assistance for integral command and dispatch of emergency rescue and the life guarantee of the rescuer.

title_en: Emergency positioning method based on mobile anchor point
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for conveniently and quickly positioning trapped people by UWB mobile anchor point dynamic networking. Namely, each search and rescue worker carries a UWB mobile anchor point pull-net type detection signal sent by a UWB label worn by the trapped person; after the signal is found, arranging at least three UWB mobile anchor points near a found point, and taking one of the UWB mobile anchor points as a main anchor point; UWB positioning resolving initial conditions, namely coordinate values of each mobile anchor point can be set visually, and measuring tools or instruments are not needed for surveying the coordinates of the mobile anchor points; the main anchor point calculates UWB label positioning signals detected by the main anchor point and other anchor points in real time in an edge calculation mode, so that the position of the label is determined; and then, a search and rescue person carrying a UWB tag integrated with a portable display terminal gradually approaches the position of the tag of the trapped person according to the position icons of the tag and the tag of the trapped person on the display terminal, and finally finds the accurate position of the trapped person.

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue method and device based on ultra-wideband correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a field search and rescue method and device based on ultra-wideband correction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial data set of a person to be rescued, determining position coordinates of the person to be rescued based on the data set of the person to be rescued, determining estimated coordinates of an IMU at a fourth moment based on the data set of the person to be rescued and a preset step length, updating the initial data set of the person to be rescued according to the estimated coordinates of the IMU at the fourth moment and the distance from the position of the person to be rescued to obtain an updated data set of the person to be rescued, and circularly executing the steps of 102-106 until the estimated coordinates of the IMU and the distance from the position of the person to be rescued are smaller than the preset distance. Through the configuration mode, the position of the personnel to be searched and rescuing can be accurately positioned on the premise of a large-scale UWB positioning system without a plurality of base stations and tags.

title_en: Indoor Positioning System for Fire Alarm System
abstract_en: A building management system tracks occupants of a building in which the building management system is installed and presents information about the occupants, including location information, to first responders during emergency and/or training events. Distributed devices of the building management system receive identification information broadcast by user devices of the occupants and sends the identification information to a control panel of the building management system. Location information for the occupants is generated based on the identification information received from the user devices and stored along with time and date information. This location information is then retrieved and presented to first responders, for example, by displaying a map of the building with icons representing the distributed devices and occupants, based on the location information.

title_en: Indoor buried-type of ultra-wideband anchor device with downlight function
title_ko: 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 uwb 앵커 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is an indoor embedded ultra-wideband (UWB) anchor device having a downlight lighting function. The present invention comprises: a downlight lighting module installed on a ceiling of a certain space in a building and having an LED radiating downlight lighting light; a UWB anchor module attached to the downlight lighting module and performing UWB communication with a UWB tag; an emergency power supply module for supplying commercial power and emergency power to the downlight lighting module and the UWB anchor module; a fixing plate for fixing and coupling the downlight lighting module and the UWB anchor module in close contact with each other; and a microphone for collecting surrounding voice and sound in real time. According to the indoor embedded UWB anchor device having a downlight lighting function, a ceiling-embedded downlight lighting, and a UWB anchor are attached and installed indoors, and the UWB anchor is configured to perform UWB communication with a UWB tag of a firefighter or a demander, thereby measuring and recognizing a precise position of the firefighter or the demander at a fire scene from the outside.
abstract_ko: 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커 장치가 개시된다. 건물 내 소정 공간의 천정에 설치되며, 다운라이트 조명광을 방사하는 LED를 구비하는 다운라이트 조명 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈에 부착되어 설치되며, UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하는 UWB 앵커 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈 및 상기 UWB 앵커 모듈로 상용 전원 및 비상 전원을 공급하는 비상 전원 공급 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈 및 상기 UWB 앵커 모듈을 서로 밀착하여 고정 결합하는 고정용 플레이트; 주변의 음성 및 소리를 실시간 집음하는 마이크로폰을 구성한다.  상술한 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커 장치에 의하면, 실내에 천장 매립형의 다운라이트 조명과 이에 UWB 앵커를 부착하여 설치하고, UWB앵커가 소방관이나 요구조자의 UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하도록 구성됨으로써, 외부에서도 화재 현장의 소방관이나 요구조자의 정밀한 위치를 측정하여 인지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Locate mining device and mining system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the mining device in a kind of location and mining system, locate mining device and comprise a body, described body arranges location and installation chamber, and described location and installation chamber arranges locating module mount pad, it is fixedly installed an indoor positioning module.Described location and installation chamber also arranges a battery, and it connects described locating module mount pad, for being described indoor positioning module for power supply.The above locates mining device can realize precise positioning; trapped personnel can be searched and rescued in time when there is accident of mine disaster, getting valuable rescue time, simultaneously; also can be the track protection of mining site manager realization to miner operation in daily miner operation, to avoid unnecessary security incident.

title_en: Method and apparatus to allow a PSAP to derive useful information from accelerometer data transmitted by a caller's device
abstract_en: A Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) is configured to receive a description of detected movement associated with one or more inertial sensors of a communication device. The description of the detected movement may then be analyzed to determine a likelihood of injury associated with the movement, whether or not the user associated with the communication device is experiencing abnormal neuromuscular activity, and/or whether the user is outside a range of the communication device such that the user is unlikely to hear audio information originating from the communication device. The PSAP may additionally or alternatively utilize the description of the movement information to assist and/or provide an advisory recommendation in the decision of which, if any first responder resources should be dispatched; the recommendation may include which resources and at what priority the resources should be dispatched.

title_en: Heading Orientation Estimation Method Using Pedestrian Characteristics in Indoor Environment
title_ko: 보행특성을 이용한 실내에서의 보행자 이동방향 추정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating a moving direction of a pedestrian in an indoor environment using a walking property. The method for estimating a moving direction of a pedestrian in an indoor environment using a walking property comprises: a waling data obtaining step (S100) obtaining walking data from a signal transmitted in accordance with a walking motion of a pedestrian from an inertial measurement unit (IMU) mounted on shoes of the pedestrian; a pedestrian position estimating step (S200) of estimating the position of the pedestrian using the obtained walking data; and a moving direction correcting step (S300) of correcting a moving direction of the pedestrian to reduce an estimation error of the pedestrian position estimated by the pedestrian position estimating step (S200). The moving direction correcting step (S300) comprises: a pedestrian exercise type determining step (S310) of determining an exercise type of the pedestrian; and a measurement value renewing step (S320) of renewing a measurement value in accordance with the determined exercise type. According to the composition of the present invention, the method for estimating a moving direction of a pedestrian in an indoor environment using a walking property enables a user to accurately grasp the position of a rescuer or a person who needs to be rescued, in an indoor environment in which it is difficult to receive a navigation signal.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a trans-mitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system in the cabin of crewman sea
abstract_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system in a kind of cabin of crewman sea, including：Command centre's server, fence transmitter, crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, crewman's Real Time Localizer, carrier-borne personnel positioning processor and persons falling in water locator, it is by being based on the modern information technologies such as AIS, UWB, big-dipper satellite positioning, single crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, carrier-borne and persons falling in water Real Time Localizer and wounded's vital sign and location data Transmission system are developed, realizes that marine wounded's vital sign monitoring automation, information storage electronization, information transmission network and the wounded give first aid to visualization.

title_en: Fire control is with multi-functional location rescue communication system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control communication, in particular to a multifunctional positioning rescue communication system for fire control, which comprises a communication device, a communication base station, a first mobile communication end and a second mobile communication end, wherein the communication device and the second mobile communication end are respectively in communication connection with the communication base station, and the first mobile communication end is in communication connection with the communication device; escape system software is arranged in the first mobile communication end and can be carried by trapped people; rescue system software is arranged in the second mobile communication terminal and can be carried by firefighters; the communication device comprises a shell, a controller, a first radio frequency module, a 4G signal antenna, a second radio frequency module, a UWB ranging and positioning antenna and a UWB communication antenna, wherein the controller is arranged on the shell; the first radio frequency module and the second radio frequency module are respectively connected with the controller in a communication way, the 4G signal antenna is connected to the first radio frequency module, the UWB ranging and positioning antenna and the UWB communication antenna are respectively connected to the second radio frequency module, and the survival probability of trapped personnel can be improved.

title_en: Indoor positioning system and method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-source information fusion, and discloses an indoor positioning system and method based on multi-source information fusion, wherein the indoor positioning system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, an image enhancement module, a multi-source data fusion and pose resolving module. The data acquisition module acquires external raw data by using different sensors. And the image enhancement module improves the quality of the obtained image data. And the multisource data fusion and pose resolving module fuses the acquired multisource data to obtain fusion data, and the pose information of the system is obtained by resolving the fusion data. The data from the visible light camera, the thermal imaging camera and the inertial measurement unit (I MU) are directly integrated through a tight coupling method, so that the problem of positioning failure when GPS signals are abnormal can be solved, meanwhile, the problem of positioning failure caused by the fact that a large amount of available information is lost in an acquired image when substances such as smoke, dust or water vapor exist in dark environment and air can be solved, and accurate positioning of equipment in various indoor environments is realized.

title_en: WIFI indoor positioning data acquisition equipment and system
abstract_en: The utility model embodiment discloses a kind of WIFI indoor positioning data acquisition equipment, including AP device.AP device includes signal receiving module, memory module, smoke detection module, sound and light alarm module, processor, shell and pedestal.Signal receiving module is used for return pulse signal；Smoke detection module transmits signal to processor for smokescope in detecting chamber.Sound and light alarm module is used to make a sound the warning signal with light beam.Signal receiving module, memory module, smoke detection module, sound and light alarm module and processor are all provided with inside the shell；Cover top portion is equipped with multiple sense cigarette holes；Pedestal passes through multiple set screw connected with outer casing.And then it realizes accurate positioning and meets the needs of user is to functional diversities.Meanwhile WIFI indoor positioning data collection system is equipped with mobile tag, server, keeps orientation management convenient and easy to use.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUANSHU LIHE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable flashlight with indoor positioning terminal and fire-fighting helmet assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable flashlight with an indoor positioning terminal and a fire-fighting helmet assembly, relates to the technical field of fire fighting, and solves the technical problem that the flashlight which is frequently worn by firefighters has a single function and cannot realize indoor positioning of firefighters; the flashlight comprises a buckle, an indoor positioning device and a flashlight body with an illumination part, wherein the buckle is fixed on the flashlight body and used for fixing the flashlight body and other equipment in a clamping manner, one end, deviating from the illumination part, of the flashlight body is provided with an accommodating end, an accommodating cavity is formed in the accommodating end, the indoor positioning device is fixed in the accommodating cavity and communicated with an indoor UWB base station in real time and used for identifying the position of the flashlight body, the flashlight can be used as indoor illumination when a fire-fighting and rescue person is positioned, emergency rescue is facilitated, and the fire-fighting helmet assembly can be used for conveniently illuminating and indoor positioning.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIUBANG FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and Rescue UAV System and Method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-vision multi-mode perception
abstract_en: The invention provides an IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-visual multi-mode perception, which comprises the functional modules of initial calibration and semantic map initialization, pre-integral prediction and key frame judgment, dense point cloud reconstruction and relative pose estimation, semantic embedding extraction, semantic guidance loop detection, semantic three-dimensional map incremental update and the like, wherein IMU motion priori, depth geometric constraint and language model semantic factors are jointly modeled through a graph optimization framework, and high-precision positioning and labeled map construction under a complex dynamic environment are realized. Compared with the prior art which only depends on geometric or inertial information, the invention reduces the loop error matching rate, improves the closed loop convergence efficiency and long-time repositioning robustness, and provides semantic interfaces for upper-layer tasks such as natural language navigation, target retrieval and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of service robots, security inspection, intelligent driving, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Direction and distance measuring method based on inertial navigation and pseudo-range
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of search and rescue positioning, in particular to a direction and distance measuring method based on inertial navigation and pseudo range. The invention can realize the positioning of the target to be rescued by using the search and rescue equipment with single antenna, reduce the cost of the search and rescue equipment, and solve the problems of the installation of the traditional double-antenna array search and rescue equipment on a small airplane and the interference of the installation environment of double antennas on the reflection of wireless signals; the positioning accuracy can be improved along with the increase of the interrogation times, and the defects that each interrogation response of the double-antenna array is independently solved, and the positioning accuracy cannot be improved due to multiple interrogation responses are overcome; and the phase characteristics of the channel and the antenna are not required, which is different from the condition that the phase balance of the channel and the antenna is high in the dual-antenna array.

title_en: Real-Time Managing Evacuation of a Building
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 00, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building, triggered by alarm notification (S202). Based on determined (S214) precise real-time positions of personal ultra-wide band, UWB, devices, as determined by UWB real-time localization system, RTLS, a controller determines (S210) evacuation plans being personal UWB device specific in real-time. Based on individual evacuation plans and input from building facilities, real-time guidance information is defined (S208) and sent to each personal UWB device, providing guidance to person carrying said personal UWB device, in what direction to move (S212), to reach a safe area. Based on localization signals the UWB RTLSA then calculates updated positions of the personal UWB devices and sends to the evacuation management system. It is an advantage that trapped or injured people can be found, even in low visibility areas.

title_en: Underwater acoustic signal detection method based on rydberg atomic radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic signal detection method based on a rydberg atomic radar. According to the invention, the performance of the traditional radar is upgraded by the capability advantages of the rydberg atoms in the aspects of high-sensitivity electromagnetic signal sensing, ultra-wideband multi-band parallel signal detection and the like, so that the requirements of micro-Doppler water surface fluctuation measurement are met; meanwhile, in view of the fact that the working frequency of the underwater acoustic signal is larger than the fluctuation frequency of the water surface waves, high-pass filters can be used for extracting high-frequency effective information from low-frequency strong background noise, and a brand-new, feasible and performance-upgraded underwater acoustic signal detection means is provided for underwater exploration, hydrological measurement, diving search and rescue and the like.
assignees: NETWORK INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE OF SYSTEM ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE OF MILITARY ACADEMY OF SCIENCE

title_en: Underground personnel positioning and tracking method based on laser ranging
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground coal mine positioning, and discloses an underground personnel positioning and tracking method based on laser ranging, which comprises the steps of calculating the distance between nodes through ranging signals between UWB mobile nodes, and establishing a relative positioning model of the UWB mobile nodes by combining preset fixed base station coordinates; registering and aligning a first local octree map of a collapse area with a relative positioning model, fusing heterogeneous data of a laser radar and a UWB sensor in time and space dimensions to form an initial positioning result of trapped personnel, acquiring real-time data of a second local octree map and the relative positioning model of the UWB under the extreme condition of communication blockage or signal interruption, predicting the position of the trapped personnel, updating the position coordinates of a mobile node of a rescue personnel in real time according to a path planning result after local obstacle avoidance adjustment, and correcting the positioning data of the trapped personnel through a graph optimization algorithm. The invention solves the positioning problem under the complex environment of the mine collapse disaster site.

title_en: Method and device for cluster configuration and round allocation for uwb communication
abstract_en: An operation method of an electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: identifying two-way ranging (TWR) values for multiple anchors; configuring a first cluster including a first initiator anchor and first responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; configuring a second cluster including a second initiator anchor and second responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; and allocating a ranging round to each of the first cluster and the second cluster.

title_en: A kind of amphibious unmanned boat of Quick rescue
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to unmanned boat technical field, and in particular to a kind of amphibious unmanned boat of Quick rescue.Wherein, including：Hull, cabin, mast, master controller, power plant module, communication module, power module and monitoring modular, cabin is installed at the top of hull stage casing, mast is installed on the afterbody of hull, and the top of mast is provided with headlamp, communication antenna and camera by rotating ring；Power plant module includes Cross-country wheel, engine, propeller and autopilot；Communication module includes image radio station, location communication device and inertial navigation equipment；Power module includes storage battery, charger and generator；Monitoring modular includes minisize gyroscopes and depth of water inductor；Master controller is commander's maincenter.The amphibious unmanned boat can timely respond to waterlogging rescue demand, and route is not known in cell of passing through；Using all transitable feature in its land and water, to carrying out organized conveying by rescuer；It is oriented to without manpower, meets the demand of the Quick rescue under waterlogging environment.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGBANG DEFENSE INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Track tracking and positioning filtering system and fusion navigation method of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A track tracking positioning filtering system and a fusion navigation method of a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belong to the field of navigation of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles. The track tracking module and the automatic tracking return module of the track tracking positioning filtering system are fixedly arranged on the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the track tracking module is in signal connection with the automatic return module, and the automatic return module is in signal connection with the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the rotation angle of the gyroscope; calculating the rotation angle of the navigation platform; speed and position descriptions; defining a state vector of an inertial navigation system and a Beidou combined system; constructing a fusion measurement position vector by using the measurement of the Beidou receiver; a filtering method based on unscented Kalman filtering uses unscented transformation techniques to approximate the probability distribution of nonlinear system states. The invention can track and record the path of the unmanned aerial vehicle in search and rescue, provide simple dangerous environment and condition positioning for staff, and provide expected preparation for further search and rescue work.

title_en: Automatic determination of defibrillation pad location on patient's chest
abstract_en: A medical device uses UWB units to infer a position of an adjunct positioned in proximity to an exterior portion of a patient's body. The position information can be used to provide CPR feedback to a rescuer. In other applications, the position information can be used to provide prompts to a user to change the position of the adjunct.

title_en: A location tracking system for a building indoor
title_ko: 구조물 실내 위치 추적시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A location tracking system for an inside of a building is provided to easily identify a rescuer from a command center by monitoring a location of the rescuer located in a building in real time. CONSTITUTION: A relay(102) is installed in an external fixed position of a building(101) for performing rescue. A terminal is worn by a rescuer entering the inside of the building. A command center(110) is installed outside the building. The command center receives final location information from the terminal. The command center manages the rescuer by displaying the location of the rescuer on a monitor. The relay includes a GPS(Global Positioning System) reception module, a reception data process module, and a wireless communication module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 구조물의 내부에 진입하는 구조자의 위치를 실시간으로 지휘센터 또는 관제센터에서 확인 가능하여 용이하게 할 수 있고, 구조자가 위험상황에 처하였을 때에도 정확한 위치파악으로 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 한 구조물 실내 위치 추적시스템에 관한 것으로서, 
구조작업을 수행하고자 하는 구조물의 외부 소정의 위치에 구비하는 중계기와, 구조물 내부로 진입하는 구조자가 휴대 또는 착용하는 단말기와, 상기 구조물의 외부에 설치되어 단말기로부터 최종위치정보를 제공받아 모니터에 구조자의 위치를 실시간으로 표시하여 추적 관리하는 지휘센터로 구성하는 것이 특징이다.

title_en: Independently distributed search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device is searched for andd rescue to autonomic distributing type, the crawler-type chassis is installed to the bottom of automobile body, there is six degrees of freedom robotic arm at the upper end middle part on crawler-type chassis through bolted connection, there is UWB wireless range finding orientation module upper end of six degrees of freedom robotic arm through bolted connection, there is intelligent camera module at the front end middle part on crawler-type chassis through bolted connection, AMG8833 thermal imaging module is installed to the lower extreme of intelligent camera module, STM32 single chip microcomputer system's rear end is connected with communication system. Adopt the hot imaging module of AMG, the stranded personnel of discernment that can be accurate can send the coordinate and the picture condition of stranded personnel to the rescue personnel the very first time, can the search and rescue of zero clearance high strength, the work efficiency of effectual improvement rescue, scalability is high, can increase and decrease the quantity of robot wantonly, and does not influence the operating condition of robot, and the use scene is nimble.
assignees: GUOKE ZHEJIANG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest team firefighter positioning system, method, equipment and medium based on wearable equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a forest team firefighter positioning system, a method, equipment and a medium based on wearable equipment, and relates to the technical field of forest accurate positioning, wherein the system comprises: the wearable device worn on the body of the firefighter comprises a head positioning module, a lower limb positioning module and a waist positioning module, wherein the head positioning module is used for positioning the firefighter based on satellite positioning to obtain first position information, meanwhile, positioning the firefighter based on UWB positioning to obtain second position information, the lower limb positioning module is used for positioning thighs, calves and feet of the firefighter based on inertial positioning to obtain third position information, fourth position information and fifth position information, and the head positioning module is used for obtaining the position information of the firefighter based on five position information. The application can combine three positioning modes of satellite positioning, UWB positioning and inertial positioning to position forest firefighters, and can accurately position forest firefighters.

title_en: Method and apparatus for cluster configuration and round assignment for uwb communication
title_ko: Uwb 통신을 위한 클러스터 구성 및 라운드 할당 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, provided is an operating method of an electronic device which includes the following steps of: identifying two-way ranging (TWR) values for a plurality of anchors; configuring a first cluster including a first initiator anchor and first responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; configuring a second cluster including a second initiator anchor and second responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; and allocating a ranging round to each of the first cluster and the second cluster. Therefore, during UWB communication, an optimal anchor role can be assigned and an optimal cluster can be configured.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 다양한 실시예에 따른 전자 장치의 동작 방법은, 복수의 앵커들에 대한 TWR (two-way ranging) 값들을 확인하는 단계와, 상기 TWR 값들에 기반하여, 제1 initiator 앵커와 제1 responder 앵커들을 포함하는 제1 클러스터를 구성하는 단계와, 상기 TWR 값들에 기반하여, 제2 initiator 앵커와 제2 responder 앵커들을 포함하는 제2 클러스터를 구성하는 단계와, 상기 제1 클러스터 및 상기 제2 클러스터 각각에 레인징 라운드를 할당하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster site three-dimensional mapping system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster site mapping, and discloses a disaster site three-dimensional mapping system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The system comprises a control unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a multispectral sensor for carrying out omnibearing scanning on a disaster site, collecting earth surface deformation data and multiband reflectivity data, carrying out time sequence alignment and noise filtering on the collected data, constructing an initial three-dimensional point cloud through dynamic voxelization processing, merging inertial measurement unit data to correct space positions, identifying earth surface fracture zone edge and elevation mutation characteristics from the point cloud, dividing geological stability subareas by combining the reflectivity data, carrying out multilevel detail division on the stability subareas by adopting a self-adaptive octree segmentation algorithm, automatically adjusting grid resolution according to fracture zone density to generate a three-dimensional topological structure of the disaster site, calculating earth surface displacement vectors and sedimentation gradients through comparing historic and current three-dimensional data, marking potential secondary disaster risk areas, and realizing accurate evaluation and risk early warning of the disaster site.

title_en: Emergency callingElevator emergency call system equipped with the function of utilizing passengers' personal information
title_ko: 비상통화호출승객 신상정보 활용기능을 구비한 엘리베이터 비상통화 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an elevator emergency call system having a function for utilizing personal information of passengers who have made an emergency call, which enables a manager to know personal information of passengers who have made an emergency call, thereby efficiently rescuing the passengers in need of rescue. The present invention comprises: a main unit installed in a machine room of an elevator; a sub-unit installed inside a car of the elevator and connected to the main unit, the sub-unit having a microphone, a speaker, a camera, a monitor, a Bluetooth, and a UWB transceiver built in, and having an emergency call button connected; a management office unit installed in a management office, connected to the main unit, and connected to the microphone, the speaker, the camera and the monitor; a control server installed in the management office and displaying a personal information screen comprising the name, age, type of disability, phone number and address of a person requiring rescue on the monitor of the management office unit and the monitor of an operation PC; and an operation PC installed in the management office and connected to the control server. The present invention has the effect of allowing the manager to easily obtain information about the elevator that was in the emergency call when the emergency call connection is disconnected and then physically/electrically restored during the emergency call, thereby allowing the manager to call the passengers again with a simple click call.
abstract_ko: 이 발명은 비상통화호출승객 신상정보 활용기능을 구비한 엘리베이터 비상통화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 이 발명의 구성은, 엘리베이터의 기계실에 설치되는 주장치와, 엘리베이터의 카내부에 설치되며, 상기 주장치와 연결되며, 마이크로폰, 카메라, 모니터, 블루투스 및 UWB 송수신기가 내장되어 있으며 비상호출버튼이 연결되어 있는 자기와, 관리실에 설치되며, 상기 주장치와 연결되며, 마이크로폰과 스피커와 카메라와 모니터가 연결되어 있는 관리실기와, 관리실에 설치되며, 주장치와 관리실기와 연결되어 엘리베이터 번호 및 모기 위치를 포함한 비상통화와 관련된 데이터를 관리하고 저장함과 동시에 요구조자의 성명, 나이, 장애종류, 전화번호, 주소로 이루어지는 신상정보 화면을 관리실기의 모니터와 운영 PC의 모니터에 표시하는 관제서버와, 관리실에 설치되며, 관리실에 설치되어 있으며 상기 관제서버와 연결되는 운영 PC를 포함하며, 상기 관제서버에는 정부 또는 지방자치단체에 등록되어 있는 지체장애자, 치매환자에 대한 신상정보(성명, 나이, 장애종류, 전화번호, 주소)가 미리 저장되며, 정부 또는 지방자치단체에 등록되어 있는 지체장애자, 치매환자의 스마트폰에는 엘리베이터 비상상황과 관련된 스마트폰앱이 설치된다.

title_en: Ad hoc network positioning system based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ad hoc network positioning system based on UWB, which comprises a long-distance Bluetooth gateway or a UWB base station, 1 or a plurality of fixed-point tags, 1 or a plurality of nearby tags and a server. The invention adopts a mechanism combining UWB and Bluetooth, and coordinates the master-slave relation M and the fixed point relation A of the label while reducing the power consumption, and confirms the self-positioning condition F; meanwhile, the ranging result is uploaded through Bluetooth, so that the ranging result can be conveniently received by a Bluetooth gateway or other intelligent equipment such as a tablet, a mobile phone and the like with Bluetooth, and the position information is further analyzed and displayed on a map; and self positioning and navigation can be realized. The firefighter carrying the tag can acquire the position information of the member carrying the tag at any time through the industrial tablet, and can support teammates through navigation or arrange personnel nearby for support. Because the data is directly transmitted from the tag to the tablet personal computer or the smart phone, the data does not need to be forwarded through a cloud platform or a server and the like, and the time delay of the position data is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting protective clothing
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent fire-fighting protective clothing, comprising: the fire-fighting backpack is internally provided with a wireless radio frequency identification system, an electronic instrument, a battery, a circuit board and an oxygen cylinder, the upper part of the protective suit is provided with a protective mask and a head-mounted display, and the circuit board is connected with the electronic instrument of the fire-fighting backpack, the battery, the protective mask and the head-mounted display; the top of the protective mask is provided with a camera, and a thermal inductance image is displayed in a thermal inductance image head-mounted display; the intelligent watch also comprises an RFID reader and an intelligent watch, and is used for detecting the blood pressure, the heart rate and the oxygen value of a wearer; the microphone is used for realizing a remote video intercom function; the help caller sends out warning information to team members through a sound or visual warning device when the wearer is static or trapped; the communication system and the inertial navigation module are used for positioning personnel in real time; the fire-fighting backpack is externally provided with a temperature sensor for detecting the ambient temperature, and the temperature sensor can automatically alarm through a prompting lamp, a sound alarm and a vibrator when the ambient temperature exceeds a set value.
assignees: RUENTEX RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument. The multifunctional life detection instrument comprises a control terminal, a life detection device carrying out data exchange with the control terminal, and a charging and discharging cell and a power source circuit which provide power for the control terminal and the life detection device, wherein the life detection device comprises a main control module carrying out data exchange with the control terminal, and a UWB electromagnetic detector, a micro vibration detector and an audio video detector which are respectively connected with the main control module to realize data interaction, and the control terminal controls switching among the three modes of the UWB electromagnetic detector, the micro vibration detector and the audio video detector. The multifunctional life detection instrument is advantaged in that high precision is realized, life rescue under various conditions can be adapted, powerful guarantee is provided for disaster rescuers, and the technological level and the equipment level in aspects of earthquake relief work and life saving of the country are effectively improved.

title_en: Automatic tracking method and system for dust removing equipment based on UWB technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic tracking method and system of dust removing equipment based on UWB technology, which comprises the steps of arranging at least three UWB positioning base stations in a workshop, wearing UWB positioning labels for each worker, installing a multi-axis intelligent lifting hook integrated with a smoke purification dust hood on an overhead track of the workshop, ranging the UWB positioning base stations and the UWB positioning labels by using a DS-TWR bilateral two-way ranging method to obtain distance information, calculating real-time three-dimensional coordinates of the worker according to the distance information of a plurality of base stations based on a trilateral positioning principle, combining preset safe hovering height according to the coordinates of the target worker, generating lifting hook target point coordinates, transmitting the lifting hook target point coordinates to a lifting hook control system, generating lifting hook running tracks based on a track planning algorithm, carrying out real-time control based on the lifting hook running tracks, and feeding back the lifting hook coordinates, speed, the working state of a smoke purification device and fault alarm information. The applicability and the acceptance of the system are improved.
assignees: KEMENG WIND POWER EQUIPMENT TANGSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-wideband MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wide band radar signal processing, and discloses an ultra wide band MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method. The invention mainly comprises the following steps: (1) rearranging the echo data of a plurality of channels of the MIMO radar; (2) performing sequential inertial coherent imaging and compensation on the target area; (3) band-pass filtering along a time dimension; (4) calculating the position of the surface of the thorax of the living body; (5) removing clutter and direct current bias; (6) taking phases to obtain vital sign signals; (7) the respiratory and heartbeat signals are separated. (8) Detecting the peak values of the respiration and heartbeat signals, and calculating the instantaneous respiration rate and the heart rate; (9) sliding time window dynamic measurements. The invention can be used for carrying out three-dimensional positioning and vital sign measurement on trapped people in ruins and buildings, has high signal processing gain, high positioning precision and good real-time performance, and can realize instantaneous respiration rate and heart rate measurement.

title_en: Man-machine cooperation method and system for emergency rescue service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a man-machine cooperation method and a man-machine cooperation system for emergency rescue service, which comprise the following steps: s1, a robot end collects data through UWB, an odometer, a laser radar and a camera, and an operator end collects data through UWB and an IMU; s2, estimating an operator motion trail based on the IMU, estimating a robot motion trail based on the wheel type odometer, constructing a constraint function by using UWB distance measurement values, and realizing pose optimization and man-machine cooperation positioning by fusing mileage information and UWB measurement data through a graph optimization algorithm; and S3, an operator utilizes the pointing device and the touch screen to realize man-machine information interaction through a wireless network, and based on the optimized man-machine cooperation positioning result, the robot fixed-point exploration and formation following are completed by combining laser radar data. The invention can perform man-machine cooperation better.

title_en: One kind is shed with water proof type infrared light smoke detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to shed with water proof type infrared light smoke detector, including smoke detector ontology, the smoke detector ontology is internally provided with air flue, the on both sides of the middle of the air flue is symmetrically arranged with infraluminescence pipe and infrared photodiode, one end end two sides of the air flue are symmetrically arranged with electrode contacts A and electrode contacts B, the other end end two sides of the air flue are symmetrically arranged with electrode contacts C and electrode contacts D, the electrode contacts A, electrode contacts B, electrode contacts C, electrode contacts D, infraluminescence pipe and infrared photodiode pass through conducting wire and connect with control circuit board box, the control circuit board box is fixed at the inside center of smoke detector ontology.The present invention solves the problems, such as that traditional smoke sensor device is difficult to quick, accurate measurements region smog near the ground in the adverse circumstances such as emergency management and rescue by setting infraluminescence pipe, infrared photodiode and acceleration inertial sensor.
assignees: COMPREHEND SUZHOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene smoke scene positioning and mapping method and device based on millimeter wave radar inertia combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene smoke scene positioning and mapping method and device based on millimeter wave radar inertia combination, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring inertial data and point cloud data; obtaining posture information of the human body based on the inertial data, estimating the step length of the human body based on the constraint of human kinematics and the inertial data, and determining the position information of the human body; lifting the sparse high-noise millimeter wave radar point cloud data to obtain dense point cloud data; and mapping the dense point cloud data to a global coordinate system through the posture information and the position information of the human body to construct a map. The invention is applied to the field of navigation positioning, aims at the characteristic that the movement of emergency rescue personnel is complex and changeable, and realizes navigation positioning by detecting gait and calculating position and posture through an inertial device based on the constraint of human kinematics; and mapping the point cloud data to a global coordinate system through the position and posture information to construct a map, so as to realize real-time positioning and map construction positioning of personnel in a smoke environment.

title_en: Track tracking and positioning filtering system and fusion navigation method of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A track tracking positioning filtering system and a fusion navigation method of a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belong to the field of navigation of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles. The track tracking module and the automatic tracking return module of the track tracking positioning filtering system are fixedly arranged on the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the track tracking module is in signal connection with the automatic return module, and the automatic return module is in signal connection with the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the rotation angle of the gyroscope; calculating the rotation angle of the navigation platform; speed and position descriptions; defining a state vector of an inertial navigation system and a Beidou combined system; constructing a fusion measurement position vector by using the measurement of the Beidou receiver; a filtering method based on unscented Kalman filtering uses unscented transformation techniques to approximate the probability distribution of nonlinear system states. The invention can track and record the path of the unmanned aerial vehicle in search and rescue, provide simple dangerous environment and condition positioning for staff, and provide expected preparation for further search and rescue work.
assignees: HARBIN TIANSHU WENDAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Man-machine cooperation method and system for emergency rescue service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a man-machine cooperation method and a man-machine cooperation system for emergency rescue service, which comprise the following steps: s1, a robot end collects data through UWB, an odometer, a laser radar and a camera, and an operator end collects data through UWB and an IMU; s2, estimating an operator motion trail based on the IMU, estimating a robot motion trail based on the wheel type odometer, constructing a constraint function by using UWB distance measurement values, and realizing pose optimization and man-machine cooperation positioning by fusing mileage information and UWB measurement data through a graph optimization algorithm; and S3, an operator utilizes the pointing device and the touch screen to realize man-machine information interaction through a wireless network, and based on the optimized man-machine cooperation positioning result, the robot fixed-point exploration and formation following are completed by combining laser radar data. The invention can perform man-machine cooperation better.

title_en: Cooperative positioning and track planning method based on air-ground robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a co-positioning and track planning method based on an air-ground robot system, which comprises the following steps: the unmanned aerial vehicle utilizes the laser radar to construct a global environment map and position the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle combines the IMU and the UWB ranging chip to obtain the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and each unmanned aerial vehicle, so as to estimate the pose in real time. Based on the fused pose and global map information, a method of combining mixed A search with nonlinear track optimization is adopted, a collaborative track planning problem is converted into a multi-constraint optimization model, the problems of view distance quality, unmanned vehicle formation geometry and unmanned vehicle rapid navigation among space robots are comprehensively considered, and a collision-free optimization collaborative track meeting the kinematic constraint of the multi-robots is generated in real time. The method remarkably improves the positioning precision and the cooperation degree of the air-ground cooperation system in a complex dynamic environment, and provides a safe, efficient and real-time heterogeneous multi-robot track planning method for various application scenes such as inspection, search and rescue, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: System and method for tracking location of rescue worker in disaster building
title_ko: 재난건물 내에서 구조대원의 위치추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난건물 내에서 구조대원의 위치추적시스템은 재난 건물에 존재하는 적어도 하나 이상의 광선 투과 윈도우를 향해 구분 가능한 광 점멸 주파수를 갖는 점멸 광선을 출력하고, 상기 점멸 광선의 상기 재난 건물 내의 도달 지점에 대응하는 광선 도달점 위치를 검출하는 위치 검출기; 구조대원에 의해 휴대되며, 상기 점멸 광선에 의해 상기 재난 건물 내의 상기 광선 도달점 위치에 형성된 광선 이미지를 촬영하고, 촬영된 광선 이미지를 전송하는 대원 단말기; 및 상기 위치 검출기로부터 수신된 상기 점멸 광선에 대한 상기 광선 도달점 위치 및 상기 대원 단말기로부터 수신된 상기 광선 이미지로부터 산출된 광 점멸 주파수를 이용하여, 상기 대원 단말기를 휴대하는 상기 구조대원의 실내 위치를 결정하는 위치 추적 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Mining disaster rescue robot based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot and a mine disaster monitoring method based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition, which relate to the technical field of mine disaster rescue robots, the mining disaster rescue robot based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition mainly comprises an image processing and edge calculating unit, a UWB positioning module, an inertia measuring unit, a laser radar, a binocular depth camera, a thermal imager, a sound sensor, a gas sensor, an RGB camera, a motion control unit and a power supply system. By implementing the mining disaster rescue robot and the mining disaster monitoring method based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition, the positioning precision and autonomous navigation capability of the rescue robot in a complex mine environment can be improved, and the accuracy and the instantaneity of judging the states of trapped workers are improved.

title_en: Digital fire-fighting individual communication system and data perception acquisition communication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital fire-fighting individual communication system and a data perception acquisition communication method, which comprise a core communication terminal and a plurality of networking nodes, wherein the core communication terminal is assembled on a scene fire-fighting individual, and has a plurality of network communication modes, is carried by the fire-fighting individual, can be in wireless interconnection and intercommunication with one or a plurality of networking nodes nearby, and can carry out audio and video communication with scene actual combat command platform commander of other scene fire-fighting individual or scene command parts. According to the invention, the information acquisition and communication equipment are highly integrated, so that the effective fusion of the individual fire fighting system equipment is realized, the individual combat load is reduced, and the individual flexible combat advantage is better exerted; the UWB-Tag is applied to realize the position location of the UWB base station, a method for information communication exchange between two networks is established, the difficulty of position acquisition of individual firefighters in indoor and outdoor spaces, particularly in the internal combat process of complex buildings, is solved, and the individual safety protection capability of the individual firefighters in the emergency rescue process can be effectively improved.

title_en: Life detection positioning method and system for mine drilling rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection and positioning method and system for mine drilling rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting an area to be detected by using back-to-back ultra-wideband radars placed in a borehole, obtaining radar echo matrixes in each preset direction of the area to be detected, and preprocessing each radar echo matrix; determining each initial direction in which the trapped person is located and the radar echo matrix preprocessed in each initial direction according to the preprocessed radar echo matrix in each preset direction; determining the distance between trapped personnel corresponding to each initial direction and the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar according to the radar echo matrix preprocessed in each initial direction; and determining the position of the trapped person based on the distance between the trapped person corresponding to each initial direction and the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar. According to the technical scheme, the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar is used for detecting the positions of trapped people, so that the calculated amount is small, and the three-dimensional positions of the trapped people can be rapidly and accurately determined.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Through-the-wall magnetoquasistatic positioning
abstract_en: Magnetoquasistatic through-the-wall non-line-of-sight coupling between a mobile transmitting device located within a building, or indoor, and a fixed receiving device located outside the building, outdoor, enables positioning of the transmitting device through the wall of the building and in non-line-of-sight environments. Systems based on magnetoquasistatic coupling can separately sense the distance and orientation of the transmitting device accurately even in heavy non-line-sight environments such as steel-reinforced buildings. The approach permits sensing and determination of location and attitude of mobile devices in buildings and can be used to locate rescue workers, first responders, or law enforcement officers inside a building.

title_en: Method for simultaneously positioning and mapping autonomous mobile platform in rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simultaneously positioning and mapping an autonomous mobile platform in a rescue scene, which is applied to the search and rescue autonomous mobile platform and can be used for positioning and mapping in extreme environments such as a fire rescue scene, a complex dangerous accident scene and the like. The method mainly comprises three parts of sensor information processing, pose estimation and pose correction. Firstly, performing operations such as deblurring, feature extraction and the like on the omnibearing image information acquired by the four-eye camera module. Then, fusing the position and the measurement information of the inertial navigation sensor, estimating the pose, and finally, carrying out global pose optimization correction. The method designs a full-automatic end-to-end defogging method based on the convolutional neural network, does not need post-processing steps, has wide application range, and can be simultaneously applied to defogging of indoor and natural scenes. Meanwhile, a relatively stable binocular vision SLAM method based on a feature point method is adopted to fuse IMU sensor data to locate and build a map of the autonomous mobile platform.

title_en: Human body target and surrounding structure compatibility detecting method based on UWB (Ultra Wideband) bio-radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body target and surrounding structure compatibility detecting method based on a UWB (Ultra Wideband) bio-radar, comprising the following steps: a preprocessing step A, a human body target detecting step B and a structure detecting step C. Since most of survivors pressed and buried in ruins after an earthquake and other disasters are buried in holes formed under the ruins is considered, a certain space is formed between the survivors and the ruins, and the medium in the space is air. The detection and identification are realized on the upper and lower interfaces of the holes according to the limited conditions and the human body target position information, so that more accurate and more comprehensive ruins structure information can be obtained in the follow-up study, and new thinking can be provided for the application and development of a UWB search and rescue bio-radar technology.

title_en: A kind of memory method for path navigation based on individual soldier's Intelligent visible glasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of memory method for path navigation based on individual soldier's Intelligent visible glasses, include the following steps：One, the building interior planogram data of command centre's transmission is received, the key element in data is extracted, is plotted on Intelligent visible glasses with block diagram form；Two, the location information of real-time reception inertial navigation set transmission, and the data received are saved in local data base；Three, according to inertial navigation location information, Intelligent visible spectacle plane schematic diagram is simultaneously switched to the layer by floor where judging individual soldier, matches coordinate relationship, map location point and progress path where drawing individual soldier；Four, judge whether be currently the state of withdrawing.The present invention is using Intelligent visible glasses as platform, comprehensive utilization inertial navigation technology, network transmission technology, can provide evacuation route for fire-fighting individual soldier in the case where dense smoke visibility is low and navigate, its is assisted safety quick to withdraw the scene of a fire.
assignees: 28TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Search and rescue ware based on ultra wide band suitable for environment in pit
abstract_en: Disclosed is an ultra-wideband based search and rescue apparatus suitable for use in a downhole environment, comprising: a data processing unit; an ultra-wideband radio frequency unit communicably connected to the data processing unit; and a power supply unit for the data processing unit and the ultra-wideband radio frequency unit; the ultra-wideband radio frequency unit is configured to communicate with a positioning identifier carried by a person to be searched and rescued based on an ultra-wideband communication technology to obtain communication data, and the data processing unit is configured to process the communication data to obtain positioning data of the person to be searched and rescued, wherein the positioning data comprises distance information between the person to be searched and rescued and the search and rescue device and direction information of the person to be searched and rescued relative to the search and rescue device. Therefore, the search and rescue device can realize the positioning of the personnel to be searched and rescued based on the ultra-wideband communication technology, and can obtain the distance information and the direction information of the personnel to be searched and rescued at the same time.
assignees: BEIJING YONGAN XINTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene smoke scene positioning and mapping method and device based on millimeter wave radar inertia combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene smoke scene positioning and mapping method and device based on millimeter wave radar inertia combination, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring inertial data and point cloud data; obtaining posture information of the human body based on the inertial data, estimating the step length of the human body based on the constraint of human kinematics and the inertial data, and determining the position information of the human body; lifting the sparse high-noise millimeter wave radar point cloud data to obtain dense point cloud data; and mapping the dense point cloud data to a global coordinate system through the posture information and the position information of the human body to construct a map. The invention is applied to the field of navigation positioning, aims at the characteristic that the movement of emergency rescue personnel is complex and changeable, and realizes navigation positioning by detecting gait and calculating position and posture through an inertial device based on the constraint of human kinematics; and mapping the point cloud data to a global coordinate system through the position and posture information to construct a map, so as to realize real-time positioning and map construction positioning of personnel in a smoke environment.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Novel Slam indoor positioning navigation method based on monocular camera
abstract_en: A novel Slam indoor positioning navigation method based on a monocular camera relates to the technical field of navigation positioning, wherein a video stream transmitted by an unmanned aerial vehicle is analyzed through a system platform AI system, a background contour is identified and separated from an image, posterior estimation comparison is carried out based on HF-Net, and accurate position data are finally obtained; the unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission system is high in practicability and very convenient to use, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be quickly subjected to data transmission and positioning by means of a 4G network, the use cost is saved, the damage of the unmanned aerial vehicle during operation in a high-temperature high-smoke environment can be reduced, and the service life of the unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged.
assignees: ZHENJIANG RUNTU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine equipment control system and control method based on gesture analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gesture analysis-based coal mine equipment control system and a gesture analysis-based coal mine equipment control method, which are characterized in that an RGB camera and a thermal infrared instrument are spliced left and right to form a camera device, a camera device is installed on a fully mechanized working face every 6 hydraulic supports, a camera device is installed on an equipment train every 10 meters, a camera device is installed at a position where fully mechanized equipment is arranged in a mine roadway, a GPU (graphic processing unit) power calculating server and a control server are deployed in a control center, UWB positioning labels are attached to each self-rescuer equipment, wireless buttons of a signal sending module are fixed for each UWB positioning label, a UWB positioning base station is arranged in the mine every 200 meters, the UWB positioning base station is communicated with the UWB positioning labels in a communication range of the UWB positioning base station, and the UWB positioning base station and the camera device are connected with the GPU power calculating server and the control server through a switch. The invention can reduce the manpower and labor of operators, ensure the safety of the operators and realize intelligent control.
assignees: SICHUAN AEROSPACE ELECTRO & HYDRAULIC CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Aerial search positioning processor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication equipment, and particularly discloses an aerial search positioning processor which comprises a case, and a power module, a CPU module, an I/O module and a motherboard which are arranged in the case, wherein the power module, the CPU module and the I/O module are electrically connected with the motherboard. According to the invention, by utilizing related information provided by devices such as a communication radio station, a lifesaving radio station, a GNSS/BD Beidou transceiver, an inertial navigation system and the like, the current position of a carrier, the position of a search target, a search track, a straight flight path and other comprehensive search and rescue conditions are displayed on a display controller, so that the air search and rescue efficiency is improved, search and rescue, positioning and instant state confirmation of people and articles falling into water are completed, and the identification of the rescued target on an electronic digital map is completed.
assignees: XIAN LONGZI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for position estimation of first responders
title_ko: 긴급 구조원의 위치 결정 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 재난 복구 시 신속 배치 가능한 응급 통신 시스템에서 긴급 구조원의 실내 위치 측정 방법이 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 긴급 구조원의 위치 결정 방법은 복수의 앵커 노드에서 수신되는 신호에 기초하여, 앵커 노드와 긴급 구조원 사이의 거리를 추정하는 단계, 거리에 기초하여, 복수의 앵커 노드 중에서 최적의 앵커 노드 집합을 결정하는 단계, 최적의 앵커 노드 집합에 기초하여, 긴급 구조원의 위치를 결정하는 단계를 포함하고, 앵커 노드는 스틸 얼라이브 액세스 포인트(still-alive access points ; SAPs) 및 헬퍼 액세스 포인트(helper access points ; HAPs) 중 적어도 하나를 포함한다.

title_en: Multi-axis scout robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-axis scout robot which comprises a machine body and a flight control panel. Four rotor wing pieces are installed at the positions of four corners of the machine body respectively, every rotor wing piece is connected with a motor, the flight control panel is installed at the central position of the machine body, a global positioning system (GPS) sensor is installed at one end of the flight control panel, the other end of the control panel opposite to the end is provided with a high-definition camera, a three-axis gyroscope is installed at the central position of the flight control panel, a magnetometer and a three-axis acceleration sensor are arranged on two sides of the three-axis gyroscope respectively, and a barometer is installed between the three-axis gyroscope and the GPS sensor. The multi-axis scout robot has the advantages that the three-axis gyroscope and the three-axis acceleration sensor are installed on the multi-axis scout robot to form an inertial navigation module, and the multi-axis scout robot can rapidly fly through an electronic regulator; functions of speed setting, height setting, heading locking and automatic return flight and the like can be achieved, and scout and search and rescue tasks can be finished excellently under the matching of the camera.

title_en: Inertial navigation assisted radio direction correction method in complex environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a radio direction-finding correction method assisted by inertial navigation in a complex environment, which can be used for the inertial navigation assisted radio direction-finding correction of a long-distance complex aviation search and rescue application scene, under the condition that a direction-finding device of a carrier receives interference such as shielding, the information of the position and the heading of the carrier output by inertial navigation is combined with the direction-finding information measured by a directional device, and the single plane flying Duan Duo point measurement information is utilized to carry out cross positioning, single positioning precision is improved through clustering, and then the multi-plane flying section measurement information is utilized to gradually improve global target positioning precision, so that the direction-finding result is corrected, and the orientation precision and reliability of the aviation search and rescue orientation equipment are greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL;SHAANXI FENGHUO ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: System and method for performing indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring on fire man
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for performing indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring on a fire man. The system comprises a main control circuit board based on an STM32 (Scanning Tunneling Microscope 32) singlechip, a GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) data transmission module based on Sim-900, a GPS (Global Positioning System) module, a remote monitoring client side, an inertial navigation module I and an inertial navigation module II, wherein the main control circuit board is respectively connected with the GPRS data transmission module, the GPS module, the inertial navigation module I and the inertial navigation module II by virtue of serial ports; and the GPRS data transmission module communicates with the bound remote monitoring client side by utilizing a GPRS network. The system and the method can be used for realizing the indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring for the fire man, accurately recognizing and judging the motion state of the fire man and meanwhile realizing the indoor and outdoor 3D seamless positioning for the fire man; aiming at the application occasion of the fire man, the system can be expanded to be provided with a poisonous gas sensor, a smoke sensor, a temperature sensor and the like, and has great significance in guaranteeing the life safety of the fire man working under a complex fire scene environment.

title_en: Building interior fire emergency navigation positioning system and method
