abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency navigation positioning system and method in a building, wherein the system comprises handheld positioning devices, a fire emergency lamp, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor, wherein each handheld positioning device is provided with a UWB positioning tag and a second UWB transceiver; each fire-fighting emergency lamp is provided with a power supply, a display screen and a processor, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor are installed in each fire-fighting emergency lamp and are connected with the processor and the power supply, and the first UWB transceiver is used for sending corresponding signals and self positioning data to the processor when receiving UWB signals of a UWB positioning tag; the processor is used for calculating and sending positioning data and environmental data of the handheld positioning device, judging the unblocked condition of the channel and controlling the display screen to indicate an escape route according to the judgment result and the environmental data. The invention can provide the smooth condition of the internal passage of the building and the distribution condition of the trapped personnel for the fire fighters, and improve the disaster relief efficiency.

title_en: Building interior fire emergency navigation and positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building interior fire emergency navigation positioning system, which comprises a handheld positioning device, a fire emergency lamp, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor, wherein each handheld positioning device is provided with a UWB positioning tag and a second UWB transceiver; each fire-fighting emergency lamp is provided with a power supply, a display screen and a processor, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor are installed in each fire-fighting emergency lamp and connected with the processor and the power supply, and the first UWB transceiver sends corresponding signals and positioning data of the first UWB transceiver to the processor when receiving UWB signals of a UWB positioning tag; the processor sends the positioning data and the environmental data of the trapped person to the trapped person and the rescue personnel handheld positioning device through the first UWB transceiver, and the processor is connected with and controls the display screen. The utility model discloses can provide the unblocked condition and the stranded personnel distribution condition of building inner channel for the fire fighter, improve the efficiency of rescuing.

title_en: Handheld instrument suitable for accurate positioning of coal mine personnel and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handheld instrument suitable for accurately positioning coal mine personnel, which comprises a shell, a power supply, a voltage conversion circuit, a UWB radio frequency chip, a power amplifier, a UWB signal receiving and transmitting antenna, a microcontroller, a Bluetooth communication module, a Bluetooth signal receiving and transmitting antenna and a touch display screen. The invention provides three working modes to meet the search and rescue requirements under different situations, and the accurate positioning of the tag/base station is realized by effectively combining the three working modes, thereby being beneficial to search and rescue personnel under a mine; meanwhile, parameter configuration, operation management and firmware updating are carried out on the tags/base stations by combining the Bluetooth communication module, so that the positioning accuracy of other tags can be improved and the tag power consumption can be reduced by reasonably setting the working mode of each tag in the search and rescue process besides the convenience of daily management.
assignees: NANJING WO XU WIRELESS CO LTD

title_en: Accurate positioning method and system for firefighter in full-task scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for accurately positioning firefighters in a full-task scene, which comprises the following steps: intelligent fire hydrant system module: referencing a positioning beacon, monitoring the health state, detecting the fire and predicting the situation, and guiding the alarm and the task; the movable intelligent reference positioning system module comprises: the method comprises the steps of referencing a positioning beacon, autonomously positioning to acquire information through an IMU (inertial measurement unit), and resolving reference positioning; wearable individual positioning system: the positioning tag is referenced, the accurate position is calculated by receiving signals, information is obtained by self-positioning, task guidance is carried out, and physiological information is monitored; fire control task control commander terminal system module: positioning monitoring personnel, monitoring and predicting fire situation, optimizing and commanding tasks, monitoring equipment state, displaying and controlling; a central processing server module: monitoring information, optimizing tasks and guidance, resolving and positioning, and managing a database. The invention provides a method for accurately positioning fire fighters and guiding tasks in a full task stage.
assignees: JIANGSU DEYANJIA SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an escape suit arranged near a fire hydrant box of a fire safety key unit and a fire control room arranged on a fire rescue vehicle, wherein the escape suit is arranged in the fire control safety key unit; the escape suit is provided with a low-power-consumption wireless signal transmission module which is communicated with the outside in a severe environment and is implanted into a building escape route map, an indoor positioning system and an enhanced learning escape route planning algorithm based on Q-learning; the fire control room is provided with an information receiving module and an escape route guidance algorithm based on real-time fire and LSTM; in case of a fire, when the field personnel take the escape suit to move quickly, the line signal transmission module of the escape suit automatically starts to guide personnel to evacuate, and the line signal transmission module is communicated with the fire control room and the fire rescue vehicle in real time, so that the combination of fire scene self rescue and fire rescue personnel search and rescue is realized, the survival rate is effectively improved, and the damage degree of the fire scene personnel is reduced to the maximum extent.
assignees: SUZHOU INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY JIANGSU UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Sea surface UWB positioning data precision improving method based on EKF and LSTM fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea surface UWB positioning data precision improving method based on the integration of an EKF and an LSTM, which is used for inhibiting NLOS errors and multipath effects through the physical model constraint of the EKF and the time sequence feature learning capability of the LSTM, improving the positioning precision in a complex sea surface environment, designing a positioning framework combining data driving and physical models, realizing long-term stable positioning in a dynamic environment, solving the problems of error accumulation and poor adaptability of the existing method, constructing an integrated positioning system, realizing the full-flow high-precision processing from data acquisition, filtering and result fusion through modularized design, and meeting the requirements of ocean engineering on the positioning precision. The invention effectively suppresses NLOS error and multipath effect, solves the problem of poor adaptability of the existing method to dynamic environment, has strong portability of software algorithm, is suitable for practical scenes such as ship navigation, ocean search and rescue, and has remarkable engineering application value.
assignees: NO 20 RESEARCH INST OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Fire scene firefighter cooperative relay positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire scene firefighter cooperative relay positioning method and a system. According to the number of UWB base stations which can be communicated by the tag to be positioned, the UWB base stations are divided into multiple priorities, and then targeted positioning is carried out. Aiming at the first priority label, UWB and INS are combined, NLOS error in UWB ranging value is weakened under the condition that UWB base station is sufficient but is mostly in NLOS environment, and positioning accuracy of the first priority label is improved. And then combining the positioned labels with the corresponding UWB base stations as a reference node, aiming at other priority labels, adopting a UWB-based cooperative positioning algorithm according to the conditions of the UWB base stations distributed around the labels and the mobile anchor points, and carrying out relay positioning on the labels to be positioned in a grouping positioning mode, thereby improving the positioning rate of the other priority labels. The invention can reduce the requirement of positioning on high distribution density or long communication radius of UWB base stations, and maximally uses the whole co-positioning network resource, thereby acquiring more positioning reference information.

title_en: Intelligent reflecting surface-assisted ultra-wideband indoor positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent reflection surface-assisted ultra-wideband indoor positioning method, which relates to the technical field of communication facilities, wherein an intelligent reflection surface receives ultra-wideband pulse signals, selects different beam forming schemes, dynamically generates and applies optimal phase configuration parameters to reflection units, user equipment receives ultra-wideband signals from a direct path and a path reflected by the intelligent reflection surface, calculates distance information, performs comprehensive position calculation by combining an arrival time difference or an arrival angle algorithm, estimates three-dimensional coordinates of the user equipment, updates the phase configuration parameters, constructs a closed-loop feedback optimization loop, and iteratively executes until final three-dimensional position coordinates of the user equipment are calculated. The invention also provides an ultra-wideband indoor positioning device, which comprises an ultra-wideband base station, user equipment and an intelligent reflecting surface, wherein the intelligent reflecting surface is provided with a passive reflecting unit for independently regulating and controlling the phase. The invention is suitable for complex indoor and outdoor environments and meets the high-precision positioning requirements of urban traffic, personnel guidance, disaster sites, logistics and the like.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a transmitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: Low smoke and zero halogen is pressure device for insulating material production
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an insulating material production technical field especially relates to a low smoke and zero halogen is pressure device for insulating material production, the on-line screen storage device comprises a base, a pedestal top fixedly connected with brace table, brace table top swing joint has the rotation wheel, the axis position swing joint who rotates the wheel has the rotation cover, the inside fixedly connected with diamond-shaped block of rotation cover, the both ends of diamond-shaped block all articulate there is the connecting rod, the one end of connecting rod articulates there is the fly leaf. The to-be-solved technical problem of the utility model is that the cooperation through hydraulic push rod, brake lever and fly leaf is used, make the cable when needs emergency braking, the drive wheel can in time stop, the rotation wheel of avoiding continues to rotate the potential safety hazard that causes because of inertial principle, lifting means's security performance, therefore, the clothes hanger is strong in practicability, use through the cooperation of brake block, fly leaf and hydraulic push rod, avoided traditional cable upper portion to need great pressure and make the cable receive the damage, practiced thrift manufacturing cost.
assignees: HENAN ZHUOLIN HIGH MOLECULAR NEW MAT CO LTD

title_en: Infant dectection system in vehicle based on ultra-wideband impluse-radio
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a UWB-based non-contact impulse radar-based vehicle infant occupancy detection system and, more specifically, to a UWB-based non-contact impulse radar-based vehicle infant occupancy detection system, in which a UWB sensor unit is installed on an upper end of a rear seat of a vehicle to measure a bio-signal of a passenger who is a monitoring target for monitoring an infant occupancy state of the vehicle in a non-contact manner, and an estimated distance between a guardian or a driver and the vehicle is measured through Bluetooth signal strength (RSSI) to monitor the occupancy state in a smartphone application through Bluetooth communication based on the measured bio-signal data and the measured estimated distance data between the guardian or the driver and the vehicle, and at the same time, a warning command signal is transmitted to a guardian terminal even if the guardian or the passenger (driver) deviates from the vehicle in the infant occupancy state to notify the guardian terminal audiovisually and immediately, thereby preventing an infant from being trapped in the vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 차량의 뒷 좌석 상단에 UWB 센서부가 설치되어, 비접촉식으로 차량의 유아 재실 상태를 모니터링하기 위한 모니터링 대상자인 탑승자의 생체 신호를 측정하고, 보호자 또는 운전자와 차량 사이의 추정 거리를 블루투스 신호 세기(RSSI)를 통해 측정하여 상기 측정된 생체 신호 데이터와 보호자 또는 운전자와 차량 사이의 측정된 추정 거리 데이터를 기초로 하여 블루투스 연통을 통해 스마트폰 앱에서 재실 상태를 모니터링함과 동시에, 유아 재실 상태에서 보호자 또는 탑승자(운전자)가 차량으로부터 이탈하더라도 보호자 단말로 경고 명령 신호를 전송하여 시청각적으로 즉각 통지할 수 있도록 하여 차량내 유아 갇힘 사고를 예방할 수 있는 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Life body double-station cooperative detection method based on single-channel ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life body double-station cooperative detection method based on a single-channel ultra-wideband radar. The method can effectively detect a plurality of different strong and weak life body targets, can extract the distance information of each life body target relative to two radars at one time, can solve the position information of the life body target without pairing processing, can effectively reduce the false alarm and false alarm leakage probability under the condition of multiple targets, improves the accuracy and robustness of human body target detection, and can meet the requirement of detecting weak vital signs of a plurality of trapped persons under the occasions of disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: Inertial measurement unit for fire fighting scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inertial measurement unit for a fire fighting scene. The inertial measurement unit comprises an inertia information sensing assembly, a magnetic field intensity sensing assembly, a temperature sensing assembly, an environment sensing assembly, a man-machine interaction assembly, an alarming assembly, a data processing assembly, a data transmission assembly and a battery; the inertial measurement unit is mainly applied to occasions that indoor environments such as fire rescue scenes and disaster search and rescue scenes are severely damaged, is installed on a fireman body, can overcome the defects that a traditional saving alarm cannot locate in real time and causes false alarm, and also can overcome the defects that a traditional inertial measurement unit cannot perform environment sensing and sound-light alarming; the inertial measurement unit has the advantages of simple structure, high starting speed, low false alarm rate, strong stability, high locating precision and prognosis of dangerous cases, is particularly suitable for beig used in the fire rescue scenes for locating a firemen in real time, sensing the scene environment and effectively guaranteeing the safety.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING INF SCI & TECH;BEIJING DEWEICHUANGYING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Battle tracking system and method aiming at firefighters at fire scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a battle tracking system and method aiming at firefighters at a fire scene. The system comprises shoe bodies, position labels and a fire fighting commanding system, wherein each shoe body is provided with a micro control unit, a GPS module, an inertial navigation system module, a label identifying module, an environment induction sensing module, an alarming module, a communication module and a power supply in the position of the heel of a sole; the label identifying modules are used for identifying the position labels in a building through scanning and obtaining the three-dimensional absolute coordinate values of the positions where the labels are placed; the shoe bodies are communicated with the fire fighting commanding system for data transfer through the communication modules. The battle tracking system has the benefits as follows: the positioning system is combined with the special shoes of firefighters, so that the real-time position tracking of battle firefighters at the fire scene and the real-time detection monitoring on the fire scene disaster situation can be implemented, and the real-time positions of firefighters and the fire scene disaster situation can be fed back to commanders through the communication modules in time, therefore, the commanders can control the overall situation conveniently, the safety of people's lives and properties can be guaranteed furthest, and the fire damage is reduced.

title_en: Positioning mining device and mining system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positioning mining device and a mining system. The positioning mining device comprises a body; the body is provided with a positioning installation chamber which is provided with a positioning module installation base; an indoor positioning module is fixedly arranged on the positioning module installation base; the positioning installation chamber is also provided with a battery which is connected with the positioning module installation base and used for supplying power for the indoor positioning module. According to the positioning mining device, the accurate positioning can be implemented, the trapped people can be timely rescued when mine accidents occur, the precious rescue time can be earned, and meanwhile the tracking protection on the miner operation can be implemented for mine field managers in the daily miner operation so as to avoid safety accidents.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in outer space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D ball-joints at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axis according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application i.e. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Alarm and indication system for starting process of multi-turboprop engine of amphibious aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm and indication system for the starting process of a multi-turboprop engine of an amphibious aircraft, which is characterized in that: the lifting wheel-mounted annunciator (115) acquires parameters such as engine ignition control, fuel oil, lubricating oil, torque, engine speed, exhaust temperature and the like and wheel-mounted signals; the collector (102) collects the sensor signals, the inertial navigation system (103) collects ground speed signals, and the radio altimeter (104) collects airplane altitude signals; the system processor (101) receives signals of the collector (102), the inertial navigation system (103) and the radio altimeter (104), and identifies the engine starting alarm state after comprehensive processing. The method can solve the problem of engine starting process alarm when the amphibious aircraft executes a water surface task, reduce the interference of unnecessary engine starting alarm to the unit when the amphibious aircraft executes the water surface task, reduce the operation load of the unit, further more rapidly execute a water surface search and rescue task, and meet the requirements of civil airworthiness standard in China.

title_en: Target positioning method and device for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target positioning method and a target positioning device for airborne equipment. The device comprises a signal processing unit, a laser distance measuring instrument, a thermal infrared imager, a visible light camera, a combined inertial navigation module and an angle meter, wherein output signals of the laser distance measuring instrument, the thermal infrared imager, the visible light camera, the combined inertial navigation module and the angle meter are all connected to the signal processing unit, and the signal processing unit is used for solving positional information of a target according to uploaded signals. Aerial carrier global positioning system (GPS) information, aerial carrier gesture information, angular deviation of observation equipment relative to an aerial carrier and distance measuring information of the target by the observation equipment are integrated to realize accurate positioning of longitude and latitude height of the target. The advantage of a multi-sensor is combined, a multi-dimensional spatial alternation principle is utilized so as to rapidly and effectively realize accurate target positioning in a non-contact and high-adaptability way, and the target positioning method can be applied to fields such as forest fire prevention, personnel rapid search and rescue and the like, and has wide technological and market prospects.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Underground tunnel rescue method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an underground tunnel rescue method and system, which comprises the following steps of automatically starting up and self-checking emergency lamps in a tunnel after a tunnel accident occurs, synchronously starting up a LoRa ad hoc network to construct a distributed positioning network, receiving data by a command center terminal to generate a tunnel equipment layout diagram after the network is built, enabling rescue workers to wear an ultra-wideband terminal to enter the tunnel, connecting the distributed positioning network formed by the emergency lamps with an emergency base station capturing terminal signal, calculating the positions of the workers through a triangular positioning algorithm of 3 adjacent emergency base stations and transmitting the positions to the command center, and switching at least 2 emergency lamps around the area into a stroboscopic mode to form a guide light band by the command center if the workers approach to a trapped area, wherein the brightness of the emergency lamps in the tunnel depth can be adjusted. According to the scheme, the emergency lighting flexibility is improved, the positioning accuracy is improved, the lighting, positioning and commanding are integrated, the rescue safety is guaranteed, and the intelligent horizontal lifting of tunnel rescue is promoted.
assignees: SHANGHAI URBAN CONSTRUCTION SMART CITY OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: System and method for performing indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring on fire man
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for performing indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring on a fire man. The system comprises a main control circuit board based on an STM32 (Scanning Tunneling Microscope 32) singlechip, a GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) data transmission module based on Sim-900, a GPS (Global Positioning System) module, a remote monitoring client side, an inertial navigation module I and an inertial navigation module II, wherein the main control circuit board is respectively connected with the GPRS data transmission module, the GPS module, the inertial navigation module I and the inertial navigation module II by virtue of serial ports; and the GPRS data transmission module communicates with the bound remote monitoring client side by utilizing a GPRS network. The system and the method can be used for realizing the indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring for the fire man, accurately recognizing and judging the motion state of the fire man and meanwhile realizing the indoor and outdoor 3D seamless positioning for the fire man; aiming at the application occasion of the fire man, the system can be expanded to be provided with a poisonous gas sensor, a smoke sensor, a temperature sensor and the like, and has great significance in guaranteeing the life safety of the fire man working under a complex fire scene environment.

title_en: UWB antenna, UWB positioning tag and indoor positioning system
abstract_en: The application provides a UWB antenna, UWB location label and indoor positioning system relates to UWB location field. This application is through printing radiating element paster and feed paster on the first plane of medium base plate, and make the radiating element paster connect the feed paster gradually, in order to guarantee radiating element paster and feed paster impedance match, then through printing the ground plane paster on the second plane relative with the first plane of medium base plate, and make the ground plane paster be connected with the feed paster, in order to realize the feed ground function of feed paster, thereby guarantee that the UWB antenna that obtains belongs to small and low cost's printing plate antenna. In addition, this application is through having seted up a fluting structure in ground plane paster's position department that corresponds with the radiating element paster, makes ground plane paster realize its ground function simultaneously, also can carry out the frequency trapped wave to the radiating element paster to ensure that the UWB antenna that obtains has higher radiation efficiency.

title_en: Emergency positioning searching device, method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency positioning searching device, a method and a system, wherein the emergency positioning searching device comprises: the ultra-wideband PDOA module is used for precise distance measurement and azimuth angle measurement; the MPU module is used for configuring the working mode of each module, managing communication and reading and writing operation and processing of data information; the wireless data transmission module is used for data interaction between the emergency positioning search and rescue device and the background server; the power supply module is used for supplying power to each module; the emergency fixed search device also comprises a display module for displaying the working state of the emergency fixed search device and the distance and direction information of a person seeking help or an object to be searched relative to the emergency fixed search device; the emergency positioning search and rescue searching device further comprises a key module used for manually sending a distress signal and switching the working modes of the emergency positioning search and rescue searching device. The system can realize interactive positioning between firefighters on site, know accurate position information of the person seeking help in real time, reduce rescue difficulty and improve rescue efficiency.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU LOCARIS ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-wideband MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wide band radar signal processing, and discloses an ultra wide band MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method. The invention mainly comprises the following steps: (1) rearranging the echo data of a plurality of channels of the MIMO radar; (2) performing sequential inertial coherent imaging and compensation on the target area; (3) band-pass filtering along a time dimension; (4) calculating the position of the surface of the thorax of the living body; (5) removing clutter and direct current bias; (6) taking phases to obtain vital sign signals; (7) the respiratory and heartbeat signals are separated. (8) Detecting the peak values of the respiration and heartbeat signals, and calculating the instantaneous respiration rate and the heart rate; (9) sliding time window dynamic measurements. The invention can be used for carrying out three-dimensional positioning and vital sign measurement on trapped people in ruins and buildings, has high signal processing gain, high positioning precision and good real-time performance, and can realize instantaneous respiration rate and heart rate measurement.

title_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and rescue method in the cabin of crewman sea
abstract_en: One kind is based on positioning in the cabin of crewman sea, it is positioned in the crewman sea cabin of vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system, vital sign monitors and rescue method, the system comprises command centre's servers, fence transmitter, crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, crewman's Real Time Localizer, carrier-borne personnel positioning processor and persons falling in water locator, this method is by being based on AIS, UWB, the modern information technologies such as big-dipper satellite positioning, develop single crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, carrier-borne and persons falling in water Real Time Localizer and wounded's vital sign are transmitted with location data, realize marine wounded's vital sign monitoring automation, information storage electronization, information transmission network and the wounded give first aid to visualization.

title_en: A firefighting time check system and flashlight
title_ko: 소방시간 체크시스템 및 상기 체크시스템에서 사용되는 무선통신용 인식칩을 장착한 손전등
abstract_en: A firefighting time check system according to the present invention can use a communication method such as an ultra-wideband (UWB) method or radio-frequency identification (RFID) scanner method by installing a wireless communication recognition chip such as an RFID, an UWB chip to an absolutely portable flashlight when a fireman goes into fires or various disaster sites. It can easily check the access and the position of the fireman who goes to the fire or various disaster sites. The access time of the fire site of firemen can be accurately managed by an access control scanner which can check access through the recognition chip of the flashlight. The proper compensation and placement for the firemen can carried out by managing a fire fighting time at the firefighting site of the firemen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 소방시간 체크시스템은 소방관등이 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동 시 반드시 휴대하는 손전등에 RFID, UWB칩 등의 무선통신용 인식칩을 장착하여 UWB 방식 또는 RFID 스캐너방식 등과 같은 통신방식을 이용할 수 있어 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동하는 소방관등의 입출입 및 위치를 손쉽게 파악할 수 있으며, 상기 손전등의 인식칩을 통해 입출입을 체크할 수 있는 출입통제 스캐너에 의하여 소방관들의 화재현장의 입출입시간이 정확하게 관리될 수가 있게 되어 소방관들의 소방현장에서 소방작업시간이 철저하게 관리되어 소방인력의 적절한 보상과 인력배치가 가능하게 된다.

title_en: One kind is shed with water proof type infrared light smoke detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind to shed with water proof type infrared light smoke detector, including smoke detector ontology, the smoke detector ontology is internally provided with air flue, the on both sides of the middle of the air flue is symmetrically arranged with infraluminescence pipe and infrared photodiode, one end end both sides of the air flue are symmetrically arranged with electrode contacts A and electrode contacts B, the other end end both sides of the air flue are symmetrically arranged with electrode contacts C and electrode contacts D, the electrode contacts A, electrode contacts B, electrode contacts C, electrode contacts D, infraluminescence pipe and infrared photodiode are connect by conducting wire with control circuit board box, the control circuit board box is fixed at the inside center of smoke detector ontology.The utility model solves the problems, such as that traditional smoke sensor device is difficult to quick, accurate measurements region smog near the ground in the adverse circumstances such as emergency management and rescue by the way that infraluminescence pipe, infrared photodiode and acceleration inertial sensor is arranged.
assignees: COMPREHEND SUZHOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic path planning and intelligent navigation return method and system for firefighter safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning and intelligent navigation return method and system for firefighter safety, which relate to the field of path planning and comprise the steps of acquiring data of fire scene air pressure, distance, gesture and the like through various sensors such as an air pressure sensor, UWB, an electronic compass and the like, acquiring three-dimensional positioning coordinates of firefighters through a fusion algorithm, recording tracks and marking characteristic points to construct a path database, dynamically planning an optimal path through an improved A-algorithm after evaluating dangerous grades by combining environment parameters, judging lost road through positioning continuity and the like, triggering return, tracing back to generate a reference path through a reverse track and correcting, sending search and rescue requests when UWB signals are lower than a threshold value, optimizing the position and guiding directions through triangular positioning, constructing a manual and automatic multi-scene alarm mechanism, and synchronously transmitting alarm related data through multiple channels. The intelligent fire scene matching system has the advantages that the fire scene complex environment is adapted by combining accurate three-dimensional positioning with dynamic path planning, intelligent return and collaborative search and rescue, and the operation safety and emergency treatment efficiency of firefighters are ensured.
assignees: BEIJING ORIENTAL DRAGON FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for evaluating object damage degree of disaster site by utilizing skeletonizing technology
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the damage degree of an object in a disaster site by using a skeletonizing technique includes moving the position of a survey robot for analyzing information in a disaster site space to a first position by using at least one sensor module including a laser radar sensor, an inertial measurement unit sensor, and one or more visual sensors, acquiring sensing information corresponding to the first position by locating a map on the fly, identifying a facility segment in the first space by using the sensing information, acquiring visual crack identification information analyzed from visual image information of the sensing information and unit crack information corresponding to the visual crack identification information by using the facility segment, determining the crack expansion risk corresponding to the unit crack information, and constructing disaster site evaluation information in the first space by using the crack expansion risk and outputting the information to one or more devices.
assignees: NAT INSTITUTE OF PHYSICAL AND SAFETY

title_en: Search and rescue UAV system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Precision Aerial Firefighting and Deluge System for Helicopters and Unmanned Aerial Systems
abstract_en: The precision aerial firefighting and deluge system for helicopters and unmanned aerial systems is a device to attack fires inaccessible to firefighters due to altitude or other obstructions by streaming water or other fire retardant into or onto a specific location on the ground, on the water, or at altitude. The system employs a medium or heavy lift helicopter or unmanned aerial systems one or more tanks or bladders for water and/or fire retardant chemicals, a compressed air foam system, a pump, rigid plumbing lines for outflow of water/fire retardant; a rigid, telescopic boom that extends beyond rotor tip path plane, flexible lines/hoses inside boom; a crew switched electronic boom controller, a boom management system, a flange adapter, an electric, variable direction, crew-controlled fire monitor, a drop-hose, and a dart with inertial feathers.

title_en: Indoor positioning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an indoor positioning method and system, wherein the indoor positioning method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional coordinate map according to the installation positions of a plurality of detection devices in a building; controlling each detection device to detect the trapped person and acquiring detection data; and determining the position of the trapped person according to the detection data and the position coordinates of each detection device in the three-dimensional coordinate map. Through the application, the problem that the position of the trapped person cannot be quickly positioned in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Firefighter gait and posture detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting gait and posture of a firefighter, which comprises the following steps: each time the firefighter takes a step, the corresponding basic state parameters are obtained through measurement of the sensors; deriving the basic state parameters to obtain extended state parameters; judging the movement gait or gesture of the firefighter according to the basic state parameters and the expansion state parameters of the firefighter and the state judgment criteria; and transmitting the determined movement gait or gesture data of the firefighter back to the command end. The invention embeds an inertia processing layer, and judges the action state of personnel by analyzing the inertia data (speed, position and attitude angle) independently, analyzes the actions of fire fighters and classifies the actions as follows: normal walking, running, resting, creeping forward, free falling, going upstairs, downstairs and the like; the method monitors the actions and the gesture and posture properties of the firefighter in real time only through the inertial sensors arranged on the feet, and performs flexible early warning under the condition that the firefighter is unconscious and cannot communicate.

title_en: Mining UWB wireless positioning base station and positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining UWB wireless positioning base station and a positioning system. Mining UWB wireless positioning basic station has circuit board (6), its characterized in that: be provided with control chip (4), first UWB radio frequency chip (3) and POE interface (5) on circuit board (6), first UWB radio frequency chip (3) have two at least, and antenna (2) that correspond are all connected to each first UWB radio frequency chip (3), can be used to the power supply of data transmission and circuit board (6) after POE interface (5) wiring. The utility model has simple structure and reasonable design, can realize the real-time positioning of underground workers, and is convenient for monitoring management and quick search and rescue in positioning.
assignees: WENZHOU YANCHUANG INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of can long-range monitoring human vital sign unmanned plane device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to it is a kind of can long-range monitoring human vital sign unmanned plane device, including unmanned plane detection device and ground intelligent terminal；By ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR device carry below unmanned plane, be equipped with transmitting antenna and receiving antenna, the direction of the transmitting antenna and receiving antenna vertically downward, towards ruins direction；The unmanned plane is equipped with airborne computer, can determine whether human life according to radar antenna signal；The judging result of airborne computer is sent to ground intelligent terminal by the unmanned plane detection device；The ground intelligent terminal has terminal interface, shows the position where unmanned plane on terminal interface on map, and the regional scope that unmanned plane detection device is searched and rescued may be selected, and control unmanned plane detection device is back and forth flown in selected region.Personnel search and rescue after the present invention can be widely applied to calamity, can use the high maneuverability of unmanned plane, the human life signal under a wide range of quick detection ruins.

title_en: Indoor positioning search and rescue system and method based on microwave technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning search and rescue system and method based on microwave technology, and the indoor positioning search and rescue system comprises a microwave antenna module (1), a circulator (2), a radio frequency transceiver module (3), a signal processor (4), an infrared temperature measurement module (5) and a positioning module (6), wherein the microwave antenna module (1) is connected with the circulator (2), the circulator (2) is connected with the radio frequency transceiver module (3), the radio frequency transceiver module (3) is connected with the signal processor (4), and the signal processor (4) is connected with the infrared temperature measurement module (5) and the positioning module (6). Has the advantages that: the radio frequency technology has low cost and wide radiation area distance. The search can be performed without lighting. The search precision is high, and the method is suitable for search and rescue work of different targets.
assignees: WANCHUANG HUIKE CHONGQING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless remote control life detector for rescue searching
abstract_en: A life detector for wireless remote control rescue search belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and aims to solve the problems that the imaging effect of a radar detector and the detection precision of trapped people are affected due to the fact that the number of antennas causes high grating/side lobe levels when the existing radar life detector transmits ultra-wideband signals; according to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle main body is provided with the radio-frequency radar and the far-infrared camera for aerial detection, the unmanned aerial vehicle main body receives instructions from an operator under the action of the remote control antenna, so that control of a flight track and operation of radar detection equipment are realized, the radio-frequency radar emits ultra-wideband signals, electromagnetic wave irradiation detection is performed by using the spiral antenna array, meanwhile, the far-infrared camera captures thermal imaging data of a target point, the data are processed and analyzed by each functional module in the intelligent control computer, and the image optimization module optimizes images by adopting a weighted coherence factor processing method, so that grating/sidelobe levels are effectively inhibited, and resolution and detection accuracy of the images are improved.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensor configured transmitting cradle head
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting launching cradle head, in particular to a launching cradle head with multi-sensor configuration. According to the invention, through organically integrating yaw and pitching movements of the cradle head, continuous transmission of power supply and data signals, accurate delivery and emission of the fire extinguishing bomb and co-location of multiple sensors on the same carbon fiber base plate, the system structure is remarkably simplified, the overall quality is reduced, real-time fusion and correction of flight control data, industrial cameras, laser ranging and inertial attitude data in the high-speed rotation process are realized, the fire extinguishing bomb emission precision and response speed are greatly improved, and the fire extinguishing bomb has stronger adaptability and stability in a complex environment, and the problems of inaccurate positioning and unstable throwing of the fire extinguishing bomb caused by unmanned aerial vehicle flight vibration and fire scene smoke interference are effectively solved.

title_en: Measuring Method of Searcher's Indoor Position
title_ko: 탐색자의 실내 위치 측위 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system (indoor positioning system) and a method for accurately identifying the position of a searcher inside a building at low cost. Provided is an indoor positioning method of a searcher, which comprises: a step in which at least three portable UWB anchors (1, 2, 3) are installed outside a building where GPS signals are receivable; a step in which GPS location information (p1, p2, p3) of each UWB anchor is transmitted to an external remote server via a mobile communication module (7); a step in which UWB communication is performed and signal arrival information, calculated by an operating module (6), is transmitted to the external server via the mobile communication module (7); and a step in which the external server calculates the exact position of a signal receiver to determine the accurate indoor position of the searcher.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 탐색자의 실내 위치 측위 방법에 관한 것이다. 

본 발명은, 탐색자의 위치 측위 방법에 있어서, 
재난 현장에 출동한 탐색자들에 의해 건물 내부에 진입하기 전에 적어도 3개의 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3)이 GPS신호 수신이 가능한 건물 외부 장소에 설치되는 단계;. 각 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3)이 내부의 GPS모듈(5)을 통해 파악한 각 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3)들의 GPS 위치 정보들(p1, P2, p3)이 이동통신 모듈(7)을 통해 외부 원격 서버로 전송되는 단계; 탐색자들이 소지하는 각 신호수집기와 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3) 사이에 UWB통신모듈(4)을 통한 UWB통신이 수행되어 연산모듈(6)에서 계산된 신호수집기 신호 도달 관련 정보들이 이동통신 모듈(7)을 통해 외부 서버로 전송되는 단계; 수신된 상기 GPS위치 정보(p1, P2, p3)와 신호수집기 신호 도달 관련 정보들을 이용하여, 외부 서버가 신호수집기의 정확한 위치를 계산하여 탐색자의 정확한 위치를 파악하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 

이상과 같은 본 발명을 이용하면, 작은 비용으로 건물 내부의 탐색자의 위치를 정확히 파악하는 것이 가능해 진다.

title_en: Search and Rescue UAV System and Method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: 3d positioning using 3d imaging, lidar, imu, and 3d ultrasound
abstract_en: The invention focuses on enhancing indoor positioning and navigation through advanced synchronous fusion methodologies that integrate various technologies, including Inertial Navigation Systems (INS), Inertial Measurement Units (IMU), LiDAR, stereo vision, and Sonar. This comprehensive system aims to achieve high-precision data collection with centimeter-level accuracy, crucial for creating detailed three-dimensional indoor maps. A significant aspect of this innovation is its ability to address privacy concerns by incorporating measures that abstract sensitive segments of the environment when necessary, ensuring personal privacy is maintained during data collection. Additionally, the system tackles challenges such as voids in stereo imaging and temperature variations in ultrasound and LiDAR measurements through sophisticated algorithms and corrections, including back propagation techniques that utilize stereo depth data. By employing particle swarm optimization and Neuro-Fuzzy algorithms, the framework enhances the accuracy and reliability of navigation in complex environments, making it particularly beneficial for emergency responders and personal navigation in unfamiliar settings.

title_en: Search and rescue UAV system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Portable intelligent fire-fighting rescue terminal
abstract_en: A portable intelligent fire-fighting rescue terminal comprises a data acquisition device and an intelligent device based on an Android system. The data acquisition device comprises a microcontroller, a smog / toxic gas sensor, a temperature sensor, a heart rate sensor, an accelerometer, a ZigBee wireless transmission module, a bluetooth module, a sound and light alarm module, a one-key calling module and a power supply circuit. The microcontroller is directly connected to the smog / toxic gas sensor, the temperature sensor, the heart rate sensor, the accelerometer, the ZigBee wireless transmission module, the bluetooth module, the sound and light alarm module and the one-key calling module separately. The intelligent device is connected to the data acquisition device via the bluetooth module to set up communication. The terminal allows visiting an upper level server and visiting external networks via Internet. The terminal accurately achieves indoor positioning of firefighters, allows automatic networking and information exchange, and transmits field conditions of a fire, heart rates and motion status of firefighters and emergency alarm information to a monitoring center and commanding people to satisfy the needs of field rescue.

title_en: UWB technology-based factory personnel positioning system
abstract_en: The factory personnel positioning system based on the UWB technology comprises a server, a UWB base station, a UWB tag, an alarm unit and a positioning calibration unit, wherein the server comprises a factory map drawing module, a signal receiving module, an instruction sending module and a processing module, the UWB base station is arranged in a factory and can communicate with the UWB tag and position the UWB tag, and meanwhile the UWB base station can transmit signals with the server signal receiving module through the signal sending module. According to the invention, the UWB base station is arranged on the factory, meanwhile, the factory personnel carry the UWB tag, and the UWB base station can communicate with the server, so that the position of the factory personnel can be monitored in real time, the factory personnel can be warned to avoid entering the dangerous area through the warning unit when the factory personnel is about to enter the dangerous area, meanwhile, the specific position of the factory personnel can be rapidly known when an accident occurs on the factory, and therefore, the personnel trapped on the factory can be rescued, the probability of occurrence of the safety accident in the factory personnel is reduced, and the safety of the factory personnel is ensured.
assignees: HANDAN HONGLIAN ZHIYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety monitoring system suitable for firefighter training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring system suitable for firefighter training, relates to the technical field of firefighting training safety, and aims to solve the problems of difficult personnel positioning, communication distortion delay, low efficiency of video monitoring and untimely safety intervention in the existing firefighting training. The system comprises a personnel positioning subsystem based on UWB, a real-time communication subsystem based on WebRTC and a training guide management subsystem, wherein the UWB personnel positioning subsystem realizes accurate positioning and track tracking of different training spaces, the WebRTC real-time communication subsystem realizes multi-mode real-time voice interaction and voice-text conversion, and the training guide management subsystem realizes positioning display, communication scheduling, video linkage and alarm control through front and rear end cooperation. The system can improve the safety monitoring precision and the scheduling efficiency in the training of firefighters, simultaneously supports the backtracking and the rewinding of the training process, and provides technical support for the safety guarantee and the efficiency improvement of the firefighting training.

title_en: Immediately positioning and map building exploration search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind positioning immediately and map building exploration search and rescue robot, applied to the field such as tube map establishment, landform exploration after calamity, including obstacle detouring chassis, vehicle body platform, 3-D scanning module, main control unit, body shell and drive module composition.Obstacle detouring chassis uses the bionics suspension frame structure of six wheel drives, car body is had the passive adaptivity to different terrain.3-D scanning module includes 3-D scanning mechanism, scanning laser radar, infrared temperature sensor, inertial laser sensor and fixed support composition.The robot can during traveling autonomous exploration surrounding environment, and create three-dimensional land map in real time, while detect whether to be possible to life entity presence；Real-time three-dimensional map, possible life entity can be searched and rescued position and feed back to operating personnel；Help operating personnel quickly and accurately to understand field condition, to deploy rescue work as early as possible, while reduce exploration and the unnecessary casualties of rescue worker and labor loss.

title_en: A socket connector of incandescent lamp, a fire detector and escape-guide lamp having beacon module for detecting indoor location and system for detecting indoor location using the same
title_ko: 실내 측위용 비콘 모듈을 구비한 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등과 이를 이용한 실내 측위 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire detector including a beacon module for indoor positioning, an evacuation guidance lamp, and an indoor positioning system using the same are provided to facilitate accurate indoor positioning by mounting the beacon module for indoor positioning, thereby being manufactured at low costs. CONSTITUTION: A fire detector (700) is composed of a base, a cover (700b), and a support (700c). The base is combined with the cover and simultaneously forms a smoke sensing room and a dark room inside. A power supply unit receives power from the outside and provides the power. An AC/DC converter converts the received power and supplies driving power. A beacon module for indoor positioning wirelessly transmits a beacon signal to the outside through an embedded antenna using wireless communication. The beacon module for indoor positioning is installed on a predetermined position of the base or on a circuit board between the support and the base. [Reference numerals] (AA) Beacon signal (including a beacon ID); (BB) Position of a user; (CC) Position estimation message
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실내 측위용 비콘 모듈을 구비한 백열등 소켓 커넥터, 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등과 이를 이용한 실내 측위 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 의하면 백열등 소켓 커넥터, 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등에 실내 측위용 비콘 모듈을 장착하여 정확한 실내 측위가 가능하도록 함으로써, 실내 측위 시스템을 저렴한 비용으로 간단하게 구축할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명에 의하면 백열등 소켓 커넥터, 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등으로부터 전송되는 비콘 신호의 세기를 기초로 사용자의 현재 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으므로, 이에 따라 건물 내부에 화재나 위급상황이 발생하였을 때 실내에 사람이 있는지를 일일이 확인하러 다니지 않고도 사용자의 현재 위치를 신속하게 파악하여 대피하도록 할 수 있어 신속한 인명구조 및 초기대응이 가능하게 되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Indoor positioning system for fire alarm system
abstract_en: A building management system tracks occupants of a building in which the building management system is installed and presents information about the occupants, including location information, to first responders during emergency and/or training events. Distributed devices of the building management system receive identification information broadcast by user devices of the occupants and sends the identification information to a control panel of the building management system. Location information for the occupants is generated based on the identification information received from the user devices and stored along with time and date information. This location information is then retrieved and presented to first responders, for example, by displaying a map of the building with icons representing the distributed devices and occupants, based on the location information.

title_en: A kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection radar device, especially a kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device having both detection human life characteristic information and range information, can be used for disaster assistance.A kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device includes the first signal generator, the first power splitter, frequency mixer, power amplifier, ultra broadband transmitting antenna, ultra-wideband receiver antenna, low noise amplifier, i/q demodulator, secondary signal generator, the second power splitter, voltage-controlled phase shifter, adjustable attenuator, solid state microwave sensor, the 3rd signal generator, lock-in amplifier, signal acquisition process module, can quickly and accurately detect vital signss information and the positional information of trapped personnel.

title_en: Communication method and related device
abstract_en: The present application describes a communication method and related device. The method includes a first responder receiving from an initiator a first frame for initiating a ranging process. The first responder generates a first private address based on the first frame and information related to an identity of the first responder, and the first responder transmits a second frame carrying the first private address to the initiator. The method may be applied to ultra-wideband multi-millisecond ranging systems. According to this application, an initiator can verify whether a frame is really from an authorized responder in an ultra-wideband multi-millisecond ranging session.

title_en: Inertial navigation assisted radio direction correction method in complex environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a radio direction-finding correction method assisted by inertial navigation in a complex environment, which can be used for the inertial navigation assisted radio direction-finding correction of a long-distance complex aviation search and rescue application scene, under the condition that a direction-finding device of a carrier receives interference such as shielding, the information of the position and the heading of the carrier output by inertial navigation is combined with the direction-finding information measured by a directional device, and the single plane flying Duan Duo point measurement information is utilized to carry out cross positioning, single positioning precision is improved through clustering, and then the multi-plane flying section measurement information is utilized to gradually improve global target positioning precision, so that the direction-finding result is corrected, and the orientation precision and reliability of the aviation search and rescue orientation equipment are greatly improved.

title_en: Method and system for locating entry point of firefighter building
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for locating entry points of firefighters in buildings, comprising the following steps: step S1: respectively solving position data by a micro inertial navigation system and a satellite navigation system; step S2: fusing the position data to obtain fused position data; step S3: collecting 3D data of surrounding environment, matching and resolving the data with the 3D graphic database of the building, and correcting the position information of the micro inertial navigation system by using the position information of the database after the entry point of the building is successfully paired; step S4: the micro inertial navigation system calculates accurate position data by integration starting from this point based on the corrected position information. The invention provides a fusion positioning method based on a miniature 3D laser radar, which is used for determining the accurate position of a building entry point of a fireman and fusion positioning calculation of an individual positioning system, so that the problem that the prior art cannot provide an effective and accurate fusion positioning method is solved.
assignees: JIANGSU DEYIJIA SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Position mining device and mining system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the mining device of one kind positioning and mining system, positioning mining device includes a body, and the body sets location and installation chamber, and the location and installation chamber sets locating module mounting seat, an indoor positioning module is fixedly installed thereon.The location and installation chamber also sets up a battery, and it connects described locating module mounting seat, for for the indoor positioning module for power supply.The mining device of positioning described above can realize precise positioning; trapped personnel can be searched and rescued in time when occurring accident of mine disaster, get the rescue time of preciousness, simultaneously; the track protection to miner operation can be also realized for mining site manager in daily miner operation, unnecessary security incident is to avoid.

title_en: Radar sensor-based bio-inspired autonomous mobile robot using BLE location tracking for disaster rescue
abstract_en: An autonomous bio-inspired mobile robotic device ( 200 ) capable of detecting, tracking and communicating location of survivor(s) ( 34 ) trapped under earthquake/building collapse debris ( 30, 32 ). The small-size, lightweight, ruggedized autonomous legged mobile robot ( 200 ) incorporates high-frequency millimeter-wave radar sensor ( 10 ) and Ultra Wideband (IR-UWB) radar sensor ( 12 ) for detecting presence and perform ranging of trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ). The autonomous mobile robot ( 200 ) also comprises GNSS ( 8 ) and BLE ( 4 ) connectivity for location tracking of trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ) in conjunction with a Wi-Fi enabled visual sensing solution ( 20 ) and a flashlight ( 16 ) to aid during rescue operation. The battery-powered ( 24 ) autonomous bio-inspired mobile robot ( 200 ) also comprises an MCU ( 26 ), actuators ( 14   b ), motor control circuitry ( 18 ) and IMU ( 6 ) to control robot ( 200 ) locomotion and perform sensor data fusion. BLE ( 4 ) connectivity solution of the present invention ( 200 ) communicates the location of detected trapped survivor(s) ( 34 ) to a plurality of rescue devices ( 44 A,  44 B,  44 C) using Angle-of-Arrival ( 700 )/Angle-of-Departure ( 800 ) method for successful survivor ( 34 ) location resolution.

title_en: Fine positioning system applying UWB technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a fine positioning system applying UWB technology, which comprises a server, a positioning module arranged on a positioning device and a search and rescue module; the positioning module is provided with a UWB tag which communicates with the server through UWB; the positioning module is connected with the search and rescue module through Bluetooth; the search and rescue module and the positioning module are respectively provided with a Bluetooth sending module and a Bluetooth receiving module which are matched; and a sending indicator lamp and a receiving indicator lamp for displaying the strength of the Bluetooth connecting signal are respectively arranged on the search and rescue module and the positioning module. By adopting the technical scheme, when the rescue is carried out under the mine, the rescue personnel can know the distance from the rescuee in real time, the rescue time is saved, and meanwhile, as the positioning device is also provided with the indicating lamp, the rescuee can know the signal that the rescuer comes to rescue the rescuee by receiving the indicating lamp, so that the rescuee is informed, and the rescuers can further take the measures of calling for help and the like to directly find the rescuee.

title_en: Terminal positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a terminal positioning method, a terminal positioning device, terminal positioning equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining base station data of an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and coordinate data of a terminal in an unmanned aerial vehicle flight area, identifying a signal transmission environment between the terminal and the unmanned aerial vehicle base station to obtain an identification result, correcting the base station data under the condition that the identification result represents that the signal transmission environment is a non-line-of-sight signal environment, determining positioning information of the terminal based on the corrected base station data and the coordinate data, solving the problem that search and rescue positioning accuracy is low under the condition that the search and rescue signal transmission environment is the non-line-of-sight signal transmission environment, realizing automatic correction of the coordinate data of the terminal, and improving the accuracy of the positioning information of the terminal.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE CHENGDU INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Communication method and related device
abstract_en: The present application provides a communication method and related device. The method includes: a first responder receives from an initiator a first frame for initiating a ranging process; the first responder generates a first private address based on the first frame and information related to an identity of the first responder; and the first responder transmits a second frame carrying the first private address to the initiator. The method may be applied to ultra-wideband multi-millisecond ranging systems. According to this application, an initiator can verify whether a frame is really from an authorized responder in an ultra-wideband multi-millisecond ranging session.

title_en: Wafer scale. ultra-wide band (uwb) radiometer with sensor probe for disaster victim rescue
abstract_en: A multi-sensor system is disclosed for detecting victims that may be trapped or buried (for example, earthquake survivors in collapsed buildings) and for accurately and safely locating such victims for safe and efficient rescue. An ultra wide band (UWB) radiometer sensor can detect and precisely calculate the position of the victim relative to a known position of a sensor probe or a monitoring unit of a sensor system. A sensing probe may be guided toward a victim and provide a combination of sensors and transducers (e.g., radiometer, optical and infrared camera, acoustic or sound transducers such as microphone and speaker) that may allow a probe operator remote from the subject (e.g., victim) to also determine the condition and status of the victim and communicate with the victim. With unique coding of the UWB signals, multiple units can be used together to triangulate a more exact position of each victim.

title_en: Terminal for alerting based on position for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a location-based alarm terminal for firefighting, comprises an NFC module, a wireless LAN, an RFID tag, a Bluetooth module, an ultra-wideband (UWB) module, an output module, and a control circuit electrically connected to the NFC module, the wireless LAN, the RFID tag, the Bluetooth module, the UWB module, and the output module. The control circuit can initiate a communication with one or more adjacent external terminals using the NFC module, form a Wi-Fi mesh with the external terminals using the wireless LAN, calculate a first distance between a location-based alarm terminal for firefighting and each of the external terminals using the Bluetooth module, calculate a second distance between the location-based alarm terminal for firefighting and each of the external terminals using the UWB module, and output an alarm using the output module when the first distance calculated by using the Bluetooth module and the second distance calculated by using the UWB module satisfy a specified condition. Therefore, a firefighter can be prevented from falling behind or being isolated.
abstract_ko: 본 문서에 개시되는 일 실시예에 따른 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말은 NFC 모듈, 무선 LAN, RFID 태그, 블루투스 모듈, UWB(ultra wideband) 모듈, 출력 모듈, 및 NFC 모듈, 무선 LAN, RFID 태그, 블루투스 모듈, UWB 모듈 및 출력 모듈과 전기적으로 연결된 제어 회로를 포함하고, 제어 회로는 NFC 모듈을 이용하여 인접한 하나 이상의 외부 단말과 통신을 개시하고, 무선 LAN을 이용하여 하나 이상의 외부 단말과 Wi-Fi 메쉬를 형성하고, 블루투스 모듈을 이용하여 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말과 하나 이상의 외부 단말 각각 사이의 제1 거리를 산출하고, UWB 모듈을 이용하여 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말과 하나 이상의 외부 단말 각각 사이의 제2 거리를 산출하고, 블루투스 모듈을 이용하여 산출한 제1 거리 및 UWB 모듈을 이용하여 산출한 제2 거리가 지정된 조건을 만족하는 경우, 출력 모듈을 이용하여 경보를 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for locating and monitoring first responders
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention can provide for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station. The system and method can include storing the location, motion and orientation data as well as status data, in the event that the communication system is unable to communicate with and transmit information to the monitoring station, the system will wait until communication is restored and transmit the status information to the monitoring station to update the location, motion orientation and status information for the person or asset.
assignees: FUNK BENJAMIN E;BANDYOPADHYAY AMRIT;KOHN ERIC A;GOLDSMAN NEIL;TEOLIS CAROLE A;BLANKENSHIP GILMER L;TRX SYSTEMS INC

title_en: Maritime life saving system with a geofence and artificial intelligence function
title_ko: 지오펜스와 인공 지능을 활용한 해상 인명 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine lifesaving system using a geofence and artificial intelligence (AI). The marine lifesaving system of the present invention includes a transmitting device provided in a life jacket, and a receiving device and a rescue processing device provided in a ship. The transmitting device has an inertial sensor and a salinity sensor. The receiving device transmits a radio signal transmitted from the transmitting device to the rescue processing device. The rescue processing device generates voice information in accordance with various scenarios in response to various distress accidents, and forms an AI voice signal optimized for a situation of a distress accident as a database. The rescue processing device sets a positional relationship between the transmitting device and the receiving device as a geofence area. When the transmitting device deviates from a set geofence area or is detected equal to or less than a reference altitude from the inertial sensor and a certain value of salinity concentration is detected at the same time, it is determined that a distress accident or a fall accident occurs to induce sailing of a ship to a location of a survivor or to provide an operator of the ship with AI voice information guiding to rescue a falling person. According to the present invention, when a distress accident occurs, the AI voice information can be output to promptly and accurately rescue a survivor or a falling person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지오펜스와 인공 지능을 활용한 해상 인명 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 해상 인명 구조 시스템은 구명 조끼에 구비되는 발신 장치와, 선박에 구비된 수신 장치 및 구조 처리 장치를 포함한다. 발신 장치는 관성 센서와 염분 센서를 구비한다. 수신 장치는 발신 장치로부터 전송되는 무선 신호를 구조 처리 장치로 전달한다. 구조 처리 장치는 다양한 조난 사고에 대응하여 여러가지 시니리오에 따른 음성 정보를 생성하고, 조난 사고의 상황에 최적화된 인공 지능 음성 신호를 데이터베이스화한다. 구조 처리 장치는 발신 장치와 수신 장치들 간의 위치 관계를 지오펜스 영역으로 설정한다. 발신 장치가 설정된 지오펜스 영역으로부터 이탈되거나, 관성 센서로부터 기준 고도 이하로 감지되고 동시에 일정 크기의 염분 농도가 감지되면, 조난 사고 또는 낙선 사고가 발생된 것으로 판별하여 조난자의 위치로 선박의 항해를 유도하거나 또는 낙선자를 구조하도록 안내하는 인공 지능 음성 정보를 선박의 운항자에게 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 조난 사고 발생 시, 인공 지능 음성 정보를 출력하여 조난자 및 낙선자를 신속하고 정확하게 구조하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Search and rescue UAV system and method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Mining post-disaster multifunctional emergency rescue detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue detection systems, and particularly relates to a mining post-disaster multifunctional emergency rescue detection system which comprises a personnel positioning identification card and a rescue end, wherein the personnel positioning identification card is carried by underground personnel in daily life, the personnel positioning identification card comprises a UWB communication module and is used for carrying out real-time positioning based on the cooperation of a preset communication channel CH2 and a UWB base station network, the rescue end is integrated with an environment detection module, a positioning search module, a laser ranging module and a communication module, the environment detection module is used for acquiring environment information, the laser ranging module is used for carrying out laser ranging, the positioning search module is provided with four independent and equidistant interfaces, the interface 1 and the interface 2 have a receiving and transmitting function, and the interface 3 and the interface 4 only have a receiving function. The invention can conveniently implement emergency rescue detection and support rapid, accurate and independent positioning search of trapped personnel in a communication interruption environment after disaster.
assignees: CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Target positioning method and device for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target positioning method and a target positioning device for airborne equipment. The device comprises a signal processing unit, a laser distance measuring instrument, a thermal infrared imager, a visible light camera, a combined inertial navigation module and an angle meter, wherein output signals of the laser distance measuring instrument, the thermal infrared imager, the visible light camera, the combined inertial navigation module and the angle meter are all connected to the signal processing unit, and the signal processing unit is used for solving positional information of a target according to uploaded signals. Aerial carrier global positioning system (GPS) information, aerial carrier gesture information, angular deviation of observation equipment relative to an aerial carrier and distance measuring information of the target by the observation equipment are integrated to realize accurate positioning of longitude and latitude height of the target. The advantage of a multi-sensor is combined, a multi-dimensional spatial alternation principle is utilized so as to rapidly and effectively realize accurate target positioning in a non-contact and high-adaptability way, and the target positioning method can be applied to fields such as forest fire prevention, personnel rapid search and rescue and the like, and has wide technological and market prospects.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: The comprehensive search and rescue system of community policing personnel and localization method
