abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of comprehensive search and rescue system of community policing personnel and localization method, belong to emergency relief and position field of locating technology.The search and rescue system includes：Locator, cell on wheels, hand-held set and Surveillance center.The locator is carried by going on patrol personnel, and locator has explicit alarm and implicit alarm dual-alarm function, and explicit alarm is manual alarm, when patrol personnel can not realize manual alarm, can be alarmed by the implicit warning function of locator from trend Surveillance center；It is used for when the cell on wheels is searched and rescued to patrol personnel's indoor positioning；The hand-held set is carried when being searched and rescued by rescue worker.The invention also provides a kind of indoor positioning algorithms, Stepping positioning algorithm；Seamless positioning to patrol personnel community indoor and outdoor can quickly be realized by the search and rescue device of Stepping positioning algorithm and the present invention；The present invention in community's indoor and outdoor without arranging radio sensing network in advance, and using single architecture, equipment is simple, and cost is relatively low, is easy to implement, and is particularly suitable for use in emergency searching and rescuing.

title_en: Firefighter safety positioning system based on UWB and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to technical field of fire-fighting safety and UWB wireless sensor networks, and discloses a firefighter safety positioning system based on UWB. The firefighter safety positioning system based on the UWB comprises multiple child anchor nodes and one main anchor node which are arranged in each room of a building, a positioning wristband, a router and a command center. The invention also discloses a positioning method applying the positioning system. The fire-fighting command center is enabled to understand real-time position information of firefighters in the building on fire, and whether danger occurs on the firefighters is judged according to the real-time position information. Meanwhile, the real-time fire situation of the building on fire is mastered in real time so that occurrence of danger due to the fact that the firefighters enter areas with higher risk of danger can be prevented.
assignees: HUNAN PUAN CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Fireman indoor positioning method based on WiFi fingerprint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WiFi fingerprint-based firefighter indoor positioning method, which comprises the following steps: when a fire disaster suddenly occurs, receiving signal intensity information transmitted by the wireless access node by a fireman rushing into the fire scene, and determining the serial number of a cluster to which the fireman belongs; according to the wireless access node reliability function, calculating and screening the reliability of each wireless access node, and filtering out wireless access nodes damaged by fire; calculating the distance proportion of all reference points in the same cluster by using a dynamic online matching algorithm in the cluster to which the firefighter belongs and combining the signal strength values received by the reference points, and selecting the reference points with the distance proportion larger than a distance proportion threshold value to carry out position estimation; and calculating the position coordinates of the firefighter according to the selected reference point. The invention provides an AP trust function to screen the AP aiming at the possible AP damage condition in the fire scene; and a dynamic online matching algorithm is applied, so that the positioning precision of the algorithm is improved.

title_en: Heading angle-assisted Kalman information direction finding correction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a heading angle-assisted Kalman information direction finding correction method, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a heading angle of a search and rescue aircraft through an airborne inertial unit of the search and rescue aircraft, measuring a gangway angle of a search and rescue target relative to the search and rescue aircraft through an airborne search and rescue radio station, combining the heading angle information of the search and rescue aircraft with a radio direction finding, calculating an azimuth angle of the search and rescue target, taking the azimuth angle of the search and rescue target as a state value, establishing a Kalman filtering recursive formula, constructing Kalman information, carrying out first correction on a direction finding result, and carrying out second correction on the heading angle, so that the radio direction finding wild value is effectively corrected, and the accuracy and reliability of aviation search and rescue radio direction finding are greatly improved.
